domains.name: Application
domains.covers: Launching and quitting Photoshop, preferences, plug-ins, help, account and Creative Cloud items, and performance settings.

features.name: About Photoshop
features.summary: Shows version, build and credits.

automation.notes: On macOS: Photoshop > About Photoshop. Version and build are readable without the dialog. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType AbAp); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('AbAp')) runs the same command.

features.name: About Plug-In
features.summary: Submenu listing installed plug-in modules, for example Camera Raw, with version information.

automation.notes: On macOS: Photoshop > About Plug-In.

features.name: Action Manager
features.summary: Low-level command interface that runs any recordable Photoshop event by its ID with a descriptor of parameters, and reads properties with get requests.

automation.notes: UXP equivalent: action.batchPlay with _obj descriptors, run inside core.executeAsModal for anything that changes state.

features.name: Adobe PDF Presets
features.summary: Creates, edits, imports and exports the shared Adobe PDF presets used when saving Photoshop PDF.

automation.notes: Opens a modal dialog. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType pdfPresetFilename); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('pdfPresetFilename')) runs the same command. Dialog-only: Edit > Adobe PDF Presets (pdfPresetFilename) opens a modal dialog and none of its settings are reachable from a script or an Action Manager event in the cited sources, so nothing runs it unattended.

features.name: Application
features.summary: The running Photoshop instance as scripts see it: open documents, preferences, colours, fonts, notifiers and the Action Manager entry points.

automation.notes: UXP exposes the same root as require("photoshop").app.

features.name: Back up and restore preferences
features.summary: Copy the Adobe Photoshop [version] Settings folder while Photoshop is closed to keep or restore custom settings.

automation.notes: Done in the file system; scripts can locate the folder through Application.preferencesFolder.

features.name: Beep
features.summary: Plays the system alert sound.

features.name: Bring Photoshop to front
features.summary: Makes Photoshop the active application.

automation.notes: UXP: app.bringToFront().

features.name: Cache Tile Size
features.summary: Amount of data Photoshop processes at a time; one of four sizes.

automation.notes: Set as an application preference: set with null = reference to property cachePrefs of the application (ordinal targetEnum) and to = a cachePrefs object holding only the key to change, the pattern Adobe's spaces-adapter uses for pluginPicker and unitsPrefs and JSUI uses for interfacePrefs. The keys are tileSize and tileSize64 (numbers), named in the photoshop-types typings of cachePrefs. Takes effect after restart. Unverified.

features.name: Cancel an operation
features.summary: Holding Esc (or Command+period on macOS) stops an operation in progress.

automation.notes: Interactive.

features.name: Persistent script options
features.summary: Stores and retrieves named descriptors that persist between sessions, used by scripts to remember their settings.

features.name: Delete Shortcut
features.summary: Removes the shortcut from the selected command or tool.

features.name: Dialog mode for scripts
features.summary: Controls whether commands run by a script show their dialogs (all, only on error, or none).

automation.notes: Each executeAction call also takes its own DialogModes argument; UXP batchPlay uses the dialogOptions option instead.

features.name: Discover panel
features.summary: In-app search panel for tools, help articles, tutorials and Quick Actions, opened with Ctrl/Cmd+F, the search icon or Help > Photoshop Help; Esc closes it.

features.name: Discover Plugins
features.summary: Opens the Creative Cloud Marketplace in the Creative Cloud desktop app to find and install plug-ins.

automation.notes: Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Efficiency indicator
features.summary: Status readout of the share of time spent processing rather than reading or writing the scratch disk.

features.name: Export/Import Presets
features.summary: Exports chosen preset sets to a folder or imports them, to move presets between computers.

features.name: Feature availability check
features.summary: Reports whether a named feature (for example photoshop/extended) is enabled in this installation.

features.name: Openable file types
features.summary: Lists the file extensions or Mac file types Photoshop can open.

automation.notes: Read-only.

features.name: Free memory
features.summary: Reports how much memory is available to Photoshop.

automation.notes: Read-only.

features.name: GPU Compatibility
features.summary: Help menu report of which GPU-accelerated features the current graphics processor supports.

features.name: Graphics processor information
features.summary: Reports the graphics processor, OpenGL and OpenCL state Photoshop detected.

automation.notes: UXP 23.1+: core.getGPUInfo() returns gpuInfoList (OpenGL) and clgpuInfoList (OpenCL) entries, and core.getCPUInfo() the CPU vendor, cores and frequency. getGPUInfo is also listed in the Alchemist event list, with no descriptor documented. No ExtendScript member.

features.name: Use Graphics Processor
features.summary: Enables GPU acceleration in the Graphics Processor Settings area; Advanced Settings include Use OpenCL.

automation.notes: Set as an application preference: set with null = reference to property cachePrefs of the application (ordinal targetEnum) and to = a cachePrefs object holding only the key to change, the pattern Adobe's spaces-adapter uses for pluginPicker and unitsPrefs and JSUI uses for interfacePrefs. The key is openglEnabled (boolean), named in the photoshop-types typings of cachePrefs, which also hold an openglAdvanced object (GLCompute, CLCompute and others). May need a restart. Unverified.

features.name: Hide Others
features.summary: macOS: hides other applications' windows.

automation.notes: macOS only.

features.name: Hide Photoshop
features.summary: macOS: hides Photoshop's windows.

automation.notes: macOS only.

features.name: Cache presets
features.summary: Performance presets that set cache levels and tile size: Web/UI Design, Default/Photos and Huge Pixel Dimensions.

features.name: History States
features.summary: Maximum number of History panel states (default 50, up to 1,000), in the History & Cache section.

features.name: Keyboard shortcut sets
features.summary: Named sets of shortcuts chosen in the Set menu; Photoshop Defaults is the built-in set, and custom sets are saved with Save Set or Save Set As.

automation.notes: Chosen, saved and deleted only in the Keyboard Shortcuts and Menus dialog.

features.name: Keyboard Shortcuts
features.summary: Keyboard Shortcuts and Menus dialog for viewing and editing shortcuts of Application Menus, Panel Menus, Tools and Taskspaces, saved as named sets.

automation.notes: Opens a modal dialog; editing shortcuts is manual. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType keyboardCustomization); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('keyboardCustomization')) runs the same command. Dialog-only: Edit > Keyboard Shortcuts (keyboardCustomization) opens a modal dialog and none of its settings are reachable from a script or an Action Manager event in the cited sources, so nothing runs it unattended.

features.name: Summarize (keyboard shortcuts)
features.summary: Exports the current shortcut list to an HTML file for viewing or printing.

features.name: Manage Creative Cloud account
features.summary: Opens the Adobe account page for the signed-in user.

automation.notes: Recorded as syncManageAcct for Edit > Sync Settings > Manage Account Online in Photoshop CC; the current Help menu location is not established here. Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Menus
features.summary: Hides menu items or gives them colours in application and panel menus, saved as menu sets.

automation.notes: Opens a modal dialog. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType menuCustomization); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('menuCustomization')) runs the same command. Dialog-only: Edit > Menus (menuCustomization) opens a modal dialog and none of its settings are reachable from a script or an Action Manager event in the cited sources, so nothing runs it unattended.

features.name: Migrate Presets
features.summary: Imports presets such as brushes, swatches, gradients, patterns, styles, shapes, actions and tool presets from an earlier installed version.

features.name: Modernized interface design
features.summary: Version 27.0 redesigned controls, dialogs, taskbars and panels and improved keyboard navigation, readability and contrast.

features.name: Photoshop (beta)
features.summary: Separate pre-release build installed from Creative Cloud for trying features before release.

automation.notes: A separate application install, not a setting.

features.name: Photoshop Help
features.summary: Opens help and learning content in the Discover panel.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType help); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('help')) runs the same command.

features.name: Plug-in information
features.summary: Information about loaded UXP plug-ins.

automation.notes: UXP 23.2+: core.getPluginInfo() returns run-time figures for the calling plug-in (pending main-thread tasks, batchPlay call count, time-outs, V8 heap size). Adobe marks it for development only. No ExtendScript equivalent.

features.name: Plugins menu
features.summary: Top-level menu listing installed UXP plug-ins, with an item to discover more in the Creative Cloud Marketplace.

features.name: Additional plug-ins folder
features.summary: Loads plug-ins from an extra folder at startup.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: Append File Extension
features.summary: Whether saved file names get the format extension (Never, Always, Ask When Saving) and whether it is lower case.

features.name: Asian text options
features.summary: Shows Asian type options in the Character and Paragraph panels.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: Ask before saving layered TIFF files
features.summary: Warns when a TIFF is saved with layers.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: Auto-update open documents
features.summary: Reloads an open document when its file changes on disk.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: Beep When Done
features.summary: Plays a sound when a long operation finishes.

features.name: Cache Levels
features.summary: Levels of cached image data (default 4, up to 8) that speed redraw and histograms.

features.name: Color Picker
features.summary: Chooses the Adobe Color Picker or the operating system picker.

automation.notes: Preferences.colorPicker takes ColorPicker.ADOBE, APPLE, WINDOWS or PLUGIN.

features.name: Column Size (Width and Gutter)
features.summary: Column width and gutter used when sizing images in columns.

features.name: Dynamic colour sliders
features.summary: Shows live colour previews in the Color panel sliders.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: Export Clipboard
features.summary: Keeps Photoshop contents on the system clipboard after quitting.

features.name: Font names in English
features.summary: Lists non-Latin font names in English.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: Font preview size
features.summary: Size of font samples in font menus.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: Image Interpolation
features.summary: Default resampling method used when images are resized or transformed.

features.name: Image Previews
features.summary: Whether to save image previews: Never Save, Always Save or Ask When Saving.

features.name: Maximize PSD and PSB File Compatibility
features.summary: Saves a flattened composite in PSD/PSB files so other applications can read them: Always, Never or Ask.

features.name: Memory Usage
features.summary: Amount of RAM Photoshop may use (Let Photoshop Use); 70% by default, applied after restart.

features.name: Other Cursors
features.summary: Pointer for non-painting tools: Standard or Precise.

features.name: Point/Pica Size
features.summary: Whether a point is 1/72 inch (PostScript) or 1/72.27 inch (Traditional).

features.name: Recent File List Contains
features.summary: Number of files listed under File > Open Recent and on the Home screen (0-100).

features.name: Rulers (units)
features.summary: Unit used by rulers and, in scripts, for distance values.

features.name: Remember panel locations
features.summary: Keeps panel positions between sessions.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: Show Channels In Color
features.summary: Displays individual colour channels in their colour instead of grey.

features.name: Show Tooltips
features.summary: Shows tool and control descriptions on hover.

features.name: Smart quotes
features.summary: Replaces straight quotes with typographer's quotes while typing.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: Grid Size (transparency)
features.summary: Size of the transparency checkerboard, or None to hide it.

features.name: Type units
features.summary: Unit for type sizes: points, pixels or millimetres.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: UI Font Size
features.summary: Size of text in panels and tooltips (Tiny, Small, Medium, Large), with Scale UI To Font; takes effect after restart.

automation.notes: Takes effect after restart.

features.name: Diffusion dither (legacy)
features.summary: Legacy display option that dithers colours on 8-bit displays.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: Pixel doubling (legacy)
features.summary: Legacy option that previews at half resolution for faster display.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: Use Shift Key For Tool Switch
features.summary: Requires Shift with a tool's letter to cycle through the tools in its group.

features.name: Video alpha (legacy)
features.summary: Legacy option that sends transparency to supported video hardware.

automation.notes: A Preferences property in the scripting object model; the help pages used here do not show its current label or pane.

features.name: Zoom Resizes Windows
features.summary: Resizes floating document windows when zooming with the keyboard.

features.name: Preferences
features.summary: The Preferences dialog: panes of application-wide settings, saved when Photoshop quits, with a search field (Ctrl/Cmd+F) since 23.5.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). Most individual settings have no DOM member; those that do are listed on their own records. Changes made before a crash are lost. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType GnrP); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('GnrP')) runs the same command.

features.name: Preferences: Camera Raw
features.summary: Opens the Camera Raw Preferences dialog (also reachable from File Handling): file handling, caching, performance and JPEG/TIFF handling.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType cameraRawPrefs); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('cameraRawPrefs')) runs the same command. The settings inside the dialog are not scriptable through our sources. Dialog-only: Preferences > Camera Raw (menu item cameraRawPrefs) is the Camera Raw plug-in's own preferences dialog; opens a modal dialog and none of its settings are reachable from a script or an Action Manager event in the cited sources, so nothing runs it unattended. The Application.preferences object has no Camera Raw members.

features.name: Preferences: Cursors
features.summary: Painting Cursors and Other Cursors styles.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). UXP 24.0+ exposes some of these settings as app.preferences.cursors. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType DspC); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('DspC')) runs the same command.

features.name: Preferences: Export
features.summary: Quick Export format, location and metadata defaults, and Use Legacy "Export As".

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions).

features.name: Preferences: File Handling
features.summary: File saving options, file compatibility, recent files and the Camera Raw Preferences button.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). UXP 24.0+ exposes some of these settings as app.preferences.filehandling. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType SvnF); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('SvnF')) runs the same command.

features.name: Preferences folder
features.summary: Location of the user's Photoshop settings folder (Adobe Photoshop [version] Settings).

automation.notes: Read-only.

features.name: Preferences: General
features.summary: Colour picker, image interpolation, Beep When Done, Reset Preferences On Quit, Reset All Warning Dialogs and other general options.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). UXP 24.0+ exposes some of these settings as app.preferences.general. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType GnrP); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('GnrP')) runs the same command.

features.name: Preferences: Guides, Grid & Slices
features.summary: Colours and styles of guides, smart guides, grid and slices, and slice numbers.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). UXP 24.0+ exposes some of these settings as app.preferences.guidesgridsandslices. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType GudG); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('GudG')) runs the same command.

features.name: Preferences: History & Content Credentials
features.summary: History log options and Content Credentials document defaults.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). UXP 24.0+ exposes some of these settings as app.preferences.history.

features.name: Preferences: Image Processing
features.summary: Selections Processing option (Faster or More Stable) for selection features on Windows.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions).

features.name: Preferences: Interface
features.summary: Appearance: colour theme, UI font size and scaling, channels in colour, gestures and other display options.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). UXP 24.0+ exposes some of these settings as app.preferences.interface. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType interfacePrefs); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('interfacePrefs')) runs the same command.

features.name: Preference migration on update
features.summary: Updating through the Creative Cloud desktop app migrates presets, settings and preferences unless Import previous settings and preferences is turned off.

features.name: Quiet Mode and notification preferences
features.summary: Quiet Mode limits pop-ups and notifications; related switches control feature onboarding, What's New notices and rich tooltips.

automation.notes: UXP 26.11+: app.preferences.notifications.quietMode, showFeatureOnboarding, showWhatsNew, useRichToolTips and showToolTips, all read-write; with Quiet Mode on some of them are locked. No ExtendScript member.

features.name: Preferences: Performance
features.summary: Memory usage, history and cache, and graphics processor settings.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). UXP 24.0+ exposes some of these settings as app.preferences.performance. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType MmrP); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('MmrP')) runs the same command.

features.name: Preferences: Plug-Ins
features.summary: Plug-in loading options such as an additional plug-ins folder.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType PlgS); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('PlgS')) runs the same command.

features.name: Preferences: Scratch Disks
features.summary: Drives used as virtual memory, their order, and the active check boxes.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions).

features.name: Preferences search
features.summary: Search box in the Preferences dialog that suggests and jumps to matching settings.

features.name: Preferences: Technology Previews
features.summary: Opt-in switches for features still in development; changes apply after restart.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions).

features.name: Preferences: Tools
features.summary: Tool behaviour: tooltips, rich tooltips, spring-loaded tool timing and similar options.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). UXP 24.0+ exposes some of these settings as app.preferences.tools.

features.name: Preferences: Transparency & Gamut
features.summary: Transparency checkerboard size and colours, and the gamut warning colour and opacity.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). UXP 24.0+ exposes some of these settings as app.preferences.transparencyandgamut. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType TrnG); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('TrnG')) runs the same command.

features.name: Preferences: Type
features.summary: Type options such as smart quotes, font names in English and font preview size.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). UXP 24.0+ exposes some of these settings as app.preferences.type. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType typePreferences); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('typePreferences')) runs the same command.

features.name: Preferences: Units & Rulers
features.summary: Ruler and type units, column size, and point/pica size.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions). UXP 24.0+ exposes some of these settings as app.preferences.unitsandrulers. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType UntR); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('UntR')) runs the same command.

features.name: Preferences: Workspace
features.summary: Workspace behaviour such as panel docking and native full-screen mode on macOS.

automation.notes: On macOS the Preferences are under Photoshop > Settings (Photoshop > Preferences in older versions).

features.name: Preset Manager
features.summary: Loads, saves, renames, deletes and reorders presets of a chosen Preset Type, with Text Only, thumbnail and list views.

automation.notes: Opens a modal dialog. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType presetManager); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('presetManager')) runs the same command. Dialog-only: Edit > Presets > Preset Manager (presetManager) opens a modal dialog and none of its settings are reachable from a script or an Action Manager event in the cited sources, so nothing runs it unattended.

features.name: Script progress bar
features.summary: Shows Photoshop's progress bar for long-running script tasks, with cancel support and sub-tasks.

automation.notes: UXP: executeAsModal reportProgress option. Application.doProgress and its relatives show a progress bar around a long-running script's own JavaScript callback; there is no standalone task for a tool to perform. Scripts run through execute_photoshop_code can call them.

features.name: Purge
features.summary: Frees memory used by the undo buffer, clipboard, histories or all of them; the purge cannot be undone.

automation.notes: Submenu items: Undo, Clipboard, Histories, All (the recorded purge event carries a purgeItem enumeration). Asks for confirmation unless run without dialogs.

features.name: All
features.summary: Frees the memory used by the undo buffer, clipboard and histories.

features.name: Clipboard
features.summary: Frees the memory used by the clipboard.

features.name: Undo
features.summary: Frees the memory used by the undo buffer.

features.name: Quit Photoshop
features.summary: Closes all documents, prompting to save changes, and exits the application.

automation.notes: On macOS the item is Photoshop > Quit Photoshop. Prompts for unsaved documents unless they are closed first.

features.name: Refresh the screen during a script
features.summary: Pauses a running script so the screen redraws.

automation.notes: UXP: core.redrawDocument.

features.name: Reset All Warning Dialogs
features.summary: Turns back on every warning that was dismissed with "Don't show again".

features.name: Reset Preferences On Quit
features.summary: Deletes the settings files so Photoshop starts with defaults; alternatively hold Ctrl+Alt+Shift (Command+Option+Shift) while launching.

automation.notes: A button in the General pane, or the modifier keys at launch; no DOM member or published event. Deleting the settings folder while Photoshop is closed has the same effect and also removes custom shortcuts, workspaces and colour settings.

features.name: Run a menu command from a script
features.summary: Invokes a menu item programmatically, by its menu item type ID in ExtendScript or by numeric command ID in UXP.

automation.notes: UXP: core.performMenuCommand({commandID}), core.getMenuCommandState and core.getMenuCommandTitle. Adobe publishes only example IDs; the IDs established for this atlas are recorded on their features.

features.name: Choose a scratch disk at launch
features.summary: Holding Ctrl+Alt (Command+Option) while launching lets you pick a new scratch disk when the current one is full.

features.name: Scratch Disks
features.summary: Drives used as virtual memory, chosen with check boxes and ordered with arrows; applied after restart. Supported formats are APFS or macOS Extended, and NTFS, exFAT or FAT32 on Windows.

automation.notes: No DOM member or published event. Scratch disk management was revised in 27.1.

features.name: Selections Processing
features.summary: Windows option in Image Processing preferences: Faster (default) or More Stable, for selection features on some NVIDIA drivers.

automation.notes: Windows only.

features.name: Settings files (.psp)
features.summary: Files such as Brushes.psp, Swatches.psp and ToolPresets.psp in the settings folder that hold current presets and can be copied between installations.

features.name: Show All
features.summary: macOS: shows the windows of all hidden applications.

automation.notes: macOS only.

features.name: System Info
features.summary: Shows a text report of the Photoshop version, operating system, memory, GPU and plug-ins for troubleshooting.

automation.notes: Application.systemInformation returns the same report as a string without opening the dialog. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType SstI); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('SstI')) runs the same command.

features.name: Technology Previews
features.summary: Opt-in experimental features listed in the Technology Previews preferences pane.

automation.notes: Set as an application preference: set with null = reference to property experimentalFeatures of the application (ordinal targetEnum) and to = a experimentalFeatures object holding only the key to change, the pattern Adobe's spaces-adapter uses for pluginPicker and unitsPrefs and JSUI uses for interfacePrefs. The photoshop-types typings of experimentalFeatures name expFeatureModifierPalette, expFeatureDeepUpscale, expFeatureContentAwareTracing and expFeatureUXPExportAs; other previews have no key in our sources. Changes apply after restart. Unverified.

features.name: Enable Content-Aware Tracing Tool
features.summary: Adds the Content-Aware Tracing tool, which makes paths along image edges; needs the graphics processor.

automation.notes: Set as an application preference: set with null = reference to property experimentalFeatures of the application (ordinal targetEnum) and to = a experimentalFeatures object holding only the key to change, the pattern Adobe's spaces-adapter uses for pluginPicker and unitsPrefs and JSUI uses for interfacePrefs. The key is expFeatureContentAwareTracing (boolean), named in the photoshop-types typings of experimentalFeatures. Technology preview; takes effect after restart and the list changes between releases. Unverified.

features.name: Deactivate Native Canvas
features.summary: Falls back from the native canvas when on-canvas visuals do not display properly.

automation.notes: Technology preview; takes effect after restart. The list changes between releases.

features.name: Use Modifier Keys Palette
features.summary: On-screen palette of modifier keys for Windows touch devices, shown with Window > Modifier Keys.

automation.notes: Set as an application preference: set with null = reference to property experimentalFeatures of the application (ordinal targetEnum) and to = a experimentalFeatures object holding only the key to change, the pattern Adobe's spaces-adapter uses for pluginPicker and unitsPrefs and JSUI uses for interfacePrefs. The key is expFeatureModifierPalette (boolean), named in the photoshop-types typings of experimentalFeatures. Technology preview; takes effect after restart and the list changes between releases. Unverified.

features.name: Enable Native Canvas Rulers
features.summary: GPU-accelerated ruler drawing.

automation.notes: Technology preview; takes effect after restart. The list changes between releases.

features.name: Older GPU Mode (Pre 2016)
features.summary: Uses the older GPU path for graphics processors from before 2016 or without DirectX 12.

automation.notes: Technology preview; takes effect after restart. The list changes between releases.

features.name: Enable Preserve Details 2.0 Upscale
features.summary: Adds the AI-assisted Preserve Details 2.0 option to the Image Size Resample menu.

automation.notes: Technology preview; takes effect after restart. The list changes between releases.

features.name: Toolbar
features.summary: Customize Toolbar dialog: regroups tools, moves rarely used ones to Extra Tools, and saves toolbar presets.

features.name: Updates
features.summary: Checks for application updates through the Creative Cloud desktop app.

automation.notes: Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Application version and build
features.summary: Read-only identification of the installed Photoshop: version string, build number, scripting interface version and install path.

automation.notes: Read-only properties.

features.name: Current and long-term support versions
features.summary: Photoshop 2026 is version 27.x; Photoshop 2025 (26.11.x) is the long-term support version.

automation.notes: From the release notes captured in December 2025.

domains.name: Documents
domains.covers: Creating, opening, saving, closing and configuring documents: presets, templates, metadata (File Info) and recovery.

features.name: Automatically Save Recovery Information
features.summary: Saves crash-recovery data at a chosen interval so work can be restored after a crash.

automation.notes: Set as an application preference: set with null = reference to property fileSavePrefs of the application (ordinal targetEnum) and to = a fileSavePrefsClass object holding only the key to change, the pattern Adobe's spaces-adapter uses for pluginPicker and unitsPrefs and JSUI uses for interfacePrefs. The keys are fileAutoSaveEnabled (boolean) and fileAutoSaveInterval (number), named in the photoshop-types typings of fileSavePrefsClass. Unverified.

features.name: Blank Document Presets
features.summary: Predefined blank document sizes and settings per category and device.

automation.notes: UXP 23.0+: app.createDocument({preset: name}) creates a document from an installed or user preset; DocumentCreateOptions also has presetJSON (22.5). No ExtendScript member lists or applies presets.

features.name: Browse in Bridge
features.summary: Opens Adobe Bridge to find and open files.

automation.notes: Needs Adobe Bridge installed. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType toggleFileBrowserPalette); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('toggleFileBrowserPalette')) runs the same command.

features.name: Clear
features.summary: Deletes the selected pixels; on a Background layer the area takes the background colour.

automation.notes: Recorded as delete; Backspace (Windows) or Delete (macOS) does the same.

features.name: Clear Recent File List
features.summary: Empties the Open Recent submenu.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType clearRecentFiles); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('clearRecentFiles')) runs the same command.

features.name: Close
features.summary: Closes the active document, asking to save unsaved changes.

automation.notes: Document.close(SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES) closes without prompting. UXP: Document.close / closeWithoutSaving.

features.name: Close All
features.summary: Closes every open document.

automation.notes: Prompts for each document with unsaved changes. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType ClsA); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('ClsA')) runs the same command.

features.name: Close and Go to Bridge
features.summary: Closes the document and switches to Adobe Bridge.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType browseAndClose); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('browseAndClose')) runs the same command.

features.name: Close Others
features.summary: Closes every open document except the active one.

automation.notes: No single member runs File > Close Others; closing every document in Application.documents except Application.activeDocument with Document.close does the same, and prompts to save as the command does unless SaveOptions is passed (Tom Ruark's CloseAllOthers.jsx). The menu item's id is not established: Adobe's SDK string list has closeOthers next to closeAll, but no source shows the item being run.

features.name: Filter cloud documents
features.summary: Home screen keyword filter, sorting and list or grid view for cloud documents.

features.name: Rename, delete and move cloud documents
features.summary: From the three-dots menu on the Home screen: rename, delete (moved to Deleted) and organise cloud documents into folders.

automation.notes: Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Cloud documents
features.summary: Photoshop files (.psdc) stored in Creative Cloud that sync across desktop, iPad and web, work offline and keep version history.

automation.notes: UXP 23.0+: Document.cloudDocument (read-only) tells whether a document is a cloud document and Document.cloudWorkAreaDirectory gives its local folder. Not in the ExtendScript object model. Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Make available offline always
features.summary: Home screen option that keeps a cloud document stored locally for offline editing; Make available online-only reverses it.

automation.notes: Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Cloud storage
features.summary: Creative Cloud storage quota used by cloud documents, with upgrade options.

automation.notes: Account setting.

features.name: Comments
features.summary: Shows and replies to review comments on a shared document; also opens Share for Review.

automation.notes: Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Content Credentials
features.summary: Panel to enable Content Credentials for a document so edit history and attribution can be attached to exported files; defaults are set in History & Content Credentials preferences.

automation.notes: Depends on Adobe services; export options are part of Export As.

features.name: Copy
features.summary: Copies the selected pixels of the active layer to the clipboard.

automation.notes: Selection.copy(true) performs Copy Merged.

features.name: Copy Merged
features.summary: Copies a merged copy of all visible layers within the selection.

features.name: Cut
features.summary: Removes the selected pixels to the clipboard.

features.name: Default File Location
features.summary: File Handling preference choosing whether saves default to On your computer or Creative Cloud; local is the default since 24.1.

automation.notes: Since 24.1 the default is to save locally (On your computer).

features.name: Clear All (notes)
features.summary: Note tool option that removes every note from the document.

features.name: Do not append 'copy' to filename when saving a copy
features.summary: File Handling preference that stops Photoshop adding "copy" to the name of saved copies; Photoshop then warns about overwriting.

automation.notes: Not in the object model's Preferences.

features.name: Document file location
features.summary: Full path, folder and name of the file a document was opened from or saved to.

automation.notes: fullName and path throw an error for a document that has never been saved.

features.name: Document ID
features.summary: Internal identifier of an open document, stable while it stays open; used to target it in Action Manager calls.

automation.notes: Read-only.

features.name: Document
features.summary: An open Photoshop image as scripts see it: size, resolution, mode, layers, channels, history and file information.

features.name: Unsaved changes state
features.summary: Whether the document has been saved since its last change.

automation.notes: Read-only.

features.name: Open documents
features.summary: The set of documents currently open, and the active one.

automation.notes: Setting app.activeDocument switches the frontmost document.

features.name: Adobe Express templates
features.summary: Browse Adobe Express templates for social posts, posters and flyers from the Home screen to start a document.

automation.notes: Depends on Adobe Express and Creative Cloud services.

features.name: File Info
features.summary: Views and edits the document's XMP metadata, such as author, copyright, keywords, IPTC and camera data, and applies metadata templates.

automation.notes: Document.info (DocumentInfo) and Document.xmpMetadata read and write the fields without the dialog. UXP: get the fileInfo property with batchPlay. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType FlIn); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('FlIn')) runs the same command.

features.name: Author metadata
features.summary: Creator name and job title.

automation.notes: Scriptable DocumentInfo fields; the corresponding File Info dialog field labels are not listed on the help pages used here.

features.name: Camera data (Exif)
features.summary: Read-only camera and exposure data.

automation.notes: Scriptable DocumentInfo fields; the corresponding File Info dialog field labels are not listed on the help pages used here.

features.name: Category and urgency
features.summary: Legacy IPTC category, supplemental categories and urgency.

automation.notes: Scriptable DocumentInfo fields; the corresponding File Info dialog field labels are not listed on the help pages used here.

features.name: Copyright metadata
features.summary: Copyright status, notice and info URL.

automation.notes: Scriptable DocumentInfo fields; the corresponding File Info dialog field labels are not listed on the help pages used here.

features.name: Caption and headline metadata
features.summary: Caption, caption writer, headline and instructions.

automation.notes: Scriptable DocumentInfo fields; the corresponding File Info dialog field labels are not listed on the help pages used here.

features.name: Keywords metadata
features.summary: Keyword list.

automation.notes: Scriptable DocumentInfo fields; the corresponding File Info dialog field labels are not listed on the help pages used here.

features.name: IPTC origin metadata
features.summary: Date created, location, credit, source and job reference.

automation.notes: Scriptable DocumentInfo fields; the corresponding File Info dialog field labels are not listed on the help pages used here.

features.name: Title metadata
features.summary: Document title.

automation.notes: Scriptable DocumentInfo fields; the corresponding File Info dialog field labels are not listed on the help pages used here.

features.name: Specify the file format in which to open a file
features.summary: When a file's extension does not match its format, choose the format in Open As (Windows) or the Format menu (macOS).

automation.notes: Pass format-specific open options to app.open.

features.name: Edit History Log in metadata
features.summary: When the history log is saved to metadata it can be read in File Info or Adobe Bridge.

features.name: Deleted (cloud documents)
features.summary: Home screen list of deleted cloud documents that can be restored or deleted permanently.

automation.notes: Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Lightroom Photos
features.summary: Home screen tab to browse synced Lightroom photos and bring them into Photoshop.

automation.notes: Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Home screen
features.summary: Start screen with New file and Open buttons, recent files, cloud documents, Lightroom photos, deleted cloud files and tutorials.

automation.notes: Interactive; cloud sections depend on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Shared with you
features.summary: Home screen list of cloud documents others shared with the user.

automation.notes: Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Import Notes
features.summary: Imports notes from a PDF or FDF file into their original locations, for example comments made on a flattened PDF proof.

features.name: Invite to Edit
features.summary: Invites people by email to edit a cloud document one at a time, with link access settings and a message; local files are first saved to the cloud.

automation.notes: Also under the Share button. Depends on Creative Cloud services; sends invitations.

features.name: Use Legacy File New Interface
features.summary: General preference that restores the pre-2017 New dialog.

automation.notes: Set as an application preference: set with null = reference to property generalPreferences of the application (ordinal targetEnum) and to = a generalPreferences object holding only the key to change, the pattern Adobe's spaces-adapter uses for pluginPicker and unitsPrefs and JSUI uses for interfacePrefs. The key is useClassicFileNewDialog (boolean), named in the photoshop-types typings of generalPreferences. Unverified.

features.name: Enable legacy "Save As"
features.summary: File Handling preference restoring the Save As dialog of version 22.3 and earlier, including the As a Copy checkbox.

features.name: Image Previews options (macOS)
features.summary: On macOS, which previews to save: Icon, Full Size, Macintosh Thumbnail and Windows Thumbnail.

features.name: Metadata templates
features.summary: Save File Info entries as a template and apply them to other files.

features.name: Artboards (New Document option)
features.summary: Creates the document with an artboard.

automation.notes: The make document descriptor takes an artboard boolean key (emptykid/photoshop-script-api Document.ts). No ExtendScript member.

features.name: Background Contents
features.summary: Fill of the first layer: White, Black, Background Color, Transparent or a custom colour.

automation.notes: DocumentFill has no Black or custom value; a custom colour needs a fill afterwards.

features.name: Color Mode
features.summary: Colour mode and bit depth for the new document.

features.name: Color Profile (New Document)
features.summary: Advanced option assigning a colour profile, or none, to the new document.

automation.notes: Pass the profile name as the colorProfileName argument of Documents.add.

features.name: Orientation
features.summary: Landscape or portrait page orientation; swaps width and height.

automation.notes: Scripts set width and height directly.

features.name: Pixel Aspect Ratio (New Document)
features.summary: Advanced option for non-square pixels used in video.

features.name: Resolution
features.summary: Pixels per inch or per centimetre for the new document.

features.name: Width and Height
features.summary: Document size with a unit menu.

features.name: New
features.summary: Opens the New Document dialog to create a blank document from a preset, a recent item, a saved preset or an Adobe Stock template.

automation.notes: Documents.add(width, height, resolution, name, mode, initialFill, pixelAspectRatio, bitsPerChannel, colorProfileName) creates a document without the dialog. Recorded as make with new: document (keys include width, height, resolution, mode, fill, depth, profile, pixelScaleFactor, artboard). UXP: app.documents.add / app.createDocument with DocumentCreateOptions.

features.name: New Document categories
features.summary: Tabs that group templates and blank presets: Recent, Saved, Photo, Print, Art & Illustration, Web, Mobile and Film & Video.

automation.notes: Browsing the dialog is interactive; scripts pass sizes directly.

features.name: New document from clipboard size
features.summary: When the clipboard holds image data, a new document defaults to its size and resolution.

features.name: Note tool
features.summary: Adds a note at the clicked location; the options bar sets the Author and the note Color.

automation.notes: Selected by setting app.currentTool = 'textAnnotTool' (or the select event with a textAnnotTool class reference); using the tool on the canvas is interactive.

features.name: Notes
features.summary: Non-printing text notes attached to a location on the image rather than to a layer, used for review comments.

automation.notes: ExtendScript can import notes from another file but has no member to create or read them.

features.name: Notes panel
features.summary: Shows and edits note text, steps through notes with arrows and deletes the selected note.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType toggleAnnotationPalette); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('toggleAnnotationPalette')) runs the same command.

features.name: Open
features.summary: Opens one or more files in a supported format; some formats show an options dialog first.

automation.notes: app.open(file, openOptions, asSmartObject) opens without the file dialog; app.openDialog shows it and returns the chosen files. Format options dialogs (PDF, raw, EPS) appear unless options are passed or dialogs are off.

features.name: Open As
features.summary: Windows only: opens a file while forcing the format to interpret it as.

automation.notes: Recorded as open with an as key naming the format.

features.name: Open from other Adobe apps
features.summary: Files can be sent to Photoshop from Illustrator, Fresco, Lightroom or Bridge.

features.name: Open Recent
features.summary: Submenu of recently opened files; the length is set in File Handling preferences.

features.name: Paste
features.summary: Pastes the clipboard as a new layer, centred on the selection or the view.

features.name: Paste in Place
features.summary: Pastes pixels copied from another Photoshop document at the same relative location.

automation.notes: Recorded as paste with an inPlace key.

features.name: Paste Into
features.summary: Pastes inside the current selection, adding a layer mask from it.

automation.notes: Document.paste(true) pastes into the selection.

features.name: Paste Outside
features.summary: Pastes outside the current selection, masking the selected area.

features.name: Preset Details
features.summary: Right-hand pane of the New Document dialog for naming the document and changing the preset's settings before creating it.

features.name: Projects
features.summary: Shared Projects that organise files and give collaborators edit or comment access.

automation.notes: Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Send to Apps
features.summary: Share > Send to Apps sends an image to apps such as Mail or Slack in a chosen format and resolution.

features.name: Save
features.summary: Saves changes to the current file in its current format.

automation.notes: An unsaved new document opens the Save As dialog. UXP: Document.save().

features.name: Save a Copy
features.summary: Saves a copy of the document in any format, for example a flattened JPEG or PNG, without changing the open document's file.

automation.notes: Document.saveAs with asCopy true; the save event takes a copy boolean (emptykid/photoshop-script-api).

features.name: Save As
features.summary: Saves the document under a new name, location or format, with format options such as layers, ICC profile and alpha channels.

automation.notes: Document.saveAs(file, options, asCopy, extensionType) saves without the dialog; the options object picks the format (PhotoshopSaveOptions, JPEGSaveOptions, TiffSaveOptions and so on). Recorded as save with as, in and copy keys.

features.name: Save As to Original Folder
features.summary: Save dialogs default to the folder the image came from rather than the last folder used.

automation.notes: Set as an application preference: set with null = reference to property fileSavePrefs of the application (ordinal targetEnum) and to = a fileSavePrefsClass object holding only the key to change, the pattern Adobe's spaces-adapter uses for pluginPicker and unitsPrefs and JSUI uses for interfacePrefs. The key is FileSaveToOriginalFolder (boolean), named in the photoshop-types typings of fileSavePrefsClass. Unverified.

features.name: Save Preset (New Document)
features.summary: Saves the current Preset Details as a named preset that appears in the Saved tab.

automation.notes: newDocPresetJSON is listed as New Document Presets in the Alchemist event list; its descriptor is not documented. Save Preset is a button in the New Document dialog (File > New). Its event, newDocPresetJSON, appears only as a name in the Alchemist event list; no published script or Adobe document gives its descriptor (preset name, the JSON payload or where it is written), so nothing can call it unattended with a known result. The object model has no member for New Document presets.

features.name: Save in Background
features.summary: File Handling preference that lets you keep working while a document saves.

automation.notes: Set as an application preference: set with null = reference to property fileSavePrefs of the application (ordinal targetEnum) and to = a fileSavePrefsClass object holding only the key to change, the pattern Adobe's spaces-adapter uses for pluginPicker and unitsPrefs and JSUI uses for interfacePrefs. The key is fileSaveInBackground (boolean), named in the photoshop-types typings of fileSavePrefsClass. Unverified.

features.name: Save large documents
features.summary: Documents up to 300,000 pixels per side; above 30,000 pixels they must be saved as Large Document Format (PSB), Photoshop Raw (flattened) or TIFF (up to 4 GB).

automation.notes: Save as PSB with the save event: as = largeDocumentFormat object (char id Pht8; maximizeCompatibility key), in = file path, optionally lowerCase (Proxyshop document.py save_document_psb). The 2015.5 object model has no PSB save-options class.

features.name: Cloud document picker
features.summary: Dialog shown by the Save commands offering Save to cloud documents or Save on your computer.

automation.notes: Depends on Creative Cloud services for cloud saves; the Default File Location preference controls which is offered first.

features.name: Save to cloud documents
features.summary: Saves the document to Creative Cloud from the Save dialog choice between cloud and computer.

automation.notes: Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Share button
features.summary: Button in the application bar that opens Share for Review and Invite to edit.

features.name: Share for Review
features.summary: Creates a named review link to a web version of a local or cloud document with access levels (invited people, organisation, anyone with the link) and optional password; links can be updated, recreated or deleted.

automation.notes: Also under the Share button. Depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Templates from Adobe Stock
features.summary: Preview, license and open Adobe Stock templates from the New Document dialog; search for more on the Stock website.

automation.notes: Licensing happens in the dialog and depends on Adobe Stock and Creative Cloud services.

features.name: Photoshop templates (.psdt)
features.summary: Template files that open as a new untitled .psd instance, leaving the template unchanged.

automation.notes: Opening a .psdt with app.open gives a new document based on it.

features.name: Version History
features.summary: Lists saved versions of a cloud document: name and mark versions, search and filter them, Revert to this version, or open one in a new tab.

automation.notes: Also File > Version History. Cloud documents only; depends on Creative Cloud services.

features.name: XMP metadata
features.summary: Metadata stored with the XMP standard, which also carries Exif, IPTC, GPS and Camera Raw settings; usually kept when the format changes.

domains.name: Image
domains.covers: Whole-image operations: image size and resampling, canvas size, crop and trim, rotate canvas, colour mode and bit depth, duplicate and reveal all.

features.name: Analysis
features.summary: Image menu of measurement commands: measurement scale, data points, recording, scale markers, and the Ruler and Count tools.

automation.notes: A submenu; each command (measurement scale, data points, record measurements, scale markers, Ruler and Count tools) has its own record.

features.name: Bit depth
features.summary: Bits per channel of the document: 1, 8, 16 or 32.

features.name: Bitmap (conversion dialog)
features.summary: Output resolution and method: 50% Threshold, Pattern Dither, Diffusion Dither, Halftone Screen or Custom Pattern.

features.name: 16 Bits/Channel
features.summary: Converts to 16 bits per channel.

automation.notes: Set Document.bitsPerChannel; recorded as convertMode with a depth key. Converting from 32-bit may open HDR Toning.

features.name: 32 Bits/Channel
features.summary: Converts to 32-bit floating point for high dynamic range.

automation.notes: Set Document.bitsPerChannel; recorded as convertMode with a depth key. Converting from 32-bit may open HDR Toning.

features.name: 8 Bits/Channel
features.summary: Converts to 8 bits per channel.

automation.notes: Set Document.bitsPerChannel; recorded as convertMode with a depth key. Converting from 32-bit may open HDR Toning.

features.name: Canvas Extension Color
features.summary: Colour for added canvas: Foreground, Background, White, Black, Gray or Other.

automation.notes: canvasSize descriptor key canvasExtensionColorType. Only applies when the image has a Background layer.

features.name: Canvas Size
features.summary: Adds or removes space around the image, anchored at a chosen position.

automation.notes: Document.resizeCanvas(width, height, anchor) changes the canvas without the dialog. The canvasSize event takes width, height, relative, horizontal, vertical, canvasExtensionColorType and canvasExtensionColor keys (published scripts; see the command record).

features.name: Anchor
features.summary: Grid choosing which side or corner stays fixed when the canvas changes.

features.name: Relative
features.summary: Treats Width and Height as amounts to add or subtract.

automation.notes: canvasSize descriptor key relative.

features.name: Color modes
features.summary: What each colour mode stores and how many channels it has.

automation.notes: Document.mode reads the current mode.

features.name: Color Table
features.summary: Edits the colour table of an indexed image; presets include Black Body, Grayscale, Spectrum, System (Mac OS) and System (Windows).

automation.notes: Recorded as set on the colour table (colorTable key). Indexed Color mode only.

features.name: Clear count
features.summary: Removes count markers.

features.name: Count groups
features.summary: Named groups of count markers with colour, marker size and label size.

automation.notes: Event names from the Alchemist list; descriptor keys not documented. The object model's CountItems has no groups, and the countAddGroup, countDeleteGroup and countColor events appear only by name in Alchemist's list, with no documented descriptor keys. Count items in the current group are scriptable (manage_count_items).

features.name: Count tool
features.summary: Clicks place numbered markers to count objects, in groups with their own colour and size.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType countTool); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('countTool')) runs the same command. Selected by setting app.currentTool = 'countTool' (or the select event with a countTool class reference); using the tool on the canvas is interactive.

features.name: Crop
features.summary: Crops the image to the current selection's bounding box.

automation.notes: Needs a selection. Document.crop(bounds, angle, width, height) crops to any rectangle without a selection.

features.name: Content-Aware (crop)
features.summary: Fills areas outside the original image with content-aware fill when straightening or extending.

features.name: Overlay Options (crop)
features.summary: Guides drawn in the crop box, such as Rule of Thirds, Grid and Golden Ratio; O cycles through them.

automation.notes: Tool option.

features.name: Crop size and proportions
features.summary: Options bar Aspect Ratio menu with ratio or size presets, custom values, saved presets, and a button to swap width and height.

automation.notes: Tool option.

features.name: Crop Options (gear menu)
features.summary: Use Classic mode, Auto Center Preview, Show Cropped Area, and Enable Crop Shield with colour, opacity and Auto Adjust Opacity.

automation.notes: Tool option.

features.name: Crop tool
features.summary: Draws or adjusts a crop box to trim or extend the canvas, straighten and set aspect ratio or size.

automation.notes: The crop event takes to (a rectangle), angle, width, height and resolution keys (xtools stdlib.js); Document.crop performs it directly. Selected by setting app.currentTool = 'cropTool' (or the select event with a cropTool class reference); using the tool on the canvas is interactive.

features.name: Delete Cropped Pixels
features.summary: When off, cropped areas are kept outside the canvas so the crop can be changed later.

automation.notes: Tool option; no descriptor key for it is established in the sources used.

features.name: Duotone mode
features.summary: Converts a grayscale image to monotone, duotone, tritone or quadtone using one to four custom inks.

automation.notes: No ChangeMode value; the recorded convertMode event targets duotoneMode and shows the duotone options dialog. Only grayscale images can be converted. Dialog-only: the Duotone Options dialog (type, inks, ink curves, overprint colours). Its descriptor layout is undocumented and the object model has no duotone options class.

features.name: Duplicate
features.summary: Copies the whole image, with layers, masks and channels, into a new unsaved document.

automation.notes: Document.duplicate(name, mergeLayersOnly) works without the dialog. Recorded as duplicate on the document with name and merged keys.

features.name: Duplicate Merged Layers Only
features.summary: Flattens the copy.

features.name: Resize the canvas using the Crop tool
features.summary: Dragging the crop box past the image edges adds canvas.

automation.notes: Document.crop with bounds outside the canvas extends it.

features.name: Document file size
features.summary: Document size shown in the status bar and the Image Size dialog; depends on pixel dimensions, mode, bit depth and layers.

features.name: Flip Canvas Horizontal
features.summary: Mirrors the whole image left to right.

automation.notes: Recorded as flip on the document with axis: horizontal.

features.name: Flip Canvas Vertical
features.summary: Mirrors the whole image top to bottom.

automation.notes: Recorded as flip on the document with axis: vertical.

features.name: Halftone Screen (Bitmap conversion)
features.summary: Frequency, angle and dot shape (Round, Diamond, Ellipse, Line, Square, Cross) for halftone bitmap conversion.

features.name: 32-bit Preview Options
features.summary: Sets how 32-bit images are displayed on screen, with Exposure and Gamma or Highlight Compression.

automation.notes: 32BitPreviewOptions appears in the Alchemist event list; the ps14 source records it as a menu item. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType hdrOptions); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('hdrOptions')) runs the same command. Dialog-only: View > 32-bit Preview Options. The hdrOptions menu item only opens the dialog; no descriptor or object-model member sets the preview method, exposure or gamma.

features.name: Document histogram
features.summary: Count of pixels at each of 256 levels for the composite or a channel.

automation.notes: Read-only arrays; the Histogram panel shows the same data.

features.name: Image Rotation
features.summary: Rotates or flips the whole canvas, including all layers.

automation.notes: UXP: Document.rotate(angle).

features.name: Image Size
features.summary: Changes pixel dimensions, print size and resolution, with or without resampling.

automation.notes: Document.resizeImage(width, height, resolution, resampleMethod, amount) resizes without the dialog. The imageSize event takes width, height, constrainProportions, scaleStyles and interpolation keys (emptykid/photoshop-script-api, xtools stdlib.js). UXP: Document.resizeImage.

features.name: Constrain Proportions
features.summary: Link icon that keeps width and height in proportion.

automation.notes: imageSize descriptor key constrainProportions; Document.resizeImage keeps proportions when one dimension is omitted.

features.name: Width, Height and Resolution (Image Size)
features.summary: Target size in pixels, percent or print units, and resolution in pixels per inch or centimetre; the Dimensions menu changes the unit shown.

features.name: Fit To
features.summary: Image Size menu of preset sizes, Original Size, and Auto Resolution (Screen frequency and Quality) for print output.

automation.notes: Scripts pass the values directly.

features.name: Image Size preview
features.summary: Resizable preview in the dialog; drag to pan, Ctrl/Cmd-click to magnify and Alt/Option-click to reduce.

features.name: Noise reduction (Preserve Details)
features.summary: Slider shown with Preserve Details (enlargement) that smooths noise when upscaling.

automation.notes: The amount argument of Document.resizeImage.

features.name: Resample
features.summary: Whether to change the number of pixels, and the interpolation method used: Automatic, Preserve Details (enlargement), Preserve Details 2.0, Bicubic Smoother (enlargement), Bicubic Sharper (reduction), Bicubic (smooth gradients), Nearest Neighbor (hard edges) and Bilinear.

automation.notes: Preserve Details 2.0 has no ResampleMethod value in the object model held here.

features.name: Scale Styles
features.summary: Gear-menu option that scales layer-effect values with the image; needs Constrain Proportions.

automation.notes: imageSize descriptor key scaleStyles. Not available in Document.resizeImage.

features.name: Indexed Color (conversion dialog)
features.summary: Palette, number of colours, forced colours, transparency, matte, dither and amount, and Preserve Exact Colors.

features.name: Dither (Indexed Color)
features.summary: Dithering for colours not in the table: None, Diffusion, Pattern or Noise.

features.name: Forced (Indexed Color)
features.summary: Colours always kept in the table: None, Black and White, Primaries, Web or Custom.

features.name: Matte (Indexed Color)
features.summary: Colour used to fill anti-aliased edges next to transparent areas.

features.name: Palette (Indexed Color)
features.summary: Palette types: Exact, System (Mac OS), System (Windows), Web, Uniform, Local and Master Perceptual, Selective or Adaptive, Custom and Previous.

features.name: Measurement Log: Auto Display Panel
features.summary: Auto Display Panel in the Measurement Log panel menu.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType measurementLogAutoDisplayPalette); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('measurementLogAutoDisplayPalette')) runs the same command.

features.name: Measurement Log: Delete Selected
features.summary: Delete Selected in the Measurement Log panel menu.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType measurementLogDeleteSelected); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('measurementLogDeleteSelected')) runs the same command.

features.name: Measurement Log: Deselect All
features.summary: Deselect All in the Measurement Log panel menu.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType measurementLogDeselectAll); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('measurementLogDeselectAll')) runs the same command.

features.name: Measurement Log: Export Selected
features.summary: Export Selected in the Measurement Log panel menu.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType measurementLogExportSelected); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('measurementLogExportSelected')) runs the same command.

features.name: Measurement Log
features.summary: Table of recorded measurements that can be sorted, exported or deleted.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType toggleMeasurementLogPalette); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('toggleMeasurementLogPalette')) runs the same command.

features.name: Measurement Log: Select All
features.summary: Select All in the Measurement Log panel menu.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType measurementLogSelectAll); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('measurementLogSelectAll')) runs the same command.

features.name: Mode
features.summary: Converts the document to another colour mode or bit depth.

automation.notes: Document.changeMode(ChangeMode, options) converts without dialogs; recorded as convertMode with a to class (for example RGBColorMode). Converting may ask whether to flatten or merge layers.

features.name: Bitmap
features.summary: Converts to 1-bit black and white; requires Grayscale first and opens the Bitmap dialog.

features.name: CMYK Color
features.summary: Converts to cyan, magenta, yellow and black channels using the working CMYK space.

features.name: Flatten or merge on mode conversion
features.summary: Some conversions flatten visible layers and discard hidden ones (Indexed Color, Multichannel) or ask whether to flatten or merge.

automation.notes: Which descriptor keys control flattening is not established in the sources used.

features.name: Duotone
features.summary: Converts a grayscale image to one to four inks (Monotone, Duotone, Tritone, Quadtone).

automation.notes: No ChangeMode value for Duotone; the recorded convertMode event targets duotoneMode and opens the Duotone Options dialog. Dialog-only: Image > Mode > Duotone opens the Duotone Options dialog. ChangeMode has no Duotone value, and the convertMode event to duotoneMode needs the duotone ink and curve descriptor, which no published script or Adobe reference documents, so nothing converts to Duotone with given inks unattended.

features.name: Grayscale
features.summary: Converts to shades of grey, discarding colour.

features.name: Indexed Color
features.summary: Reduces the image to at most 256 colours in a colour table.

features.name: Lab Color
features.summary: Converts to device-independent Lab.

features.name: Multichannel
features.summary: Turns each channel into an independent 256-level spot channel.

features.name: RGB Color
features.summary: Converts to red, green and blue channels.

features.name: Perspective Crop tool
features.summary: Crops along a four-cornered shape and corrects the perspective to a rectangle.

automation.notes: Committing the crop records perspectiveCrop; its descriptor (the quadrilateral corners) is not documented. Selected by setting app.currentTool = 'perspectiveCropTool' (or the select event with a perspectiveCropTool class reference); using the tool on the canvas is interactive.

features.name: Pixel Aspect Ratio
features.summary: Assigns a non-square pixel ratio for video: Square, D1/DV NTSC (0.91), D1/DV PAL (1.09), D1/DV NTSC Widescreen (1.21), HDV 1080/DVCPRO HD 720 (1.33), D1/DV PAL Widescreen (1.46), Anamorphic 2:1 (2) and DVCPRO HD 1080 (1.5).

automation.notes: Recorded as set on the document with a pixelScaleFactor key; Document.pixelAspectRatio sets it directly.

features.name: Pixel Aspect Ratio Correction
features.summary: Previews non-square pixels as they will appear on a video display.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType toggleProofVideo); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('toggleProofVideo')) runs the same command.

features.name: Custom Pixel Aspect Ratio
features.summary: Defines a new named pixel aspect ratio.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType customScaleFactor); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('customScaleFactor')) runs the same command. Dialog-only: Custom Pixel Aspect Ratio names and saves a new entry in the View > Pixel Aspect Ratio menu. Any ratio can be applied with Document.pixelAspectRatio (set_pixel_aspect_ratio), but saving a named preset has no scriptable form.

features.name: Delete Pixel Aspect Ratio
features.summary: Removes a custom pixel aspect ratio.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType deleteScaleFactor); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('deleteScaleFactor')) runs the same command. Dialog-only: Delete Pixel Aspect Ratio asks which saved preset to delete; the deleteScaleFactor menu item only opens that dialog and no descriptor names the preset.

features.name: Reset Pixel Aspect Ratios
features.summary: Restores the default list of pixel aspect ratios.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType resetScaleFactor); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('resetScaleFactor')) runs the same command. Dialog-only: Reset Pixel Aspect Ratios asks to confirm (Append or OK) in a dialog; the resetScaleFactor menu item opens it and has no documented descriptor.

features.name: Place Scale Marker
features.summary: Adds a scale bar with optional caption to the image.

automation.notes: measurementScaleMarker is listed as Measurement Scale Marker in the Alchemist event list. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType placeMeasurementScaleMarker); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('placeMeasurementScaleMarker')) runs the same command. Dialog-only: Image > Analysis > Place Scale Marker opens the Measurement Scale Marker dialog. The placeMeasurementScaleMarker menu item only opens it; the measurementScaleMarker descriptor keys are not documented and the object model has no member for it.

features.name: Record Measurements
features.summary: Measures the selection, Ruler tool line or Count tool points and adds a row to the Measurement Log.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType measurementRecordMeasurements); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('measurementRecordMeasurements')) runs the same command.

features.name: Image size and resolution
features.summary: Relationship between pixel dimensions, document resolution, print size, monitor and printer resolution.

automation.notes: Background topic.

features.name: Reveal All
features.summary: Enlarges the canvas so that every pixel of every layer, including content outside the canvas, is visible.
Rotates the canvas half a turn.

automation.notes: Document.rotateCanvas(180); recorded as rotateEventEnum on the document with an angle key.

features.name: 90° CCW
features.summary: Rotates the canvas a quarter turn counter-clockwise.

automation.notes: Document.rotateCanvas(-90); recorded as rotateEventEnum on the document with an angle key.

features.name: 90° CW
features.summary: Rotates the canvas a quarter turn clockwise.

automation.notes: Document.rotateCanvas(90); recorded as rotateEventEnum on the document with an angle key.

features.name: Arbitrary
features.summary: Rotates the canvas by an entered angle clockwise or counter-clockwise; uses the Ruler tool angle when one is drawn.

automation.notes: Opens a modal dialog; Document.rotateCanvas(angle) takes any angle.

features.name: Ruler tool
features.summary: Measures between two points, showing start X/Y, W, H, angle and length in the options bar and Info panel; Alt/Option-drag makes a protractor, Clear removes the line, and Image Rotation > Arbitrary uses its angle.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType rulerTool); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('rulerTool')) runs the same command. Selected by setting app.currentTool = 'rulerTool' (or the select event with a rulerTool class reference); using the tool on the canvas is interactive.

features.name: Sample a colour from the document
features.summary: Reads the colour of a pixel at a position.

automation.notes: UXP 24.0+: Document.sampleColor(position); in ExtendScript a temporary colour sampler reads the value.

features.name: Select Data Points
features.summary: Chooses which measurements (area, perimeter, circularity, height, width and others) are recorded.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType measurementDataPointsCustom); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('measurementDataPointsCustom')) runs the same command.

features.name: Set Measurement Scale
features.summary: Defines how many pixels equal a logical unit (Default or Custom presets).

automation.notes: Document.measurementScale sets the scale without the dialog. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType measurementScaleCustom); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('measurementScaleCustom')) runs the same command. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType measurementScaleDefault); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('measurementScaleDefault')) runs the same command.

features.name: Straighten
features.summary: Draw a line along a feature that should be level and the crop rotates the image to match.

automation.notes: Document.crop takes an angle, and the crop event an angle key (xtools stdlib.js).

features.name: Trim
features.summary: Removes borders of transparent pixels or of the top-left or bottom-right pixel colour from chosen sides.

automation.notes: Document.trim(type, top, left, bottom, right) trims without the dialog; recorded trim keys trimBasedOn, top, bottom, left, right. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType trim); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('trim')) runs the same command.

domains.name: Artboards
domains.covers: Creating, sizing, arranging and exporting artboards.

features.name: Add artboard with the plus icons
features.summary: Clicking a + icon beside the selected artboard adds an artboard in that direction.

automation.notes: Interactive.

features.name: Artboard appearance preferences
features.summary: Interface preferences for the artboard matte colour and whether artboard borders show.

features.name: Auto-nesting
features.summary: Layers moved onto an artboard become part of it unless locked against auto-nesting.

automation.notes: editArtboardEvent with the autoNestEnabled key (Size-Marks.jsx).

features.name: Prevent auto-nesting into or out of artboards
features.summary: Assigning the lock to an artboard, or to layers inside it, stops layers from being nested into or out of it automatically.

automation.notes: Size-Marks.jsx toggles the related autoNestEnabled key with editArtboardEvent.

features.name: Artboard Background Color
features.summary: Fill shown behind an artboard's layers: White, Black, Transparent or a custom colour.

features.name: Create an artboard document
features.summary: New documents get an artboard when Artboards is selected in the New Document dialog or an artboard preset is chosen.

automation.notes: The make document descriptor takes an artboard boolean key (emptykid/photoshop-script-api).

features.name: Document Type: Artboard
features.summary: Choosing Artboard as the document type in the New dialog offers more than 35 Artboard Size presets.

automation.notes: The make document descriptor takes an artboard boolean key (emptykid/photoshop-script-api).

features.name: Artboard from Group
