features.summary: Turns the selected layer group into an artboard sized to its contents.

automation.notes: Needs a selected group.

features.name: Artboard from Layers
features.summary: Puts the selected layers into a new artboard sized to them.

automation.notes: Needs selected layers.

features.name: Artboard guides
features.summary: Guides dragged onto a selected artboard belong to it, move with it and are copied when it is duplicated.

features.name: Filter the Layers panel by artboard
features.summary: Choosing Artboard in the Layers panel filter restricts the panel to the selected artboard.

features.name: Artboard
features.summary: A special kind of layer group that clips its contents and acts as its own canvas; a document can hold many.

automation.notes: An artboard is a layer group whose layer descriptor has artboardEnabled true; get on the document's artboards property returns the list of artboards (emptykid Layer.ts getArtboardList, isArtboardLayer). Artboards are made and edited with newArtboardEvent and editArtboardEvent (see those features). UXP 22.5+: Document.artboards (read-only list of artboard layers). ExtendScript has no artboard class.

features.name: Lock artboard position
features.summary: The positional lock keeps an artboard fixed on the canvas while its contents remain editable.

features.name: Artboard size presets
features.summary: Device and screen size presets offered by the Artboard tool and the New Artboard dialog.

features.name: Artboard properties
features.summary: Properties panel settings for the selected artboard: size preset, W, H, X, Y and background colour (White, Black, Transparent, Other).

automation.notes: editArtboardEvent (Edit Artboard in the Alchemist list) edits the selected artboard; Size-Marks.jsx uses it with the autoNestEnabled key. Size and background keys are not documented in the sources used.

features.name: Artboard tool
features.summary: Creates, selects, moves and resizes artboards; grouped with the Move tool.

automation.notes: Selected by setting app.currentTool = 'artboardTool' (or the select event with a artboardTool class reference); using the tool on the canvas is interactive.

features.name: Artboard tool options
features.summary: Options bar Size presets for the selected artboard, plus the artboard's properties.

automation.notes: Tool options; interactive.

features.name: Artboards to Files
features.summary: Exports each artboard as a separate file in a chosen format, with prefix, background and artboard-content options.

automation.notes: Runs as a script plug-in identified by this UUID (Artboard to Files in the Alchemist list); parameters are not documented, so it opens its dialog.

features.name: Artboards to PDF
features.summary: Exports artboards to a single or multiple PDF files with encoding, range, background and name options.

automation.notes: Runs as a script plug-in identified by this UUID (Artboard to PDF in the Alchemist list); opens its dialog.

features.name: Clear Selected Artboard Guides
features.summary: Removes guides on the selected artboards.

features.name: Convert to Frame
features.summary: Turns a shape or text layer into a frame with that outline.

features.name: Duplicate artboard
features.summary: Alt/Option-click a + icon to duplicate the selected artboard with its contents and guides.

automation.notes: Duplicating the selected artboard group records duplicate on the layer.

features.name: Edit Frame
features.summary: Changes a frame's size, position or stroke from the Properties panel.

automation.notes: editFramedGroupEvent (Edit Frame) is only a name in the Alchemist event list; its descriptor keys (frame shape, size, stroke) are not documented in any published script, so no tool can set them reliably.

features.name: Export As (artboards)
features.summary: Export As can export each artboard as a separate image with its own size settings.

features.name: Add Frame To Layer Group
features.summary: Places the selected layer group inside a new frame.

features.name: Add Frame to Layers
features.summary: Places the selected layers inside a new frame.

features.name: Frame stroke
features.summary: Adds a stroke around a frame from the Properties panel.

features.name: Frame tool
features.summary: Draws rectangular or elliptical placeholder frames that mask images placed into them.

automation.notes: Selected by setting app.currentTool = 'framedGroupTool' (or the select event with a framedGroupTool class reference); using the tool on the canvas is interactive.

features.name: Move elements between artboards
features.summary: Dragging an element to another artboard keeps its position relative to the artboard's ruler origin and puts it at the top of that artboard's stack.

features.name: Artboard (new)
features.summary: Adds an artboard with a name and a preset or custom size.

automation.notes: newArtboardEvent (New Artboard in the Alchemist list) carries an artboardRect; opens a dialog unless run with dialogs off.

features.name: New Artboard Guides From Shape
features.summary: Adds artboard guides along a selected shape.

features.name: New Frame
features.summary: Creates an empty frame layer by drawing with the Frame tool.

automation.notes: newFramedGroupEvent (New Frame) in the Alchemist list; descriptor not documented. newFramedGroupEvent (New Frame) is only a name in the Alchemist event list; no published script or recording gives its descriptor (the frame's shape and rectangle), so a frame cannot be drawn unattended. Frames from existing layers or groups are made with create_frame; the Frame tool is selected with edit_artboards select_tool.

features.name: Place an image into a frame
features.summary: Drag an image or Adobe Stock asset onto a frame, or place it, and it fills the frame as a Smart Object.

features.name: Rename Artboard
features.summary: Renames the selected artboard; double-clicking its name in the Layers panel does the same.

automation.notes: An artboard is a layer, so set on the target layer with to = layer {name} renames it (emptykid Layer.ts setName; isArtboardLayer shows artboards are layers). The menu item itself starts inline editing. Not run on an artboard by the cited script: unverified.

features.name: Select a frame or its content
features.summary: Click once for the frame, double-click for the image inside, to move or scale them separately.

features.name: Artboard Names
features.summary: Shows or hides artboard names on the canvas.

features.name: Ungroup Artboards
features.summary: Releases the layers from the selected artboards and removes the artboards.

automation.notes: Ungroup on an artboard group; the ungroupLayersEvent stringID is used by published scripts for ungrouping.

domains.name: Layers
domains.covers: Layers and groups: creating, stacking, linking, locking, blending, opacity, fill, merging, flattening, layer comps and the Layers panel.

features.name: Apply Layer Comp
features.summary: Restores the document to the state recorded in the selected comp.

automation.notes: UXP: LayerComp.apply.

features.name: Background from Layer
features.summary: Turns the selected layer into the Background: transparent pixels take the background colour and the layer drops to the bottom.

automation.notes: Renaming a layer to Background does not make it the background; set isBackgroundLayer = true.

features.name: Background layer
features.summary: The locked bottom layer of a document that has no transparency; it cannot be restacked or have its opacity or blend mode changed until converted.

features.name: Blending mode
features.summary: How a layer or group combines with the layers beneath; groups default to Pass Through, and some modes are unavailable for Lab images.

automation.notes: Values are the BlendMode enumeration.

features.name: Bring Forward
features.summary: Moves the selected layer up one position.

automation.notes: Action Manager: move to layer ordinal next.

features.name: Bring to Front
features.summary: Moves the selected layer to the top of its group or of the stack.

automation.notes: move(relativeObject, ElementPlacement). Action Manager: move to layer ordinal front.

features.name: Clear Layer Comp Warning
features.summary: Removes the caution icon a comp shows after layers it recorded were deleted, merged or converted; Clear All Layer Comp Warnings does it for every comp.

features.name: Collapse All Groups
features.summary: Closes every expanded group in the Layers panel.

automation.notes: Event established only by Alchemist's labelled event list.

features.name: Color Decontaminate
features.summary: Replaces background colour in edge pixels with nearby fully selected colours.

automation.notes: Event established only by Alchemist's labelled event list. Listed by help as a matting command.

features.name: Copy CSS
features.summary: Context-menu command that copies CSS for the selected shape or type layer (size, position, colours, gradients, shadow, type settings) to the clipboard; groups produce a parent class.

automation.notes: Does not work on smart objects or on several ungrouped shape or type layers.

features.name: Copy SVG
features.summary: Copies the selected shape layer as SVG markup to the clipboard.

automation.notes: No help page read for it; the name comes from Alchemist's event list and the UI-DNA script.

features.name: Defringe
features.summary: Replaces the colour of fringe pixels on a layer's edges with colours from further inside, over a Width in pixels.

automation.notes: Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Delete Hidden Layers
features.summary: Removes every hidden layer in the document.

automation.notes: delete with null = layer ordinal 'hidden' (hiepndrtbed Public/structFinalize.jsx). DOM fallback: walk Document.layers and remove layers whose visible is false.

features.name: Delete Layer
features.summary: Removes the selected layers or groups, with a confirmation when the panel's Delete icon is clicked.

features.name: Delete Layer Comp
features.summary: Removes the selected comp.

features.name: Deselect Layers
features.summary: Leaves no layer selected.

features.name: Disable layer link
features.summary: Shift-click on a linked layer's link icon suspends the link (a red X) without removing it; Shift-click again restores it.

automation.notes: Events are listed by Alchemist with these labels; descriptors not established.

features.name: Duplicate Layer
features.summary: Copies the selected layer or group, optionally into another open document or a new document chosen in the Document menu of the dialog.

automation.notes: duplicate(relativeObject, insertionLocation) can target another document. Duplicating to a new document is done with 'duplicate' plus make document, or by duplicating the document. UXP: Layer.duplicate / Document.duplicateLayers.

features.name: Duplicate Layer Comp
features.summary: Copies a comp by dragging it to the New Layer Comp button.

automation.notes: UXP: LayerComp.duplicate (24.0). No ExtendScript member.

features.name: Fill
features.summary: Opacity of a layer's pixels, shapes or type without fading its layer effects; not available for groups.

features.name: Filter layers
features.summary: Filter bar at the top of the Layers panel that shows only layers matching a kind, name, effect, mode, attribute, colour, smart object state, selection or artboard; a switch turns filtering on and off.

automation.notes: Panel display state only; no event or object-model member for it was found.

features.name: Find Layers
features.summary: Puts the Layers panel filter into name search so layers can be found by typing.

automation.notes: Event established only by Alchemist's labelled event list; no help page read for it. Menu location (Select menu) not confirmed from a source. Limit: the findLayers event only puts the Layers panel filter into name search for typing, which a script cannot use. set_layer_selection (action find) does the same job unattended by selecting every layer whose name contains the query; findLayers itself is not played.

features.name: Flatten Image
features.summary: Merges all visible layers into the Background, discards hidden layers and fills transparency with white.

automation.notes: UXP: Document.flatten.

features.name: Group from Layers
features.summary: Puts the selected layers into a new named group.

automation.notes: make with null = class layerSection, from = target layers, using = layerSection descriptor with name (Proxyshop layers.py group_layers). The object model has no single member; LayerSets.add plus moving each layer into the set is the DOM fallback. UXP: Document.groupLayers. Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Group Layers
features.summary: Groups the selected layers without a dialog; Shift-click on the New Group button does the same.

automation.notes: Scripts use make layerSection from the target layers; groupLayersEvent is the event Alchemist lists for this command. UXP: Document.groupLayers.

features.name: Isolate Layers
features.summary: Filters the Layers panel to the selected layers only; Remove from Isolation ends it.

automation.notes: Events established only by Alchemist's labelled event list; no help page read for it.

features.name: Last Document State
features.summary: Returns the document to how it was before a comp was applied.

automation.notes: Alchemist labels resetFromComp as Restore Last Document State. ExtendScript has LayerComp.resetFromComp, described only as resetting the comp state to the document state; its exact match with this button is not confirmed. UXP: LayerComp.resetLayerComp.

features.name: Layer Cleanup
features.summary: Layers panel button that deletes empty pixel and type layers and renames layers from their content, for the whole document or the selected layers.

automation.notes: No event or object-model member established for this panel command.

features.name: Layer color
features.summary: Colour tag shown on a layer or group row in the Layers panel, set from the right-click menu or the New Layer dialog.

automation.notes: Not an object-model property. A 'color' enumeration (red, orange, yellowColor, grain, blue, violet, gray, none) appears in make descriptors (hiepndrtbed R_RetouchBG/RetouchBG.jsx); setting it on an existing layer was not established.

features.name: Layer comp
features.summary: A named, commented record of which layer properties to restore: visibility, position, appearance (layer style and blend mode) and smart object layer comp selection.

automation.notes: The smart object comp option is not in the ExtendScript model; UXP LayerComp.childComp and LayerCompCreateOptions.childComp (24.0) cover it.

features.name: Layer Comp Options
features.summary: Edits a comp's name, comment and recorded options.

features.name: Layer Comps
features.summary: Panel of saved layer comps: snapshots of layer visibility, position, appearance and smart object comp choice, with apply, previous/next, update and Last Document State.

automation.notes: UXP: Document.layerComps (LayerComps, LayerComp classes, Photoshop 24.0+).

features.name: Layer from Background
features.summary: Converts the Background into a regular layer that can hold transparency, be restacked and take opacity and blend modes.

automation.notes: Set isBackgroundLayer = false on the background layer. Opens the New Layer dialog in the UI.

features.name: Layer group
features.summary: A folder in the Layers panel that holds layers and nested groups, with its own opacity, blend mode (Pass Through by default), mask and visibility.

automation.notes: UXP: a Layer whose kind is group, with a layers collection.

features.name: Layer
features.summary: A pixel, type, shape, fill, adjustment, smart object or video layer in the stack, carrying name, visibility, opacity, fill, blend mode and locks.

automation.notes: ArtLayer.kind returns the LayerKind (NORMAL, TEXT, SMARTOBJECT, SOLIDFILL, GRADIENTFILL, PATTERNFILL, the adjustment kinds, VIDEO, LAYER3D). UXP: Layer class (document.layers, layer.kind).

features.name: Opacity
features.summary: Overall opacity of a layer or group, affecting its pixels and its layer effects.

automation.notes: Background and locked layers cannot change opacity.

features.name: Layer via Copy
features.summary: Copies the selected pixels (or the whole layer when nothing is selected) onto a new layer; on a smart object it makes an instance that shares contents.

automation.notes: Smart objects and shape layers must be rasterized before a pixel selection can be copied. No object-model member; Selection.copy + Document.paste is the DOM fallback.

features.name: Layer via Cut
features.summary: Cuts the selected pixels to a new layer, leaving transparency (or background colour) behind.

automation.notes: Needs an active selection.

features.name: Layers
features.summary: Panel listing the layer stack, used to select, reorder, show or hide, lock, group, mask and add effects to layers and groups.

automation.notes: Showing or hiding the panel (Window > Layers): Runs as select on menu item charIDToTypeID('Tgly') (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('Tgly')) runs the same command. The stack itself is reached through Document.layers.

features.name: Layers Panel Options
features.summary: Panel-menu dialog for thumbnail size and whether thumbnails show the layer bounds or the entire document.

automation.notes: Opens the Layers Panel Options dialog. Runs as select on menu item charIDToTypeID('LyrP') (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('LyrP')) runs the same command.

features.name: Link Layers
features.summary: Links the selected layers or groups so they stay related (move and transform together) after the selection changes.

automation.notes: UXP: Layer.link.

features.name: Lock All
features.summary: Locks every property of a layer or group; layers inside a locked group show a grey lock.

automation.notes: Action Manager key: layerLocking.protectAll (protectNone unlocks).

features.name: Lock Image Pixels
features.summary: Stops painting tools from changing a layer's pixels.

automation.notes: Action Manager key: layerLocking.protectComposite.

features.name: Lock Layers
features.summary: Applies chosen lock options to all selected layers, or to every layer in a group (Lock All Layers in Group).

automation.notes: applyLocking with target layers and a layerLocking descriptor (Proxyshop layers.py lock_layer). Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Lock Position
features.summary: Stops a layer's pixels from being moved.

automation.notes: Action Manager key: layerLocking.protectPosition.

features.name: Lock Transparent Pixels
features.summary: Confines painting and editing to the opaque parts of a layer; the forward-slash key toggles it.

automation.notes: applyLocking with layerLocking.protectTransparency is the Action Manager equivalent.

features.name: Merge Clipping Mask
features.summary: With the base layer of a clipping mask selected, merges the visible clipped layers into the base.

automation.notes: Available when the base layer is a raster layer. No event established.

features.name: Merge Down
features.summary: Merges the selected layer into the pixel layer directly below it.

automation.notes: The bottom layer must be a pixel layer; adjustment and fill layers cannot be the target.

features.name: Merge Layers
features.summary: Merges all selected layers (pixel or vector) into one layer; on a group it merges the group.

automation.notes: mergeLayersNew with no descriptor merges the selected layers (Proxyshop layers.py merge_layers); LayerSet.merge merges a group. UXP: Layer.merge.

features.name: Merge Visible
features.summary: Merges all visible layers into one and leaves hidden layers alone.

automation.notes: UXP: Document.mergeVisibleLayers.

features.name: New Fill Layer
features.summary: Adds a Solid Color, Gradient or Pattern fill layer (with its own mask) after a New Layer dialog and the fill's settings.

automation.notes: make class contentLayer, using type solidColorLayer (Paul Riggott Picture Processor.jsx), gradientLayer (Proxyshop adjustments.py) or patternLayer (ES-Collection Scale Patterns to 100%.jsx sets one). Opens dialogs unless run with DialogModes.NO. UXP has no fill-layer constructor.

features.name: New Group
features.summary: Adds an empty layer group; the dialog takes Name, Color, Mode and Opacity.

automation.notes: 'make' with class layerSection does the same through Action Manager.

features.name: New Layer
features.summary: Adds an empty layer above the active one (or inside the selected group); the dialog sets Name, Use Previous Layer to Create Clipping Mask, Color, Mode, Opacity and Fill With Mode-Neutral Color.

automation.notes: ArtLayers.add makes a pixel layer without the dialog. The Color label and neutral fill are not object-model properties; 'make' with class layer takes them in its 'using' descriptor. UXP: Document.createLayer / createPixelLayer.

features.name: Create a new layer
features.summary: Layers panel button that adds a layer with default options; Option/Alt-click shows the New Layer dialog and Cmd/Ctrl-click adds the layer below.

features.name: New Layer Comp
features.summary: Saves the current layer state as a comp; the dialog takes Name, Comment and the Visibility, Position, Appearance (Layer Style) and Layer Comp Selection for Smart Objects options.

automation.notes: LayerComps.add(name, comment, appearance, position, visibility). Action Manager: make using compsClass with useVisibility, usePosition, useAppearance, title, comment (retorillo live2d-utils lib.jsx).

features.name: Apply Previous / Next Layer Comp
features.summary: Panel buttons that step through all comps (or the selected ones), applying each in turn.

automation.notes: Script equivalent: apply the comp at the previous or next index.

features.name: Rasterize All Layers
features.summary: Rasterizes every layer in the document that holds vector or generated data.

automation.notes: UXP: Document.rasterizeAllLayers.

features.name: Rasterize Fill Content
features.summary: Rasterizes the fill of a shape layer and keeps its vector mask.

features.name: Rasterize Layer
features.summary: Rasterizes all vector and generated content on the selected layers.

automation.notes: UXP: Layer.rasterize.

features.name: Rasterize Shape
features.summary: Converts a shape layer to pixels.

features.name: Rasterize Type
features.summary: Converts the text on a type layer to pixels, leaving other vector data alone.

features.name: Rasterize Video
features.summary: Rasterizes the current frame of a video layer into an image layer.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "rasterizeVideo" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('rasterizeVideo')) runs the same command. The same menu item is listed under Layer > Video Layers > Rasterize.

features.name: Remove Black Matte
features.summary: Removes dark edge pixels left by anti-aliasing against black.

features.name: Remove White Matte
features.summary: Removes light edge pixels left by anti-aliasing against white.

features.name: Rename Layer
features.summary: Renames the selected layer or group (also by double-clicking its name in the panel).

features.name: Reverse
features.summary: Reverses the stacking order of the selected layers (needs at least two).

features.name: All Layers
features.summary: Selects every layer except the Background.

features.name: Select layer
features.summary: Making a layer active (or several layers selected) by clicking, Shift-clicking or Cmd/Ctrl-clicking in the panel, or with the Move tool's Auto Select.

automation.notes: The object model sets only one active layer; selecting several needs 'select' with selectionModifier addToSelection (Proxyshop layers.py select_layer_add). UXP: Document.activeLayers (read).

features.name: Select Linked Layers
features.summary: Selects every layer linked to the active one.

automation.notes: ArtLayer.linkedLayers / LayerSet.linkedLayers read the linked set without changing the selection.

features.name: Similar Layers
features.summary: Selects all layers of the same kind as the selected one, for example all type layers.

automation.notes: Event established only by Alchemist's labelled event list.

features.name: Send Backward
features.summary: Moves the selected layer down one position.

automation.notes: Action Manager: move to layer ordinal previous (hiepndrtbed RetouchBG.jsx).

features.name: Send to Back
features.summary: Moves the selected layer to the bottom of its group or just above the Background.

features.name: Show / Hide Layers
features.summary: Shows or hides the selected layers; the eye column in the panel does the same per layer, and Option/Alt-click on an eye shows only that layer.

features.name: Stamp selected layers
features.summary: Merges a copy of the selected (or linked) layers into a new layer, leaving the originals intact.

automation.notes: Presumably mergeLayersNew with duplicate = true, but no published script was found that does it.

features.name: Stamp visible
features.summary: Merges a copy of all visible layers into a new layer above the selection, keeping the originals (Option/Alt with Merge Visible).

automation.notes: mergeVisible with duplicate = true (Proxyshop pencilsketch.py; hiepndrtbed Resources.jsx mergeVisible).

features.name: Ungroup Layers
features.summary: Removes the selected group and leaves its layers in place in the stack.

features.name: Unlink Layers
features.summary: Removes the link between the selected layers.

features.name: Update Layer Comp
features.summary: Re-records the selected comp from the current layer state.

automation.notes: UXP: LayerComp.recapture (options to recapture only visibility, position or appearance).

domains.name: Layer styles
domains.covers: Layer effects (drop shadow, strokes, glows, bevel and emboss, overlays) and saved styles.

features.name: Advanced Blending options
features.summary: Checkboxes Blend Interior Effects as Group, Blend Clipped Layers as Group, Transparency Shapes Layer, Layer Mask Hides Effects and Vector Mask Hides Effects.

automation.notes: set on the layer; layerMaskAsGlobalMask is the Layer Mask Hides Effects key (Proxyshop masks.py apply_mask_to_layer_fx). Keys for the other checkboxes not established.

features.name: Contour (Bevel & Emboss)
features.summary: Bevel & Emboss sub-page that shapes the ridges and valleys of the bevel with a contour curve and Range.

automation.notes: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key bevelEmboss (useShape boolean turns it on) (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Bevel & Emboss
features.summary: Highlights and shadows that model depth; Style (Outer Bevel, Inner Bevel, Emboss, Pillow Emboss, Stroke Emboss), Technique (Smooth, Chisel Hard, Chisel Soft), Depth, Direction, Size, Soften, Angle, Altitude, Use Global Light, Gloss Contour, Highlight and Shadow Mode, with Contour and Texture sub-pages.

automation.notes: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key bevelEmboss (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Texture (Bevel & Emboss)
features.summary: Bevel & Emboss sub-page that applies a pattern texture with Scale, Depth, Invert, Link with Layer and Snap to Origin.

automation.notes: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key bevelEmboss (useTexture boolean turns it on) (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Channels (blending)
features.summary: Advanced Blending checkboxes that leave chosen colour channels out of the layer's blending.

automation.notes: set on the target layer with to = layer object carrying channelRestrictions, a list of channel enumerations (red, grain = green, blue) naming the channels that blend; it is read back with executeActionGet on the same key (boogalooper toggle blending options). ExtendScript has LayerSet.enabledChannels for groups only.

features.name: Blend If
features.summary: Advanced Blending sliders (Gray or a single channel) for This Layer and Underlying Layer that drop pixels by brightness; Option/Alt splits a slider for a soft range.

automation.notes: set on the layer with a blendRange list of srcBlackMin/Max, srcWhiteMin/Max, destBlackMin/Max, destWhiteMin/Max (hiepndrtbed HDR/FullAction.jsx).

features.name: Blending Options
features.summary: The General Blending (Blend Mode, Opacity) and Advanced Blending (Fill Opacity, Channels, Knockout, group options, Blend If) page of the Layer Style dialog.

automation.notes: Blend mode, opacity and fill are object-model properties; the advanced options are only reachable with set on the layer (Action Manager).

features.name: Clear Layer Style
features.summary: Removes the whole style from the selected layers.

features.name: Color Overlay
features.summary: Fills the layer content with a colour at a blend mode and opacity.

automation.notes: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key solidFill (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Contour Editor
features.summary: Edits, saves, loads and deletes the curves used by contour options in shadows, glows, bevel, emboss and satin.

features.name: Copy Layer Style
features.summary: Copies the selected layer's style for pasting onto other layers.

features.name: Create Layers
features.summary: Converts the effects of a style into separate image layers (some clipped), after which the style is no longer live.

automation.notes: make class layer using a reference to property layerEffects ('Lefx') of the target layer (ps14features; Moksa1123's sweep plays the same descriptor). May show an alert when some effects cannot be reproduced as layers.

features.name: Delete an effect
features.summary: Dragging one effect from a layer's effect list to the panel's Delete icon removes just that effect.

automation.notes: Event established only by Alchemist's labelled event list; descriptor not established. Limit: the disableSingleFX descriptor is not established, so set_layer_effects removes one effect by erasing its key from the layer's layerEffects descriptor and setting it back (clearing the style with disableLayerStyle when none remain).

features.name: Copy an effect by dragging
features.summary: Option/Alt-dragging one effect, or dragging the Effects bar, from one layer to another in the Layers panel duplicates it there.

automation.notes: Script route: read layerEffects from the source layer and set it on the target (Proxyshop effects.py copy_layer_fx).

features.name: Drop Shadow
features.summary: Shadow behind the layer content; options Blend Mode, Color, Opacity, Angle, Use Global Light, Distance, Spread, Size, Contour, Anti-aliased, Noise and Layer Knocks Out Drop Shadow.

automation.notes: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key dropShadow (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Effect visibility
features.summary: The eye icons on a layer's effect list that show or hide one effect or all effects of that layer.

automation.notes: hide / show with a reference to class layerEffects of the target layer (Proxyshop effects.py set_layer_fx_visibility). The layerFXVisible key reports the state.

features.name: Global Light
features.summary: Sets one lighting angle and altitude used by every effect that has Use Global Light on (drop shadow, inner shadow, bevel).

automation.notes: set on property globalAngle ('gblA') of the target document. With no value and dialogs on, ps14features opens the Global Light dialog; Moksa1123's sweep sets it directly with to = globalLighting object carrying globalLightingAngle and globalAltitude (both #Ang). Scripts also read these keys from the document.

features.name: Gradient Overlay
features.summary: Fills the layer content with a gradient at a blend mode, opacity and angle.

automation.notes: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key gradientFill (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Hide All Effects / Show All Effects
features.summary: Hides or shows every layer style in the document.

automation.notes: The menu command records as set on property layerFXVisible ('lfxv') of the target document, to an lfxv object with layerFXVisible = false (ps14features); true is presumably Show All Effects (not shown in the source). Per layer, hide / show on class layerEffects of the target layer does the same (Moksa1123's sweep for this menu item; see effect_visibility).

features.name: Inner Glow
features.summary: Glow inside the content's edges; adds Source (Center or Edge) and Choke to the Outer Glow options.

automation.notes: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key innerGlow (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Inner Shadow
features.summary: Shadow just inside the content's edges; options Blend Mode, Color, Opacity, Angle, Use Global Light, Distance, Choke, Size, Contour, Anti-aliased and Noise.

automation.notes: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key innerShadow (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Knockout
features.summary: Advanced Blending option (None, Shallow, Deep) that punches the layer through to the first stop point or to the Background, used with lowered Fill.

automation.notes: set on the target layer with to = layer object carrying knockout (enumerated, type knockout); boogalooper's toggle blending options script writes the value none. The stringIDs shallow and deep exist in Adobe's string terminology for the other two choices but no published script was seen setting them.

features.name: Layer Style
features.summary: Dialog that edits a layer's style: a list of effects with checkboxes on the left and the selected effect's options on the right, plus Styles, Blending Options, New Style, Make Default and Reset to Default.

automation.notes: Double-clicking a layer (outside its name and thumbnail) opens it. set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key of each effect (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Layer style
features.summary: The set of effects attached to a layer or group, shown under the fx icon in the Layers panel; effects follow the layer content as it changes.

automation.notes: Read through executeActionGet on the layer's layerEffects key; written with set (Proxyshop effects.py copy_layer_fx / apply_fx). No object-model members.

features.name: Make Default / Reset to Default
features.summary: Layer Style dialog buttons that store the current effect settings as the defaults and restore them later.

features.name: Multiple effect instances
features.summary: The + button beside some effects (drop shadow, inner shadow, stroke, colour and gradient overlay) adds another instance of that effect to one style.

automation.notes: Multiple instances are stored as lists such as dropShadowMulti in layerEffects (UI-DNA Kinase_lib.jsx reads and rewrites dropShadowMulti).

features.name: New Style
features.summary: Saves the selected layer's style as a preset in the Styles panel, with a name and style options.

automation.notes: Opens the New Style dialog for the selected layer's style. Runs as select on menu item charIDToTypeID('SlsN') (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('SlsN')) runs the same command.

features.name: Outer Glow
features.summary: Glow outside the content's edges in a colour or gradient; options Blend Mode, Opacity, Noise, Technique (Softer, Precise), Spread, Size, Contour, Anti-aliased, Range and Jitter.

automation.notes: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key outerGlow (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Paste Layer Style
features.summary: Replaces the styles of the selected layers with the copied style.

features.name: Pattern Overlay
features.summary: Fills the layer content with a pattern; options include Pattern, Angle, Scale, Link with Layer and Snap to Origin.

automation.notes: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key patternFill (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Style display options
features.summary: Panel menu choices Text Only, Small or Large Thumbnail, and Small or Large List for the Styles panel and style pickers.

automation.notes: Each view is a Styles panel menu item run as select on menuItemClass/menuItemType (ps14features): stylesTextView (Text Only), stylesSmallThumbnailView (Small Thumbnail), stylesThumbnailView (Large Thumbnail), stylesSmallTextView (Small List), stylesTextThumbnailView (Large List); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID(id)) runs the same command. Panel display only.

features.name: Rasterize Layer Style
features.summary: Bakes a layer's effects into its pixels.

automation.notes: rasterizeLayer with what = rasterizeItem layerStyle (Proxyshop effects.py rasterize_layer_fx). Menu location not confirmed from a help page.

features.name: Satin
features.summary: Interior shading that gives a satiny finish; options Blend Mode, Color, Opacity, Angle, Distance, Size, Contour, Anti-aliased and Invert.

automation.notes: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key chromeFX (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Save Styles / Load Styles
features.summary: Saves the current presets as a style library file or loads, replaces, appends and resets libraries.

automation.notes: applyStyleFile / saveStyleFile exist in the 2015.5 object model; how they map to the panel's library commands is not documented beyond their names.

features.name: Scale Effects
features.summary: Scales the sizes in a layer's effects by a percentage without scaling the layer.

automation.notes: Descriptor: scale in percentUnit (SimonScript). Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Stroke
features.summary: Outlines the content with a colour, gradient or pattern; Size, Position (Outside, Inside, Center), Blend Mode and Opacity.

automation.notes: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor; the effect is the object under key frameFX (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx; hiepndrtbed Freelance/29-5/replaceLogoChangeText.jsx for bevelEmboss). Layer effects are not in the object model. Opening the Layer Style dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Styles
features.summary: Panel of preset styles grouped in libraries; clicking or dragging a style applies it, Shift adds it to existing effects instead of replacing them.

automation.notes: ArtLayer.applyStyle(styleName) applies a loaded preset by name. Styles cannot be applied to the Background, locked layers or groups.

domains.name: Smart objects
domains.covers: Smart objects, linked smart objects, smart filters and editing their contents.

features.name: Convert for Smart Filters
features.summary: Turns the selected layer into a smart object so filters stay editable as Smart Filters.

automation.notes: Records the same newPlacedLayer event as Convert to Smart Object. Menu location (Filter menu) not confirmed from a page read here. executeAction(stringIDToTypeID("newPlacedLayer")) with no descriptor converts the active layer. The menu item name is taken from the cited ps14features.js.

features.name: Convert to Layers
features.summary: Unpacks a smart object back into its component layers inside a new group.

features.name: Convert to Linked
features.summary: Writes an embedded smart object's source to a file and links to it, keeping transforms and filters.

automation.notes: Pass the destination path in 'using' (SimonScript); otherwise a save dialog opens.

features.name: Convert to Smart Object
features.summary: Bundles the selected layers into one embedded smart object.

features.name: Edit Contents
features.summary: Opens the smart object's source in Photoshop or its native application; saving the source updates the layer.

automation.notes: Opens a new document (PSB for layer-based contents) that becomes the active document; the script must save and close it to update the parent. May show an informational alert. Limit: placedLayerEditContents opens raster or layered contents as a new Photoshop document that later tools can edit, save and close to update the layer; vector contents (Illustrator, PDF) open in their own application and cannot be edited or saved back unattended from Photoshop.

features.name: Embed All Linked
features.summary: Embeds every linked smart object in the document.

features.name: Embed Linked
features.summary: Copies the linked source into the document, turning the layer into an embedded smart object.

features.name: Export Contents
features.summary: Saves an embedded smart object's source in its original placed format, or PSB when it was made from layers.

automation.notes: Pass the destination path in 'null'; otherwise a save dialog opens.

features.name: Filter Layers panel by Smart Object
features.summary: Layers panel filter that shows up-to-date linked, out-of-sync linked, missing linked or embedded smart objects.

automation.notes: Panel display state only.

features.name: Filter mask
features.summary: The mask shared by a smart object's smart filters, with its own density and feather; Shift-click toggles it and Cmd/Ctrl-click loads it as a selection.

automation.notes: Enabling or deleting the filter mask uses filterMaskEnable and the filterMask channel; those descriptors were not established.

features.name: Image stack
features.summary: Aligning similar frames as layers, converting them to one smart object and applying a stack mode to remove noise or moving objects.

automation.notes: Auto-Align Layers sits between selecting and converting (transformations domain). File > Scripts > Load Files into Stack and Statistics automate it.

features.name: Linked Smart Object
features.summary: A smart object whose contents stay in an external file and update when that file changes; missing or out-of-date links are flagged in the Layers panel.

automation.notes: Created with File > Place Linked or Option/Alt-drag. A script places a linked file with placeEvent, null = the file path and linked = true (Moksa1123 menu sweep), or converts an embedded one with placedLayerConvertToLinked. Linked state is read from the layer's smartObject descriptor (linked) with executeActionGet; there is no object-model member.

features.name: New Smart Object via Copy
features.summary: Duplicates a smart object as an independent copy whose contents no longer follow the original (Layer via Copy makes a shared instance instead).

features.name: Package
features.summary: Saves a copy of the document with copies of all linked smart object sources (including audio and video) into a folder.

automation.notes: packageFile with null and to = the destination folder (Moksa1123's sweep, run on a saved document with a linked smart object). Listed in the Alchemist event list as Package File. The document must be saved first.

features.name: Rasterize Smart Object
features.summary: Converts a smart object into an ordinary pixel layer; transforms and filters stop being editable.

automation.notes: rasterizeLayer with what = rasterizeItem placed (hiepndrtbed Public/tootip.jsx). Also under Layer > Rasterize > Smart Object. ArtLayer.rasterize(RasterizeType.ENTIRELAYER) also flattens a smart object.

features.name: Relink to File
features.summary: Points a linked smart object (for example one whose source went missing) at a file on disk.

automation.notes: Pass the file in 'null'. placedLayerReplaceMissing is the variant Photoshop uses for missing links.

features.name: Relink to Library Graphic
features.summary: Points a smart object at a graphic in a Creative Cloud library.

automation.notes: placedLayerRelinkToLibraries exists in Adobe's string terminology but no published script uses it, so its descriptor is unknown. Depends on Creative Cloud Libraries.

features.name: Replace Contents
features.summary: Swaps the smart object's source for another file and keeps scaling, warps and effects.

automation.notes: Pass the file in 'null'; without it a file dialog opens.

features.name: Reset Transform
features.summary: Removes every transform applied to a smart object.

features.name: Resolve Broken Link
features.summary: Relinks a linked smart object whose source file is missing; Photoshop searches the last relative path, the absolute path, a Mac alias and the document folder first.

automation.notes: placedLayerReplaceMissing is the Action Manager variant for missing links (Alchemist labels it Relink to File).

features.name: Smart filter visibility
features.summary: Eye icons that turn one smart filter, or all of a layer's smart filters, off and on.

automation.notes: hide / show with a reference to filterFX by index on the target layer.

features.name: Smart Filters
features.summary: Filters applied to a smart object stay editable as a list under the layer, with a shared filter mask and per-filter blending options.

automation.notes: The filters themselves are applied with the filter events (filters domain) while a smart object is active. Each smart filter is a filterFX entry that hide / show can toggle (hiepndrtbed SHAPE/liquifyWhileProduct.jsx). Applying a filter event to a smart object layer creates a Smart Filter. Editing an existing Smart Filter's settings uses a set event on filterFX (editmamei smartobject fragments), not researched here.

features.name: Smart Object
features.summary: A layer that keeps its source raster or vector content so it can be transformed, filtered and replaced without losing the original data.

automation.notes: Identify with kind == LayerKind.SMARTOBJECT. Pixel edits (painting, cloning) need the layer rasterized first.

features.name: Smart object layer comp
features.summary: Properties panel menu that picks which layer comp of a placed document a smart object displays, without editing its contents.

automation.notes: Event established only by Alchemist's labelled event list; descriptor not established.

features.name: Properties panel (smart object)
features.summary: Shows a smart object's source path, size and position, with Edit Contents, Embed, Convert to Layers and layer comp choices.

automation.notes: Showing the panel (Window > Properties): Runs as select on menu item "togglePropertiesPanel" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('togglePropertiesPanel')) runs the same command. The values it shows are read from the layer's smartObject descriptor with executeActionGet.

features.name: Stack Mode
features.summary: Renders a multi-layer smart object with a statistical stack mode: Entropy, Kurtosis, Maximum, Mean, Median, Minimum, Range, Skewness, Standard Deviation, Summation or Variance; None removes it.

automation.notes: applyImageStackPluginRenderer with imageStackPlugin set to the mode's four-character id, as Adobe's Statistics.jsx does. Modes work per channel on non-transparent pixels. Limit: Stack Mode None (removing a stack mode) has no established event; imageStackConvertSmartObject is listed without a label or descriptor, so set_stack_mode applies modes but does not remove one.

features.name: Update All Modified Content
features.summary: Refreshes every out-of-date linked smart object in the document.

features.name: Update Modified Content
features.summary: Refreshes the selected out-of-date linked smart object from its source.

automation.notes: Only the directly linked file is checked; links nested in other smart objects are not updated.

domains.name: Selection
domains.covers: Selection tools and the Select menu: marquee, lasso, magic wand, object and subject selection, colour range, focus area, modify and transform selection, saving and loading selections.

features.name: Anti-alias
features.summary: Options-bar checkbox (lassos, Elliptical Marquee, Magic Wand) that smooths selection edges by partly selecting edge pixels; it must be set before selecting.

automation.notes: Selection.select takes an antiAlias argument.

features.name: Border
features.summary: Replaces the selection with a band of the given width along its edge.

automation.notes: Needs an active selection. Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO. The help page for Modify > Border was not available to read; the name comes from Adobe's event code table. UXP: Selection.selectBorder.

features.name: Color Range
features.summary: Selects a sampled colour range, a preset colour or tonal range, or skin tones (with Detect Faces); Fuzziness, Localized Color Clusters with Range, Invert, Selection/Image preview, Selection Preview (None, Grayscale, Black Matte, White Matte, Quick Mask), and Save/Load of settings.

automation.notes: Works inside an existing selection if there is one. Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Contract
features.summary: Shrinks the selection inward by 1-100 pixels.

automation.notes: Needs an active selection. Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Delete and Fill Selection
features.summary: Removes the selected object and fills the area with generated surroundings.

automation.notes: Listed here because it acts on a selection; the retouching domain owns the fill. No event established.

features.name: Deselect
features.summary: Drops the current selection.

automation.notes: Action Manager: set channel selection to ordinal none.

features.name: Elliptical Marquee Tool
features.summary: Draws elliptical (Shift for circular) selections, with the same Style options and an Anti-alias option.

automation.notes: Selecting the tool is scriptable (Application.currentTool, or select with the tool class), but dragging on the canvas is interactive; the resulting selection shape can be made directly with set channel selection to an ellipse object with top, left, bottom, right, plus feather and antiAlias (Paul Riggott Create Masks.jsx); UXP Selection.selectEllipse (25.0).

features.name: Expand
features.summary: Grows the selection outward by 1-100 pixels; edges on the canvas boundary are not moved.

automation.notes: Needs an active selection. Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Feather
features.summary: Softens the edge of an existing selection by a Feather Radius; warns when no pixel stays more than half selected.

automation.notes: Needs an active selection. Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Feather (tool option)
features.summary: Options-bar value for marquee and lasso tools that softens the edge of the selection about to be drawn.

automation.notes: Selection.select takes a feather argument.

features.name: Focus Area
features.summary: Selects the in-focus parts of an image with In-Focus Range, add/subtract brushes, Advanced Image Noise Level, Soften Edge and an Output To choice (Selection, Layer Mask, New Layer, New Layer with Layer Mask, New Document, New Document with Layer Mask).

automation.notes: Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO. Descriptor keys not established.

features.name: Grow
features.summary: Adds adjacent pixels within the Magic Wand tolerance to the selection.

automation.notes: Needs an active selection. Not available for Bitmap or 32-bit images.

features.name: Inverse
features.summary: Selects everything that was not selected.

automation.notes: Needs an active selection. UXP: Selection.inverse.

features.name: Lasso Tool
features.summary: Draws freehand selection borders; Option/Alt switches to straight segments while drawing.

automation.notes: Selecting the tool is scriptable (Application.currentTool, or select with the tool class), but dragging on the canvas is interactive; the resulting selection shape can be made directly with Selection.select with a point array (UXP Selection.selectPolygon).

features.name: Load layer transparency as selection
features.summary: Cmd/Ctrl-clicking a layer thumbnail selects its non-transparent pixels (or a mask thumbnail its unmasked area); Shift, Option/Alt and both add, subtract or intersect.

automation.notes: set channel selection to channel transparencyEnum of the layer (Proxyshop selection.py select_layer_pixels).

features.name: Load Selection
features.summary: Loads a selection from a channel or layer transparency of this or another open document, with Invert and New, Add, Subtract or Intersect operations.

automation.notes: Selection.load(channel, combination, inverting). Action Manager: set channel selection to a channel reference (Proxyshop selection.py). UXP: Selection.load.

features.name: Magic Wand Tool
features.summary: Selects areas of similar colour from a click, controlled by Sample Size, Tolerance (0-255), Anti-alias, Contiguous and Sample All Layers.

automation.notes: select on class magicWandTool makes it the active tool (ps14features). A scripted click is set on property selection ('fsel') of class channel with to = point (Hrzn, Vrtc in pixels), tolerance ('Tlrn', integer), antiAlias ('AntA'), contiguous ('Cntg') and merged ('Mrgd', Sample All Layers): editmamei captured the click as this set event and plays it without the tool. Grow and Similar reuse the tool's Tolerance.

features.name: Magnetic Lasso Tool
features.summary: Traces a border that snaps to edges, controlled by Width, Contrast, Frequency and Stylus Pressure; not available for 32-bit images.

automation.notes: Edge snapping happens only while dragging interactively; there is no scripted equivalent.

features.name: Style (Normal, Fixed Ratio, Fixed Size)
features.summary: Marquee option that constrains drawing to a width-to-height ratio or to exact dimensions in pixels or other units.

automation.notes: Only affects interactive drawing; scripts give exact coordinates instead.

features.name: Move selection border
features.summary: Dragging inside a selection with a selection tool in New Selection mode moves only the border; arrow keys nudge it by 1 (Shift: 10) pixels.

features.name: Object Selection Tool
features.summary: Selects objects by hovering (Object Finder) or by a rough Rectangle or Lasso around them, with Sample All Layers and Hard Edge options.

automation.notes: No published script drives the tool's detection; Select Subject (autoCutout) is the scripted whole-image equivalent. Uses on-device or cloud models.

features.name: Polygonal Lasso Tool
features.summary: Draws straight-edged selection borders point by point, with Shift for 45-degree steps.

automation.notes: Selecting the tool is scriptable (Application.currentTool, or select with the tool class), but dragging on the canvas is interactive; the resulting selection shape can be made directly with Selection.select with the polygon's points.

features.name: Quick Selection Tool
features.summary: Paints a selection that grows to follow edges, with brush size, Sample All Layers and Enhance Edge options.

automation.notes: Interactive brushing only.

features.name: Rectangular Marquee Tool
features.summary: Draws rectangular (Shift for square) selections, from the centre with Option/Alt; Style can be Normal, Fixed Ratio or Fixed Size.

automation.notes: Selecting the tool is scriptable (Application.currentTool, or select with the tool class), but dragging on the canvas is interactive; the resulting selection shape can be made directly with Selection.select with four corner points (UXP Selection.selectRectangle).

features.name: Reselect
features.summary: Restores the most recent selection.

automation.notes: set on property selection ('fsel') of class channel, to = ordinal previous ('Prvs') (ps14features; Moksa1123's sweep plays it after a deselect).

features.name: Save Selection
features.summary: Stores the selection in a new or existing alpha channel (or a layer mask), in this or another same-size document; existing channels can be replaced, added to, subtracted from or intersected.

automation.notes: Selection.store(channel, combination). Action Manager records duplicate of the selection channel. UXP: Selection.save / saveTo. Needs an active selection.

features.name: All
features.summary: Selects every pixel of the active layer within the canvas.

automation.notes: Action Manager: set channel selection to ordinal all. UXP: Selection.selectAll.

features.name: Select and Mask
features.summary: Workspace for refining a selection or mask: View Mode (Onion Skin, Marching Ants, Overlay, On Black, On White, Black & White, On Layers), Show Edge, Show Original, High Quality Preview, Real-time Refinement, Color Aware or Object Aware refine mode, Edge Detection (Radius, Smart Radius), Global Refinements (Smooth, Feather, Contrast, Shift Edge), Decontaminate Colors and Output To, with Remember Settings.

automation.notes: smartBrushWorkspace run with DialogModes.NO applies the given refinement (radius, smooth, feather, contrast, shift edge, decontaminate, output) without showing the workspace; refineSelectionEdge is the older Refine Edge event. The brushes are interactive. Needs an active selection.

features.name: Select and Mask tools
features.summary: Tools inside the workspace: Quick Selection, Refine Edge Brush, Brush, Object Selection, Lasso, Polygonal Lasso, Hand and Zoom, plus Select Subject and Refine Hair buttons.

automation.notes: Brush-based refinement is interactive; only the numeric settings are scriptable through smartBrushWorkspace.

features.name: Select people
features.summary: Object Selection option that lists detected people and lets you pick the entire person or parts such as facial skin, hair, beard or eyebrows.

automation.notes: No event established.

features.name: Select Sky
features.summary: Selects the sky in an image in one step; also offered as a Discover panel quick action.

automation.notes: Descriptor: sampleAllLayers (SimonScript). The Select menu location was not confirmed from a help page read here.

features.name: Select Subject
features.summary: Selects the most prominent subjects in the image in one step; also a button in the Object Selection, Quick Selection and Magic Wand options bars and in Select and Mask.

automation.notes: Descriptor: sampleAllLayers. Processing is on device or in the cloud depending on Preferences > Image Processing (cloud option since 23.5; Cloud (Detailed results) also covers Remove Background); cloud mode needs a connection.

features.name: Select Subject processing
features.summary: Image Processing preference that runs Select Subject and Remove Background on the device or in the cloud (detailed results).

automation.notes: Preference; not established as scriptable.

features.name: Selection Brush Tool
features.summary: Paints or circles a selection shown as a coloured overlay, with Add and Subtract brushes and Hardness and Opacity for soft, partial selections.

automation.notes: Brushing is interactive only. Quick Mask editing is the scriptable alternative.

features.name: New / Add / Subtract / Intersect selection
features.summary: Options-bar modes (and Shift, Option/Alt, Shift+Option/Alt modifiers) that decide how a new selection combines with the current one.

automation.notes: SelectionType is the combination argument of Selection.select, load and store.

features.name: Selection
features.summary: The active selection of a document: the pixels that edits, filters and adjustments affect, shown with marching ants.

automation.notes: Document.selection exists even when nothing is selected; reading bounds then throws. UXP: Document.selection (Selection class, 25.0+).

features.name: Selection tools
features.summary: The toolbar's selection tools: marquees, lassos, Selection Brush, Object Selection, Quick Selection and Magic Wand, each with New, Add, Subtract and Intersect modes.

features.name: Similar
features.summary: Adds pixels anywhere in the image within the Magic Wand tolerance.

automation.notes: Needs an active selection. Not available for Bitmap or 32-bit images.

features.name: Single Column Marquee Tool
features.summary: Selects a one-pixel-wide column down the image.

automation.notes: Selecting the tool is scriptable (Application.currentTool, or select with the tool class), but dragging on the canvas is interactive; the resulting selection shape can be made directly with Selection.select with a one-pixel-wide rectangle (UXP Selection.selectColumn).

features.name: Single Row Marquee Tool
features.summary: Selects a one-pixel-high row across the image.

automation.notes: Selecting the tool is scriptable (Application.currentTool, or select with the tool class), but dragging on the canvas is interactive; the resulting selection shape can be made directly with Selection.select with a one-pixel-high rectangle (UXP Selection.selectRow).

features.name: Smooth
features.summary: Cleans stray pixels in and around a colour-based selection using a Sample Radius of 1-100 pixels.

automation.notes: Needs an active selection. Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Transform Selection
features.summary: Scales, rotates or moves the selection border itself without touching pixels.

automation.notes: The help page for Select > Transform Selection was not available to read. Needs an active selection.

domains.name: Masks
domains.covers: Layer masks, vector masks, clipping masks, Quick Mask and Select and Mask.

features.name: Add Layer Mask
features.summary: Layers panel button that adds a mask revealing the layer (or the selection); Option/Alt-click makes a mask that hides it.

automation.notes: make new channel at channel mask using userMaskEnabled revealAll or revealSelection (Proxyshop masks.py create_mask; hiepndrtbed PE/Resources.jsx).

features.name: Apply Layer Mask
features.summary: Permanently removes the hidden pixels and discards the mask; not possible on smart objects.

automation.notes: delete channel mask with apply = true (Proxyshop masks.py apply_mask).

features.name: Clipping mask
features.summary: A stack of successive layers whose visible area is limited to the non-transparent pixels of the bottom (base) layer; clipped layers are indented.

automation.notes: ArtLayer.grouped is true for a layer clipped to the one below. UXP: Layer.isClippingMask.

features.name: Copy or move a mask
features.summary: Dragging a mask to another layer moves it; Option/Alt-drag copies it.

automation.notes: make new channel at the target layer's mask using the source layer's mask (Proxyshop masks.py copy_layer_mask).

features.name: Create Clipping Mask
features.summary: Clips the selected layer to the layer below; Option/Alt-click on the line between two layers does the same.

features.name: Delete Layer Mask
features.summary: Removes the mask without changing the layer's pixels.

automation.notes: delete channel ordinal targetEnum with the mask channel selected (Proxyshop masks.py delete_mask).

features.name: Disable / Enable Layer Mask
features.summary: Turns a layer mask off (red X on its thumbnail) or back on; Shift-click on the thumbnail does the same.

automation.notes: set layer userMaskEnabled true/false (Proxyshop masks.py set_layer_mask).

features.name: Invert mask
features.summary: Reverses the hidden and visible areas of the targeted mask.

automation.notes: Run invert with the mask channel targeted.

features.name: Layer mask
features.summary: A greyscale, resolution-dependent mask on a layer or group: black hides, white shows, grey partly shows; edited with painting and selection tools.

automation.notes: Only density and feather are object-model properties; creating, applying, enabling and linking masks are Action Manager. UXP: Layer.layerMaskDensity / layerMaskFeather.

features.name: Layer Mask Display Options
features.summary: Sets the colour and opacity of the rubylith shown when a layer mask is displayed as an overlay; double-click the mask channel to open it.

features.name: From Transparency
features.summary: Turns the layer's transparency into a mask and fills the hidden pixels with an opaque colour.

automation.notes: make new channel at channel mask using = userMaskEnabled transparency ('UsrM' / 'Trns') (ps14features; Moksa1123's sweep MASK('transparency') builds the same descriptor).

features.name: Hide All
features.summary: Adds a black layer mask that hides the whole layer.

automation.notes: using = userMaskEnabled hideAll (string terminology).

features.name: Hide Selection
features.summary: Adds a layer mask that hides the selected area.

automation.notes: using = userMaskEnabled hideSelection (string terminology). Needs an active selection.

features.name: Reveal All
features.summary: Adds a white layer mask that shows the whole layer.

automation.notes: using = userMaskEnabled revealAll.

features.name: Reveal Selection
features.summary: Adds a layer mask that shows only the selected area.

automation.notes: using = userMaskEnabled revealSelection. Needs an active selection.

features.name: Link / Unlink layer mask
features.summary: The link icon between layer and mask thumbnails; unlinked masks move independently of the layer.

automation.notes: set layer userMaskLinked true/false (hiepndrtbed HDR/jsx/insertSky.jsx).

features.name: Load mask as selection
features.summary: Cmd/Ctrl-clicking a layer or filter mask thumbnail loads its unmasked area as a selection.

automation.notes: set channel selection to channel mask of the layer.

features.name: Mask All Objects
features.summary: Detects every object on the selected layer and creates a masked group for each one.

automation.notes: Also in the Layers panel context and flyout menus. May take minutes on busy layers. No event established.

features.name: Color Range (mask)
features.summary: Properties panel button that refines a layer mask with Color Range.

automation.notes: Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Density
features.summary: Properties panel slider for the opacity of a layer or vector mask.

features.name: Feather (mask)
features.summary: Properties panel slider that softens a layer or vector mask's edges without changing the mask pixels.

features.name: Properties panel (masks)
features.summary: Mask controls for the selected layer: pixel or vector mask, Density, Feather, Select and Mask, Color Range, Invert, load as selection, apply, disable and delete.

automation.notes: The buttons map to the Layer Mask and Vector Mask commands, which are Action Manager.

features.name: Quick Mask Mode
features.summary: Turns the selection into a temporary red overlay (a Quick Mask channel) that is edited with painting tools and turned back into a selection on exit.

automation.notes: Document.quickMaskMode is read/write. Action Manager: set enters and clearEvent leaves, both with a reference to property quickMask of the document (boogalooper SD Helper.jsx). UXP: Document.quickMaskMode.

features.name: Quick Mask Options
features.summary: Chooses whether the overlay colour marks Masked Areas or Selected Areas, and its colour and opacity; double-click the Quick Mask button to open it.

features.name: Rasterize Vector Mask
features.summary: Converts a vector mask into a layer mask; it cannot be turned back into a path.

automation.notes: Action Manager: rasterizeLayer with what = vectorMask (tjx666 mask.jsx).

features.name: Refine mask in Select and Mask
features.summary: Opening Select and Mask from a layer mask to refine its edges and write the result back to the mask.

automation.notes: Output To = layer mask in the smartBrushWorkspace descriptor. Limit: smartBrushWorkspace run with DialogModes.NO applies the global refinements (radius, smart radius, smooth, feather, contrast, shift edge) and writes a new layer mask; the workspace's brush-based Refine Edge and Refine Hair strokes are interactive and not reachable.

features.name: Release Clipping Mask
features.summary: Removes the selected layer and those above it from the clipping mask.

features.name: Target layer mask
features.summary: Making the layer mask (rather than the layer) the editing target, or viewing it alone (Option/Alt-click) or as a rubylith overlay (backslash).

automation.notes: select channel mask with makeVisible (Proxyshop masks.py enter_mask_channel); select channel RGB returns to the layer. The shortcut table lists Ctrl+\ for Windows and \ for Mac.

features.name: Vector mask
features.summary: A resolution-independent path on a layer that clips its content with sharp edges, created with the pen or shape tools.

features.name: Vector Mask Current Path
features.summary: Makes a vector mask from the selected path or work path.

automation.notes: make class path at path vectorMask of the layer using a path reference (Proxyshop masks.py copy_vector_mask uses another layer's vector mask as the source).

features.name: Delete vector mask
features.summary: Removes the vector mask.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "discardVectorMask" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('discardVectorMask')) runs the same command. Without the menu: delete with null = path vectorMask of the target layer (Moksa1123 menu sweep).

features.name: Vector Mask Disable / Enable
features.summary: Turns a vector mask off or on; Shift-click on its thumbnail does the same.

automation.notes: set layer vectorMaskEnabled (Proxyshop masks.py set_layer_vector_mask).

features.name: Vector Mask Hide All
features.summary: Adds a vector mask that hides the whole layer.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "vectorMaskHideAll" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('vectorMaskHideAll')) runs the same command. Without the menu: make class path at path vectorMask using = vectorMaskEnabled hideAll (Moksa1123 menu sweep, VMASK helper).

features.name: Vector Mask Reveal All
features.summary: Adds an empty vector mask that shows the whole layer.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "vectorMaskRevealAll" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('vectorMaskRevealAll')) runs the same command. Without the menu: make class path at path vectorMask using = vectorMaskEnabled revealAll (Moksa1123 menu sweep, VMASK helper).

domains.name: Channels
domains.covers: Colour, alpha and spot channels, the Channels panel, Calculations and Apply Image.

features.name: Alpha channel
features.summary: A saved selection stored as an editable greyscale mask in the Channels panel.

features.name: Apply Image
features.summary: Blends a source image's layer and channel into the active layer and channel: Source, Layer (or Merged), Channel, Invert, Blending (including Add and Subtract with Scale and Offset), Opacity, Preserve Transparency and Mask.

automation.notes: Images must share pixel dimensions. UXP: Layer.applyImage (24.5). Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Calculations
features.summary: Blends two single channels from one or two same-size images (Source 1 and 2 with Layer, Channel and Invert, Blending, Opacity, Mask) and puts the result in a new document, a new channel or a selection.

automation.notes: Recorded as make new channel using a calculation descriptor (source1, source2, invertSource2, calculation, opacity) (SimonScript kanalberechnung.js). Not for composite channels. UXP: Document.calculations (24.5). Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Channel
features.summary: A greyscale plane of the image: a colour channel from the colour mode, an alpha channel holding a mask, or a spot channel for an extra ink; up to 56 per image.

automation.notes: Alpha channels survive only in PSD, PSB, PDF, TIFF and raw formats. UXP: Channel class (23.0+).

features.name: Channel Options
features.summary: Edits an alpha or spot channel's name, Color Indicates (Masked Areas, Selected Areas, Spot Color), colour and opacity or solidity.

features.name: Channels
features.summary: Panel listing the composite, colour, spot and alpha channels with thumbnails, eye icons and buttons to load as selection, save selection, create and delete channels.

features.name: Channels Panel Options
features.summary: Sets the channel thumbnail size or turns thumbnails off.

automation.notes: Opens the Channels Panel Options dialog. Runs as select on menu item charIDToTypeID('ChnP') (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('ChnP')) runs the same command.

features.name: Convert alpha channel to spot channel
features.summary: Choosing Spot Color in an alpha channel's Channel Options turns it into a spot channel.

features.name: Delete Channel
features.summary: Removes a spot or alpha channel (deleting a colour channel converts the image to Multichannel).

automation.notes: UXP: Channel.remove.

features.name: Duplicate Channel
features.summary: Copies a channel within the image, into another open image of the same size or into a new multichannel image, optionally inverted.

automation.notes: Not possible into a Bitmap-mode image. UXP: Channel.duplicate.

features.name: Load channel as selection
features.summary: Cmd/Ctrl-click on a channel, or its Load Selection button, turns the channel into a selection; Shift, Option/Alt and both add, subtract or intersect.

features.name: Merge Channels
features.summary: Combines open, flattened greyscale images of the same size into one RGB, CMYK, Lab or Multichannel image; Mode and channel count are chosen, then the image for each channel.

automation.notes: Needs more than one open greyscale image. No object-model member. Opens a modal dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO.

features.name: Merge Spot Channel
features.summary: Merges a spot channel into the colour channels, splitting the ink into process components.

automation.notes: UXP: Channel.merge.

features.name: New Channel
features.summary: Adds an alpha channel; the dialog sets Name, Color Indicates (Masked Areas, Selected Areas) and the overlay Color and Opacity.

automation.notes: UXP: Document.channels.add.

features.name: New Spot Channel
features.summary: Adds a spot channel (filled with the ink where a selection exists) with an ink Color, often from a colour library, a Name and a Solidity of 0-100%.

automation.notes: Set kind = ChannelType.SPOTCOLOR on a new channel; opacity stands for Solidity.

features.name: Save selection as channel
features.summary: Channels panel button that stores the current selection in a new alpha channel.

automation.notes: Needs an active selection.

features.name: Select channel
features.summary: Making one or more channels the editing target; Cmd/Ctrl+2 selects the composite and Cmd/Ctrl+3, 4, 5 the red, green and blue channels.

automation.notes: Assign an array of channels to Document.activeChannels. Legacy channel shortcuts can be turned back on in Keyboard Shortcuts.

features.name: Show / hide channel
features.summary: Eye column that shows any combination of channels, including an alpha channel over the composite.

features.name: Split Channels
features.summary: Closes a flattened image and opens each channel as its own greyscale document.

automation.notes: Only for flattened images. UXP: Document.splitChannels.

features.name: Spot channel
features.summary: A channel holding an extra premixed ink plate; it overprints the composite in panel order and shows on screen at its Solidity.

automation.notes: Spot colours cannot be applied to individual layers.

domains.name: Colour
domains.covers: Choosing colours: foreground and background, Color and Swatches panels, colour pickers, gradients and patterns as colours.

features.name: Adobe Color Picker
features.summary: Dialog for choosing a colour from a spectrum or by HSB, RGB, Lab, CMYK or hexadecimal values, with gamut and web-safe warnings.

automation.notes: Application.showColorPicker(pickForeground) opens the picker interactively and returns false when cancelled; a script normally assigns SolidColor values instead.

features.name: CMYK
features.summary: Cyan, magenta, yellow and black percentages.

automation.notes: Dialog control.

features.name: CMYK equivalents
features.summary: Out-of-gamut warning triangle that picks the nearest printable colour.

automation.notes: Gamut warning in the dialog; no object-model check for gamut.

features.name: Color Libraries
features.summary: Switches the picker to spot-colour libraries.

automation.notes: Dialog control.

features.name: # (hexadecimal)
features.summary: Six-digit hex field (#).

automation.notes: Dialog control.

features.name: HSB
features.summary: Hue, saturation and brightness fields (H, S, B).

automation.notes: Dialog control.

features.name: Lab
features.summary: Lightness and a, b fields (L, a, b).

automation.notes: Dialog control.

features.name: Only Web Colors
features.summary: Limits the picker to the 216 web-safe colours.

automation.notes: nearestWebColor gives the web-safe colour closest to a SolidColor.

features.name: RGB
