features.summary: Red, green and blue fields (R, G, B).

automation.notes: Dialog control.

features.name: Warning: not a web safe color
features.summary: Cube icon that snaps to the closest web-safe colour.

automation.notes: Dialog control.

features.name: Background color
features.summary: Colour used by gradients, background-layer erasing and canvas extension, shown in the lower toolbar swatch.

features.name: Color Libraries
features.summary: Chooses spot colours from printed colour systems such as PANTONE, TRUMATCH, FOCOLTONE, HKS, ANPA and DIC.

automation.notes: Interactive dialog. A spot colour is created by script as a spot channel (channels domain), not through this dialog.

features.name: ANPA-COLOR
features.summary: Library of colours for newspaper printing.

automation.notes: Colour book in the Color Libraries dialog.

features.name: Book
features.summary: Menu that chooses the colour book.

automation.notes: Colour book in the Color Libraries dialog.

features.name: DIC Color Guide
features.summary: Japanese spot colour library.

automation.notes: Colour book in the Color Libraries dialog.

features.name: FOCOLTONE
features.summary: Process colour system that avoids trapping and registration problems.

automation.notes: Colour book in the Color Libraries dialog.

features.name: HKS
features.summary: German spot colour library.

automation.notes: Colour book in the Color Libraries dialog.

features.name: Pantone + CMYK Coated
features.summary: Pantone book for coated stock.

automation.notes: Colour book in the Color Libraries dialog.

features.name: Pantone + Metallic Coated
features.summary: Pantone metallic colours.

automation.notes: Colour book in the Color Libraries dialog.

features.name: TRUMATCH
features.summary: Predictable CMYK colour matching system.

automation.notes: Colour book in the Color Libraries dialog.

features.name: Color panel

domains.name: Adjustments
domains.covers: Image adjustments and adjustment layers: levels, curves, hue/saturation, colour balance, black and white, photo filter, channel mixer, gradient map and the rest, plus auto tone, colour and contrast.

features.name: Adjust Colors
features.summary: Contextual Task Bar action that targets a sampled colour with a Hue/Saturation adjustment.

features.name: Adjustment Brush tool
features.summary: Paints a non-destructive adjustment onto chosen areas, creating an adjustment layer with a painted mask.

automation.notes: Interactive brush. The resulting adjustment layer and mask can be built by script with make and mask events instead. Tool id adjustmentBrushTool in PsCommandPalette.

features.name: Adjustment layer
features.summary: A layer that applies a colour or tonal adjustment to the layers below it without changing their pixels, editable and maskable at any time.

automation.notes: Created with make (adjustmentLayer class) and changed with set; see each adjustment type. The object model has no adjustment-layer class: ArtLayer.kind reports the type but cannot create one with settings.

features.name: Adjustment Presets
features.summary: Saved stacks of adjustment layers that can be previewed by hovering and applied, saved, renamed, imported and exported.

features.name: Adjustments panel
features.summary: Panel of adjustment-layer buttons and adjustment presets for one-click non-destructive corrections.

features.name: Auto Color
features.summary: Neutralizes midtones and clips black and white points to remove a colour cast.

automation.notes: levels with autoBlackWhite and autoNeutrals true (cited ps14features.js). No dialog. Changes the pixels of the active layer directly; the adjustment-layer form is non-destructive.

features.name: Auto Color Correction Options
features.summary: Chooses the algorithm, target colours and clipping used by Auto in Levels and Curves and by the Auto commands.

automation.notes: Opened from Options in Levels or Curves. Runs as select on menu item "adjustmentAutoOptions" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, from the Adjustments and Levels/Curves Properties panel menus); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('adjustmentAutoOptions')) runs the same command and opens the dialog. The algorithm choices map onto levels event keys (see the option records); target colours, clipping and Save as defaults are not established.

features.name: Enhance Monochromatic Contrast
features.summary: Clips all channels identically, keeping colour relationships.

automation.notes: levels with the boolean AuCo (autoContrast) true applies Auto with this algorithm: the help page names it as the Auto Contrast algorithm and ps14features plays Auto Contrast that way. This applies it once; it does not change the stored default.

features.name: Enhance Per Channel Contrast
features.summary: Maximizes tonal range in each channel separately.

automation.notes: levels with the boolean Auto true applies Auto with this algorithm: the help page names it as the Auto Tone algorithm and ps14features plays Auto Tone that way. This applies it once; it does not change the stored default.

features.name: Find Dark & Light Colors
features.summary: Uses the average darkest and lightest pixels for maximum contrast with minimal clipping.

automation.notes: levels key autoBlackWhite (boolean). ps14features plays Auto Color as levels with autoBlackWhite and autoNeutrals, and the help page names Find Dark & Light Colors with Snap Neutral Midtones as the Auto Color choices; the pairing of autoBlackWhite with this choice is by name. Unverified.

features.name: Save as defaults
features.summary: Makes these the settings Auto uses.

features.name: Snap Neutral Midtones
features.summary: Finds a near-neutral colour and makes it neutral.

automation.notes: levels key autoNeutrals (boolean). ps14features plays Auto Color as levels with autoBlackWhite and autoNeutrals, and the help page names Find Dark & Light Colors with Snap Neutral Midtones as the Auto Color choices; the pairing of autoNeutrals with this choice is by name. Unverified.

features.name: Auto Contrast
features.summary: Adjusts overall contrast by mapping the lightest and darkest pixels to white and black without changing colour casts.

automation.notes: Action Manager form: levels with autoContrast true (cited ps14features.js). No dialog. Changes the pixels of the active layer directly; the adjustment-layer form is non-destructive.

features.name: Auto Tone
features.summary: Sets the darkest and lightest pixels in each channel to black and white and redistributes the tones in between.

automation.notes: ArtLayer.autoLevels is the object-model equivalent (Auto Tone was once called Auto Levels). The Action Manager form is levels with the boolean auto set (cited ps14features.js). No dialog. Changes the pixels of the active layer directly; the adjustment-layer form is non-destructive.

features.name: Black & White
features.summary: Converts colour to grayscale with control over how each colour range converts, with an optional tint.

automation.notes: blackAndWhite is the Action Manager event; Opens its dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO. Changes the pixels of the active layer directly; the adjustment-layer form is non-destructive.

features.name: Black & White adjustment layer
features.summary: Non-destructive Black & White adjustment held on its own layer.

automation.notes: make with a null reference to the adjustmentLayer class and using.type set to a blackAndWhite descriptor creates the layer (editmamei capture, Photoshop 27.7); a following set event on the adjustment layer applies the values.

features.name: Auto
features.summary: Sets a conversion based on the image colours.

automation.notes: The Auto button in the Black & White dialog and Properties panel computes slider values from the image inside the dialog; recordings capture only the resulting slider values, and no descriptor key asks Photoshop to compute them.

features.name: Color sliders
features.summary: Reds, Yellows, Greens, Cyans, Blues and Magentas: how light each colour range becomes.

automation.notes: Keys red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta.

features.name: Preset
features.summary: Saved conversion settings.

automation.notes: Key presetKind. Same as Hue/Saturation: the blackAndWhite descriptor's preset file reference is not shown in any cited recording; the six colour sliders and tint (what a preset sets) are written explicitly instead.

features.name: Tint
features.summary: Applies a colour tone to the grayscale result.

automation.notes: Keys useTint and tintColor.

features.name: Brightness/Contrast
features.summary: Simple adjustment of the tonal range: brightness shifts tones, contrast expands or compresses them.

automation.notes: ArtLayer.adjustBrightnessContrast applies it without a dialog. brightnessEvent is the Action Manager event; Opens its dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO. Changes the pixels of the active layer directly; the adjustment-layer form is non-destructive.

features.name: Brightness/Contrast adjustment layer
features.summary: Non-destructive Brightness/Contrast adjustment held on its own layer.

automation.notes: make with a null reference to the adjustmentLayer class and using.type set to a brightnessContrast descriptor creates the layer (editmamei capture, Photoshop 27.7); a following set event on the adjustment layer applies the values.

features.name: Brightness
features.summary: Shifts tonal values, from -150 to +150.

features.name: Contrast
features.summary: Expands or shrinks the tonal range, from -50 to +100.

features.name: Use Legacy
features.summary: Shifts all pixel values linearly, as in older versions, instead of proportionally.

automation.notes: Key useLegacy.

features.name: Channel Mixer
features.summary: Builds each output channel from a mix of the existing channels, for creative colour or custom grayscale.

automation.notes: ArtLayer.mixChannels applies it without a dialog. channelMixer is the Action Manager event; Opens its dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO. Changes the pixels of the active layer directly; the adjustment-layer form is non-destructive.

features.name: Channel Mixer adjustment layer
features.summary: Non-destructive Channel Mixer adjustment held on its own layer.

automation.notes: make with a null reference to the adjustmentLayer class and using.type set to a channelMixer descriptor creates the layer (editmamei capture, Photoshop 27.7); a following set event on the adjustment layer applies the values.

features.name: Monochrome
features.summary: Produces a grayscale result from the channel mix.

features.name: Clarity and Dehaze adjustment layer
features.summary: Adjustment layer that adds midtone contrast (Clarity) and removes or adds atmospheric haze (Dehaze).

automation.notes: make with a null reference to adjustmentLayer and using.type the class clarity (cited AdjustmentLayerPanel.jsx, which creates it with DialogModes.NO). Keys for the Clarity and Dehaze values are not established.

features.name: Clarity
features.summary: Adjusts local midtone contrast.

automation.notes: Key clarity (integer) in the clarity adjustment descriptor of the layer, read with executeActionGet in the cited script; writing it with set on the adjustment layer is not shown. Unverified.

features.name: Dehaze
features.summary: Reduces or adds haze.

automation.notes: Key dehaze (integer) in the clarity adjustment descriptor of the layer, read with executeActionGet in the cited script; writing it with set on the adjustment layer is not shown. Unverified.

features.name: Color and Vibrance adjustment layer
features.summary: Adjustment layer that changes white balance and colour intensity with Temperature, Tint, Vibrance and Saturation.

automation.notes: The layer's adjustment class is vibrance: a test fixture (repository without a licence) lists a "Color and vibrance" layer of type vibrance, and the cited GPL script reads vibrance, saturation, temperature, tint and useLegacy from that descriptor. make with a null reference to adjustmentLayer and using.type the class vibrance creates a vibrance adjustment layer; set on the adjustment layer with a vibrance object applies the values. Whether make gives the Color and Vibrance form rather than the legacy Vibrance one is not established; unverified.

features.name: Saturation
features.summary: Changes all colours equally.

automation.notes: Key Strt (saturation) in the vibrance adjustment descriptor of the layer, written with set on the adjustment layer (integer) in the cited script. Unverified.

features.name: Temperature
features.summary: Warms or cools the colours.

automation.notes: Key temperature in the vibrance adjustment descriptor of the layer (read with executeActionGet in the cited script; writing it with set is not shown). Unverified.

features.name: Tint
features.summary: Shifts colours toward green or magenta.

automation.notes: Key tint in the vibrance adjustment descriptor of the layer (read with executeActionGet in the cited script; writing it with set is not shown). Unverified.

features.name: Vibrance
features.summary: Boosts muted colours more than saturated ones.

automation.notes: Key vibrance in the vibrance adjustment descriptor of the layer, written with set on the adjustment layer (integer) in the cited script. Unverified.

features.name: Color Balance
features.summary: Shifts the colour mix in shadows, midtones or highlights to correct casts.

automation.notes: ArtLayer.adjustColorBalance applies it without a dialog. colorBalance is the Action Manager event; Opens its dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO. Changes the pixels of the active layer directly; the adjustment-layer form is non-destructive.

features.name: Color Balance adjustment layer
features.summary: Non-destructive Color Balance adjustment held on its own layer.

automation.notes: make with a null reference to the adjustmentLayer class and using.type set to a colorBalance descriptor creates the layer (editmamei capture, Photoshop 27.7); a following set event on the adjustment layer applies the values.

features.name: Cyan/Red, Magenta/Green, Yellow/Blue

features.summary: Keeps luminosity unchanged while colours shift.

features.summary: Which tonal range to change: Shadows, Midtones or Highlights.

features.name: Color Lookup
features.summary: Remaps colours through a lookup table (3D LUT, abstract or device link profile) for film looks and grading.

automation.notes: colorLookup is the Action Manager event; Opens its dialog unless run with DialogModes.NO. Changes the pixels of the active layer directly; the adjustment-layer form is non-destructive. The colorLookup event needs the profile key: binary data Photoshop parses from the LUT file inside the Color Lookup dialog. A script cannot produce it, and passing only the file name and raw LUT3DFileData is unverified. create_adjustment_layer makes an empty Color Lookup layer whose LUT is then chosen in the Properties panel.

features.name: Color Lookup adjustment layer
features.summary: Non-destructive Color Lookup adjustment held on its own layer.

automation.notes: Key lookupType. Loading a 3DLUT file sets lookupType 3DLUT together with the parsed profile binary, which only the Color Lookup dialog or Properties panel produces; see photoshop.adjustments.color_lookup.

features.name: Art History Brush tool

automation.notes: Setting app.currentTool = "artBrushTool" (tool id from PsCommandPalette, which activates it with a select event on that tool class) makes it the active tool; painting on the canvas stays interactive. A script paints with it along a path through the stroke event: null references the target path and using is the tool class stringID "artBrushTool" (editmamei, live-verified on Photoshop 2026). PathItem.strokePath(ToolType.ARTHISTORYBRUSH) is the object-model alternative, but the editmamei authors report it leaves only a 1-pixel line. Tool options are read and written as currentToolOptions on the application with get and set (editmamei brush fragments: opacity, flow, brush.hardness).

automation.notes: Setting app.currentTool = "paintbrushTool" (tool id from PsCommandPalette, which activates it with a select event on that tool class) makes it the active tool; painting on the canvas stays interactive. A script paints with it along a path through the stroke event: null references the target path and using is the tool class stringID "paintbrushTool" (editmamei, live-verified on Photoshop 2026). PathItem.strokePath(ToolType.BRUSH) is the object-model alternative, but the editmamei authors report it leaves only a 1-pixel line. Tool options are read and written as currentToolOptions on the application with get and set (editmamei brush fragments: opacity, flow, brush.hardness).

features.name: Adjust for Zoom

automation.notes: currentToolOptions key smoothingZoomCompensation (boolean) in photoshop-types (typings of the currentToolOptions descriptor); photocraft maps it to Adjust for Zoom. Written with set on the tool class (target e.g. paintbrushTool, to = the currentToolOptions descriptor) after reading currentToolOptions with get on the application (intechstudio package-photoshop, Aya-Image-Edit).

ToolType has no Mixer Brush entry; the stroke event with using = wetBrushTool is not confirmed by our sources. Only making the tool active (app.currentTool = "wetBrushTool") and setting its options is scriptable. Painting with it needs a person on the canvas: ToolType has no Mixer Brush entry, so PathItem.strokePath cannot use it, and no source shows the stroke event accepting wetBrushTool as its tool. adobe-mcp-photoshop's set_tool_options can make it active; it does not claim the feature.

Taken from Adobe's own Lens Correct.jsx (File > Automate > Lens Correction), which plays the same $LnCr event and lists its keys; read from an unlicensed mirror, facts only. Keys left out keep the plug-in's defaults.

domains.name: Camera Raw and neural filters

features.name: Adobe Camera Raw
features.summary: Plug-in for developing raw, JPEG and TIFF photos non-destructively before they open in Photoshop, and as a filter on layers.

automation.notes: Application.open with CameraRAWOpenOptions opens a raw file with chosen settings and no dialog (DialogModes.NO); those options cover the older Camera Raw controls only. For layers, the Camera Raw Filter event applies settings (filters domain).

features.name: Camera Raw Filter settings

automation.notes: Keys are charIDs inside the descriptor, with a required version handshake (CrVe, PrVN, PrVe); the cited capture models WBal, Ex12, ShpR and PCVS and reports 91 keys in all. Re-editing uses set on filterFX with the full prior state.

features.name: Camera Raw open settings
