automation.notes: TextItem.font takes a PostScript name; Application.fonts lists installed fonts.

features.name: Installed fonts
features.summary: The fonts available to Photoshop, each with family, style and PostScript name.

features.name: Font search and filters
features.summary: Filters the font menu by classification, Adobe Fonts, favorites (starred) or visual similarity, and searches by name.

automation.notes: Interface feature of the font menu; scripts address fonts by PostScript name instead.

features.name: Font size
features.summary: Sets type size, in points by default or in any unit typed after the value.

automation.notes: Unit follows Preferences.typeUnits.

features.name: Fractional Widths / System Layout
features.summary: Spaces characters by fractional pixels, or in whole pixels for small screen type.

automation.notes: Character panel menu commands; not in the object model and not established for Action Manager.

features.name: Glyphs panel
features.summary: Browses every glyph of a font by category and inserts one at the insertion point with a double-click.

automation.notes: Also Type > Panels > Glyphs Panel. Browsing glyphs is interactive; inserting a glyph by script means setting TextItem.contents with the character.

features.name: Horizontal scale
features.summary: Stretches characters horizontally as a percentage.

features.name: Horizontal Type Mask Tool
features.summary: Types a selection border in the shape of horizontal text on the active layer.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "typeCreateMaskTool" (used by boogalooper and photoshop-python-api) or with the select event on that tool class. Entering and committing text is interactive; create type layers through the object model instead.

features.name: Horizontal Type Tool
features.summary: Adds or edits horizontal point or paragraph text on a new type layer.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "typeCreateOrEditTool" (used by boogalooper and photoshop-python-api) or with the select event on that tool class. Entering and committing text is interactive; create type layers through the object model instead.

features.name: Hyphenate
features.summary: Turns automatic hyphenation on or off for the paragraph.

features.name: Hyphenation dialog
features.summary: Sets minimum word length, letters before and after a break, hyphen limit, hyphenation zone and capitalized words.

automation.notes: Paragraph panel menu > Hyphenation. Hyphenation Zone applies only with the Single-line Composer.

features.name: Indent First Line
features.summary: Indents the first line relative to the left indent; negative values hang it.

features.name: Indent Left Margin
features.summary: Indents the paragraph from the left (top for vertical type).

features.name: Indent Right Margin
features.summary: Indents the paragraph from the right (bottom for vertical type).

features.name: Insert emoji
features.summary: Adds emoji from the Glyphs panel (Noto Color Emoji SVG), the macOS Character Viewer or the Windows emoji keyboard.

automation.notes: Scripts can set contents to the emoji characters with an emoji font; the pickers are interactive.

features.name: Justification dialog (word, letter and glyph spacing)
features.summary: Sets minimum, desired and maximum word spacing, letter spacing and glyph scaling, and the auto-leading percentage.

automation.notes: Paragraph panel menu > Justification.

features.name: Kerning (Metrics, Optical, manual)
features.summary: Adjusts space between a pair of characters automatically from font data or shapes, or by a manual value.

automation.notes: Manual kern values for individual pairs have no object-model member.

features.name: Kinsoku line-breaking (Push In First, Push Out First, Push Out Only)
features.summary: Chooses how prohibited characters are moved to satisfy kinsoku.

automation.notes: Shown when Show Asian Text Options is on; no TextItem member and no published Action Manager example.

features.name: Kinsoku Shori
features.summary: Chooses JIS Weak or Maximum rules for characters that may not start or end a line.

automation.notes: Shown when Show Asian Text Options is on; no TextItem member and no published Action Manager example.

features.name: Language (hyphenation and spelling dictionary)
features.summary: Assigns the dictionary used for hyphenation and spell checking.

automation.notes: Language enum lists the languages the object model knows.

features.name: Leading
features.summary: Sets the distance between baselines of lines.

automation.notes: Auto leading percentage is set from the Justification dialog (TextItem.autoLeadingAmount).

features.name: Load Default Type Styles
features.summary: Applies the saved default character and paragraph styles to the current document.

features.name: Manage Missing Fonts
features.summary: Chooses, per missing non-Adobe font, to replace it with the default font, a font already used in the document, or nothing.

automation.notes: Modal dialog; no event or member established. Missing Adobe Fonts are activated automatically when online.

features.name: Match Font
features.summary: Finds installed or Adobe Fonts faces that resemble text inside a marquee selection of an image.

automation.notes: Needs a rectangular selection around the sample text; interactive dialog; works for Roman/Latin and Japanese only. Option Show Fonts Available To Activate From Adobe Fonts depends on cloud access.

features.name: Enable Missing Glyph Protection
features.summary: Substitutes a suitable font when non-Roman text is typed in a Roman font that lacks the glyphs.

automation.notes: Type preference not in the object model.

features.name: Mojikumi
features.summary: Chooses a JIS X 4051 spacing set for Japanese text composition.

automation.notes: Shown when Show Asian Text Options is on; no TextItem member and no published Action Manager example.

features.name: Character alignment (mojisoroe)
features.summary: Aligns small characters to the Roman baseline, em box or ICF of large characters.

automation.notes: Shown when Show Asian Text Options is on; no TextItem member and no published Action Manager example.

features.name: More fonts (Adobe Fonts browser)
features.summary: Browses the Adobe Fonts library from the font menu, previews on canvas and activates fonts.

automation.notes: Requires Creative Cloud sign-in and network access; interactive.

features.name: Move or flip type along a path
features.summary: Drags path type along its path, or across it to flip it to the other side, with a path selection tool.

automation.notes: Interactive drag only; baseline shift (TextItem.baselineShift) moves type off the path without flipping it.

features.name: New / edit character style
features.summary: Creates a character style from selected text or edits one in the Character Style Options dialog.

automation.notes: Panel and dialog only, as far as the sources show.

features.name: New / edit paragraph style
features.summary: Creates a paragraph style from selected text or edits one in the Paragraph Style Options dialog.

automation.notes: Panel and dialog only, as far as the sources show.

features.name: No Break
features.summary: Keeps selected characters from breaking at a line end.

features.name: On-canvas glyph alternates
features.summary: Shows alternates for a selected character in a small on-canvas grid (Preferences > Type > Enable Type Layer Glyph Alternates).

automation.notes: Preference not in the object model's Preferences.

features.name: OpenType: Contextual Alternates
features.summary: Swaps in alternate letterforms that join better in script faces.

automation.notes: Character panel menu > OpenType; no TextItem member and no published Action Manager example.

features.name: OpenType: Discretionary Ligatures
features.summary: Uses optional ligatures such as ct and st.

features.name: OpenType fonts
features.summary: Cross-platform font format that can carry ligatures, alternates and wide character sets.

automation.notes: Font format, not an operation.

features.name: OpenType: Fractions
features.summary: Turns numbers separated by a slash into fraction glyphs.

automation.notes: Set in the textStyle of a textStyleRange: play set on the target textLayer with to = the layer's text descriptor carrying the changed textStyleRange list (xtools Text.jsx), or pass it when making the textLayer. Key fractions (boolean) (photocraft-corpus opentype-fractions case, xtools Text.jsx). No TextItem member. Unverified.

features.name: OpenType: Old Style figures
features.summary: Uses shorter old-style numerals that can descend below the baseline.

features.name: OpenType: Ordinals
features.summary: Sets ordinal suffixes such as 1st as superscript.

automation.notes: Set in the textStyle of a textStyleRange: play set on the target textLayer with to = the layer's text descriptor carrying the changed textStyleRange list (xtools Text.jsx), or pass it when making the textLayer. Key ordinals (boolean) (photocraft-corpus opentype-ordinals case, xtools Text.jsx). No TextItem member. Unverified.

features.name: OpenType: Ornaments
features.summary: Uses the font's ornament glyphs.

automation.notes: Set in the textStyle of a textStyleRange: play set on the target textLayer with to = the layer's text descriptor carrying the changed textStyleRange list (xtools Text.jsx), or pass it when making the textLayer. Key ornaments (boolean) (xtools Text.jsx, jamText). No TextItem member. Unverified.

features.name: OpenType: Standard Ligatures
features.summary: Replaces pairs such as fi and fl with ligature glyphs.

features.name: OpenType: Stylistic Alternates
features.summary: Uses purely decorative alternate characters.

automation.notes: Set in the textStyle of a textStyleRange: play set on the target textLayer with to = the layer's text descriptor carrying the changed textStyleRange list (xtools Text.jsx), or pass it when making the textLayer. Key stylisticAlternates (boolean) (xtools Text.jsx, jamText). No TextItem member. Unverified.

features.name: OpenType SVG fonts and emoji
features.summary: Color fonts with multiple colors and gradients per glyph, including emoji composites such as flags and skin-tone variants.

automation.notes: Font format. Glyph colors cannot be changed; warp or Convert to Shape drop the color (help). Noto Color Emoji SVG replaced EmojiOne in the bundled fonts.

features.name: OpenType: Swash
features.summary: Uses swash glyphs with extended flourishes.

automation.notes: Set in the textStyle of a textStyleRange: play set on the target textLayer with to = the layer's text descriptor carrying the changed textStyleRange list (xtools Text.jsx), or pass it when making the textLayer. Key swash (boolean) (xtools Text.jsx, jamText). No TextItem member. Unverified.

features.name: OpenType: Titling Alternates
features.summary: Uses capitals designed for large display sizes.

automation.notes: Set in the textStyle of a textStyleRange: play set on the target textLayer with to = the layer's text descriptor carrying the changed textStyleRange list (xtools Text.jsx), or pass it when making the textLayer. Key titling (boolean) (xtools Text.jsx, jamText). No TextItem member. Unverified.

features.name: Paragraph alignment
features.summary: Aligns paragraph text left, center or right (top, center or bottom for vertical type).

features.name: Justification (Justify Last Left/Centered/Right, Justify All)
features.summary: Justifies lines to both edges, with the last line aligned or forced.

features.name: Paragraph panel
features.summary: Panel for alignment, justification, indents, spacing, hyphenation and composer of paragraphs.

automation.notes: Also under Type > Panels. Opening or closing the panel: Runs as select on menu item "toggleParagraphPalette" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: Paragraph styles
features.summary: Named sets of character and paragraph attributes applied to whole paragraphs; Basic Paragraph is the default.

automation.notes: The ExtendScript object model has no style objects. UXP TextItem exposes characterStyle/paragraphStyle objects for the text's formatting, not named styles. Named style creation by Action Manager was not found in published scripts.

features.name: Paragraph Styles panel
features.summary: Panel listing paragraph styles; every document starts with Basic Paragraph.

automation.notes: Also under Type > Panels. Opening or closing the panel: Runs as select on menu item "toggleParagraphStylesPalette" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: Paragraph type
features.summary: Text that wraps inside a bounding box you drag or size numerically.

automation.notes: Alt/Option-click with a type tool opens the Paragraph Text Size dialog (help).

features.name: Paste Lorem Ipsum
features.summary: Fills the active text insertion point or box with placeholder text.

automation.notes: Needs a type tool in edit mode, so the menu command is interactive. Setting TextItem.contents to any string is the scripted equivalent.

features.name: Fill new type layers with placeholder text
features.summary: Type preference that pre-fills new type layers with sample text.

automation.notes: Not in the object model.

features.name: Point type
features.summary: A line of text that starts at a click point and grows without wrapping.

features.name: Replace All Missing Fonts
features.summary: Substitutes the default font for every missing font in the document.

automation.notes: Menu item in Photoshop CC 14 (ps14features). Current versions offer Manage Missing Fonts, whose dialog has a Replace All Missing Fonts With the Default Font option.

features.name: Roman Hanging Punctuation
features.summary: Hangs quotes, commas, periods, hyphens and dashes outside the margins.

automation.notes: The member name is spelled hangingPuntuation in the object model.

features.name: Save Default Type Styles
features.summary: Stores the current character and paragraph styles as defaults for new documents.

features.name: Add Space After Paragraph
features.summary: Adds space below the paragraph.

features.name: Add Space Before Paragraph
features.summary: Adds space above the paragraph.

features.name: Standard Vertical Roman Alignment
features.summary: Rotates Roman characters upright in vertical type.

automation.notes: Character panel menu option; not established for scripting.

features.name: Strikethrough
features.summary: Draws a line through the characters.

features.name: Superscript / Subscript
features.summary: Sets reduced-size characters raised or lowered from the baseline.

automation.notes: Set in the textStyle of a textStyleRange: play set on the target textLayer with to = the layer's text descriptor carrying the changed textStyleRange list (xtools Text.jsx), or pass it when making the textLayer. Key baseline (enumerated, type baseline): superScript or subScript; normal turns it off (photocraft-corpus super-subscript case; xtools Text.jsx; Adobe's TextAuto sample). No TextItem member. Unverified.

features.name: Tate-chu-yoko
features.summary: Sets a short run of horizontal characters inside vertical text.

automation.notes: Shown when Show Asian Text Options is on; no TextItem member and no published Action Manager example.

features.name: Text color
features.summary: Sets the color of type; individual characters can differ.

automation.notes: TextItem.color applies to the whole layer; per-character color needs textStyleRange descriptors.

features.name: Add a drop shadow to text
features.summary: Applies the Drop Shadow layer style to a type layer.

automation.notes: Same as the Drop Shadow layer style applied to a type layer: set with null = property layerEffects of the target layer and to = a layerEffects descriptor holding dropShadow (Proxyshop effects.py apply_fx). No TextItem member.

features.name: Text Effects actions
features.summary: Default action set of ready-made type effects loaded from the Actions panel menu.

automation.notes: Load the set, then play an action with Application.doAction.

features.name: Text orientation (Horizontal / Vertical)
features.summary: Switches a type layer between horizontal lines and vertical lines.

automation.notes: Also the Text Orientation button in the options bar, Layer > Type > Horizontal/Vertical and Change Text Orientation in the Character panel menu.

features.name: Tracking
features.summary: Loosens or tightens spacing across selected characters, in 1/1000 em.

features.name: Resize or transform a type bounding box
features.summary: Resizes, rotates or skews a paragraph text box, or scales the text with it by Ctrl/Cmd-dragging a handle.

automation.notes: TextItem.width/height set the paragraph box; ArtLayer.resize/rotate scale or rotate the whole layer.

features.name: Tsume
features.summary: Tightens the space around Asian characters by a percentage.

automation.notes: Set in the textStyle of a textStyleRange: play set on the target textLayer with to = the layer's text descriptor carrying the changed textStyleRange list (xtools Text.jsx), or pass it when making the textLayer. Key mojiZume (double, the tsume amount) in the textStyle (Adobe's TextAuto sample, xtools Text.jsx, jamText). Shown when Show Asian Text Options is on. No TextItem member. Unverified.

features.name: Type formatting shortcuts
features.summary: Shortcuts to align, set 100% scale, auto leading, zero tracking, justify, toggle hyphenation and composer, and nudge size, leading, baseline shift and kerning.

automation.notes: Keyboard shortcuts only; each target property has its own record and DOM member.

features.name: Type inside a closed path
features.summary: Paragraph text that fills the inside of a closed path, breaking lines at the path boundary.

automation.notes: Not established for scripting.

features.name: Type layer
features.summary: A layer holding live, editable vector text; it is created whenever you type with a type tool.

automation.notes: Set ArtLayer.kind = LayerKind.TEXT on a new art layer, then fill TextItem. The make event with a textLayer class and textKey/textShape/textStyleRange creates one in a single step (Adobe UXP sample). Type layers are not created in Multichannel, Bitmap or Indexed Color documents (help).

features.name: Type layer Properties panel
features.summary: Properties panel view of a type layer with character, paragraph, bullets and advanced script options.

automation.notes: Showing the panel: Runs as select on menu item "togglePropertiesPanel" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('togglePropertiesPanel')) runs the same command. Its settings map to the TextItem members and textStyle keys recorded separately.

features.name: Type on a path
features.summary: Text that flows along an open or closed work path or shape outline in the direction the points were drawn.

automation.notes: make textLayer whose textShape has char onACurve and a path object (class pathClass with pathComponents), with textKey and textStyleRange as for point text (photocraft-corpus generate.jsx makeText). jamText also types the path-type keys pathTypeEffect, pathTypeAlignment, pathTypeAlignTo, pathTypeSpacing and flip. TextType in the object model has only point and paragraph text. Unverified.

features.name: Type selection border
features.summary: Uses a type mask tool to produce a selection shaped like the typed text instead of a type layer.

automation.notes: The mask tools are interactive. Not established how to produce the selection by script.

features.name: Type 1 (PostScript) font support removed
features.summary: Photoshop 23.0 and later no longer list or use Type 1 fonts; documents using them treat those fonts as missing.

automation.notes: Removed capability, recorded for completeness.

features.name: Underline (and Underline Left/Right for vertical type)
features.summary: Draws a line under horizontal type or beside vertical type.

features.name: Unified Text Engine
features.summary: Single text composer (since 23.0) that shapes Latin, Indic, Middle Eastern, South East Asian and CJK scripts without switching layout options.

automation.notes: Engine behaviour, not a command.

features.name: Unwarp text
features.summary: Removes a warp by setting the Warp Text style to None.

features.name: Update All Text Layers
features.summary: Re-renders type layers, converting bitmap type from older versions to vector type.

features.name: Update text layers for vector-based output
features.summary: On opening a document with CJK text rendered differently, Photoshop offers to update the layers so they output as vectors.

automation.notes: The prompt appears on open; afterwards Type > Update All Text Layers (updateLayouts) performs the update. The prompt itself is interactive.

features.name: OpenType variable fonts
features.summary: Fonts whose weight, width, slant or optical size are adjusted with sliders in the Properties panel.

automation.notes: No object-model member; not established for Action Manager.

features.name: Vertical scale
features.summary: Stretches characters vertically as a percentage.

features.name: Vertical Type Mask Tool
features.summary: Types a selection border in the shape of vertical text.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "typeVerticalCreateMaskTool" (used by boogalooper and photoshop-python-api) or with the select event on that tool class. Entering and committing text is interactive; create type layers through the object model instead.

features.name: Vertical Type Tool
features.summary: Adds or edits text that runs top to bottom.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "typeVerticalCreateOrEditTool" (used by boogalooper and photoshop-python-api) or with the select event on that tool class. Entering and committing text is interactive; create type layers through the object model instead.

features.name: Warp Bend
features.summary: Sets how strongly the warp style is applied.

features.name: Warp Horizontal Distortion
features.summary: Adds horizontal perspective to the warp.

features.name: Warp orientation (Horizontal / Vertical)
features.summary: Chooses whether the warp bends along the horizontal or vertical axis.

features.name: Warp style: Arc
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as arc.

features.name: Warp style: Arch
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as arch.

features.name: Warp style: Arc Lower
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as arc lower.

features.name: Warp style: Arc Upper
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as arc upper.

features.name: Warp style: Bulge
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as bulge.

features.name: Warp style: Fish
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as fish.

features.name: Warp style: Fisheye
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as fisheye.

features.name: Warp style: Flag
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as flag.

features.name: Warp style: Inflate
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as inflate.

features.name: Warp style: Rise
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as rise.

features.name: Warp style: Shell Lower
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as shell lower.

features.name: Warp style: Shell Upper
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as shell upper.

features.name: Warp style: Squeeze
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as squeeze.

features.name: Warp style: Twist
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as twist.

features.name: Warp style: Wave
features.summary: Warp Text preset that shapes the type as wave.

features.name: Warp Text
features.summary: Bends a type layer into a preset shape that stays editable; the warp is an attribute of the layer.

automation.notes: Set the TextItem warp properties directly. Runs as select on menu item "warp" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). Not available on layers with Faux Bold or with bitmap fonts (help).

features.name: Warp Vertical Distortion
features.summary: Adds vertical perspective to the warp.

domains.name: Shapes and paths
domains.covers: Shape layers and tools, the pen and path tools, the Paths panel, path operations and vector strokes.

features.name: Add Anchor Point Tool
features.summary: Adds an anchor point where you click on a path segment.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "addKnotTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; scripts rebuild the subpath with the extra PathPointInfo.

features.name: Anchor point and direction lines
features.summary: A smooth or corner point with left and right direction handles.

features.name: Clipping Path
features.summary: Marks a saved path as the image clipping path so only its inside shows when placed in page-layout applications, with a flatness value.

automation.notes: PathItem.makeClippingPath(flatness). Saved paths only.

features.name: Content-Aware Tracing Tool
features.summary: Technology Preview tool (October 2020) that turns detected image edges into paths as you hover and click.

automation.notes: Enabled from Preferences > Technology Previews; interactive only. Options: Detail slider, Tracing mode (Detailed, Normal, Simplified), create, extend or trim traced paths.

features.name: Convert Point Tool
features.summary: Converts anchor points between smooth and corner by clicking or dragging.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "convertKnotTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; PathPointInfo.kind sets SMOOTHPOINT or CORNERPOINT when a path is built.

features.name: Copy path components between documents
features.summary: Drags or copies and pastes paths and components between images or to and from Illustrator.

automation.notes: Not established for scripting.

features.name: Curvature Pen Tool
features.summary: Draws smooth curves and straight segments by placing points; double-click toggles a point between smooth and corner.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "curvaturePenTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; scripts build paths with PathItems.add.

features.name: Custom shape picker and Shapes panel
features.summary: Chooses custom shapes; the Shapes panel (Window > Shapes) can import shape files and restore Legacy Shapes and More.

automation.notes: The picker and Shapes panel are interactive. Drawing a named custom shape by script: make contentLayer using a shape of class customShape with the shape's name and bounds (choppy createCustomShapeLayer). Unverified.

features.name: Custom Shape Tool
features.summary: Draws a shape chosen from the custom shape picker or Shapes panel.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "customShapeTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; shape layers can be made with the make event on a contentLayer with a shape object (darkwark Layer.ts).

features.name: Define Custom Shape
features.summary: Saves the selected path or shape as a named custom shape.

automation.notes: Needs a path selected in the Paths panel; prompts for a name.

features.name: Delete Anchor Point Tool
features.summary: Removes an anchor point while keeping the path closed or open as before.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "deleteKnotTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; scripts rebuild the subpath without the point.

features.name: Delete Path
features.summary: Removes the selected path.

features.name: Direct Selection Tool
features.summary: Selects and drags individual anchor points, direction handles and segments.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "directSelectTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; point editing is interactive; PathPoint exposes anchor and handle positions read-only.

features.name: Duplicate Path
features.summary: Copies a path under a new name.

features.name: Adjust path segments and points
features.summary: Moves, reshapes, deletes and nudges segments and anchor points, extends or joins open paths.

automation.notes: Interactive editing; existing PathPoint values are read-only, so scripts rebuild the path with PathItems.add.

features.name: Ellipse Tool
features.summary: Draws ellipses and circles.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "ellipseTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; shape layers can be made with the make event on a contentLayer with a shape object (darkwark Layer.ts).

features.name: Curve Fit
features.summary: Freeform Pen option (0.5 to 10 pixels) controlling how many anchor points the path gets.

automation.notes: Interactive tool option.

features.name: Freeform Pen Tool
features.summary: Draws a path freehand, adding anchor points automatically.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "freeformPenTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; scripts build paths with PathItems.add.

features.name: Arrowheads
features.summary: Adds arrowheads to lines with Width, Length and Concavity (-50% to +50%).

automation.notes: make contentLayer with a line shape (class Ln) whose descriptor carries startArrowhead and/or endArrowhead objects (class arrowhead) with width, length, concavity (percent) and on (emptykid Shape.ts Line). Unverified.

features.name: Line Tool
features.summary: Draws lines, optionally with arrowheads.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "lineTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; shape layers can be made with the make event on a contentLayer with a shape object (darkwark Layer.ts).

features.name: Live Shape controls and properties
features.summary: On-canvas handles and Properties panel fields that keep shapes parametric (size, position, corner radii).

automation.notes: Live shape parameters are the keyOrigin* keys of the shape descriptor (keyOriginType, keyOriginShapeBBox, keyOriginPolySides, corner keys), set when making the contentLayer (emptykid Shape.ts). Alchemist lists Change Path Details (changePathDetails) for later edits, and a published script without a licence plays it to change a live rectangle's corner radii; its descriptor is not taken from that script. Unverified.

features.name: Magnetic Pen option
features.summary: Freeform Pen option that snaps the path to image edges, with Width, Contrast, Frequency and Pen Pressure settings.

automation.notes: Interactive tool option.

features.name: Make Selection (load path as selection)
features.summary: Turns a closed path into a selection with feather radius, anti-aliasing and new/add/subtract/intersect options.

automation.notes: PathItem.makeSelection(feather, antiAlias, operation SelectionType). Ctrl/Cmd-click on the thumbnail does it with current settings.

features.name: Make Work Path (from selection)
features.summary: Converts the current selection to a work path with a tolerance value, discarding feathering.

automation.notes: Selection.makeWorkPath(tolerance). Needs an active selection.

features.name: Merge Shape Components
features.summary: Turns overlapping path components into one component.

automation.notes: Path Operations menu in the options bar; not established for scripting.

features.name: Drawing mode: Path
features.summary: Shape and pen tools draw a work path on the current layer.

automation.notes: PathItems.add builds any path; xtools adds rectangles to a path with addTo.

features.name: Drawing mode: Pixels
features.summary: Shape tools paint the shape directly as pixels on the current layer.

automation.notes: Scripted equivalent: build a temporary path, fill it, then remove it.

features.name: Drawing mode: Shape
features.summary: Shape and pen tools create a shape layer: a fill layer with a vector mask holding the outline.

automation.notes: make with a contentLayer class, using contentLayer with type solidColorLayer and shape Rctn or Elps (darkwark Layer.ts).

features.name: New Path
features.summary: Creates an empty named path to record drawing into.

automation.notes: PathItems.add(name, entirePath array of SubPathInfo) creates a path with content in one step.

features.name: Path alignment and distribution
features.summary: Aligns or distributes path components within one path or shape layer from the Path Alignment menu.

automation.notes: Not established for scripting. Layers on separate layers are aligned with Layer > Align instead.

features.name: Path arrangement
features.summary: Changes the stacking order of path components in a shape layer.

automation.notes: Not established for scripting.

features.name: Path
features.summary: A vector outline made of subpaths and anchor points, listed in the Paths panel.

features.name: Path operation: Combine Shapes (Add To Path Area)
features.summary: Adds the new or selected area to overlapping areas.

automation.notes: Set per subpath when building a path with PathItems.add. Shift and Alt/Option while drawing pick add and subtract temporarily.

features.name: Path operation: Exclude Overlapping Shapes
features.summary: Keeps the areas except where they overlap.

automation.notes: Set per subpath when building a path with PathItems.add. Shift and Alt/Option while drawing pick add and subtract temporarily.

features.name: Path operation: Intersect Shape Areas
features.summary: Keeps only where the areas overlap.

automation.notes: Set per subpath when building a path with PathItems.add. Shift and Alt/Option while drawing pick add and subtract temporarily.

features.name: Path operation: Subtract Front Shape (Subtract From Path Area)
features.summary: Removes the area from overlapping areas.

automation.notes: Set per subpath when building a path with PathItems.add. Shift and Alt/Option while drawing pick add and subtract temporarily.

features.name: Path Selection Tool
features.summary: Selects and moves whole path components; its options bar holds path operations, alignment and arrangement.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "pathComponentSelectTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; PathItem.select/deselect target a path by script.

features.name: Path options: thickness and color
features.summary: Sets how thick and in what color paths are drawn on screen (visual only).

automation.notes: Display preference only.

features.name: Paths panel
features.summary: Lists saved paths, the work path and the vector mask of the selected shape layer.

automation.notes: Showing or hiding the panel: Runs as select on menu item "togglePathsPalette" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). (charID Tglt)

features.name: Paths panel options (thumbnail size)
features.summary: Sets or turns off path thumbnails.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "pathsPaletteOptions" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). Opens a dialog. Paths panel menu > Panel Options (thumbnail size) is a dialog-only command: the pathsPaletteOptions menu item opens the Paths Panel Options dialog, and neither the object model nor a published descriptor sets the thumbnail size without it.

features.name: Auto Add/Delete
features.summary: Pen tool option that adds or deletes anchor points when you click on a segment or point.

automation.notes: Interactive tool option.

features.name: Rubber Band
features.summary: Pen tool option that previews the next segment while moving the pointer.

automation.notes: Interactive tool option.

features.name: Pen Tool
features.summary: Draws precise straight and curved path segments by clicking and dragging anchor points.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "penTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; scripts build paths with PathItems.add and PathPointInfo/SubPathInfo.

features.name: Number of sides / star points
features.summary: Sets the sides of a polygon or the points of a star.

automation.notes: The side count is passed when making the contentLayer: emptykid's triangle shape sets keyOriginType 7 with keyOriginPolySides and sides 3. The star options (star points, ratio) are not shown by a source. Unverified.

features.name: Polygon Tool
features.summary: Draws polygons with a chosen number of sides.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "polygonTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; shape layers can be made with the make event on a contentLayer with a shape object (darkwark Layer.ts).

features.name: Rectangle Tool
features.summary: Draws rectangles and squares, with optional rounded corners.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "rectangleTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; shape layers can be made with the make event on a contentLayer with a shape object (darkwark Layer.ts).

features.name: Rename path
features.summary: Renames a saved path by double-clicking its name.

features.name: Reorder paths
features.summary: Drags saved paths into a different order in the panel.

automation.notes: Not established; work paths and vector masks cannot be reordered (help).

features.name: Radius of rounded corners
features.summary: Rounds the corners of rectangles, triangles, polygons and stars.

automation.notes: darkwark drawRoundRect passes the corner radii in the rectangle shape descriptor when making the contentLayer.

features.name: Save Path
features.summary: Saves the work path under a name so it is not replaced.

automation.notes: Not established: no member converts a work path to a saved path.

features.name: Select or deselect a path
features.summary: Shows a path on the canvas by selecting it, or hides it.

features.name: Shape fill
features.summary: Fills a shape with a solid color, gradient or pattern, or none.

automation.notes: Set when the shape layer is made (contentLayer type solidColorLayer, gradientLayer or patternLayer). Changing it on an existing shape is not established.

features.name: Shape layer
features.summary: A fill layer whose vector mask holds the shape outline.

automation.notes: make contentLayer, using contentLayer with type (solidColorLayer and color) and shape (Rctn, Elps with bounds) (darkwark). The ExtendScript DOM cannot create one; LayerKind has no shape kind in the 2015.5 model.

features.name: Shape stroke (color, width, type)
features.summary: Outlines a shape with a solid, gradient or pattern stroke of a set width and line type.

automation.notes: set on the target contentLayer with to = shapeStyle {strokeStyle {strokeStyleLineWidth}} changes the stroke (boogalooper change shape stroke; it reads the current stroke from the layer property AGMStrokeStyleInfo). make contentLayer accepts a strokeStyle object with strokeEnabled, strokeStyleLineWidth, strokeStyleContent (solidColorLayer with color), strokeStyleOpacity and strokeStyleBlendMode (emptykid Stroke.ts, Shape.ts draw; choppy). Gradient and pattern stroke content are not shown. No object-model member. Unverified.

features.name: Shape W and H
features.summary: Sets a shape's width and height numerically in the options bar.

automation.notes: ArtLayer.resize scales the whole shape layer by percentage.

features.name: Star Inner and Outer Radius
features.summary: Sets the depth of the indents and length of the spikes of a star.

automation.notes: Not established for scripting.

features.name: Star Tool
features.summary: Draws stars with a chosen number of points, corner radius and inner/outer radius.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "StarTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; shape layers can be made with the make event on a contentLayer with a shape object (darkwark Layer.ts).

features.name: Stroke Options
features.summary: Chooses solid, dashed or dotted lines, stroke alignment (inside, center, outside), caps (butt, round, square) and corners (miter, round, bevel); can save stroke presets and copy or paste stroke details.

automation.notes: The panel's settings are keys of the strokeStyle object set on a contentLayer: strokeStyleLineDashSet (dash list), strokeStyleLineCapType (strokeStyleButtCap, strokeStyleRoundCap, strokeStyleSquareCap), strokeStyleLineJoinType (strokeStyleMiterJoin, strokeStyleRoundJoin, strokeStyleBevelJoin), strokeStyleLineAlignment (strokeStyleAlignInside, strokeStyleAlignCenter, strokeStyleAlignOutside), strokeStyleMiterLimit and strokeStyleLineDashOffset (emptykid Stroke.ts). Stroke presets and copy/paste of stroke details are not established. Unverified.

features.name: Path component (subpath)
features.summary: One closed or open part of a path with its own operation.

features.name: Triangle Tool
features.summary: Draws triangles, with optional rounded corners.

automation.notes: Activate by setting Application.currentTool to "triangleTool" (as boogalooper and photoshop-python-api do) or with the select event on that tool class. Drawing with the tool is interactive; shape layers can be made with the make event on a contentLayer with a shape object (darkwark Layer.ts).

features.name: Work path
features.summary: The temporary path that drawing creates until it is saved.

domains.name: Transformations
domains.covers: Free transform, warp, perspective warp, puppet warp, content-aware scale, align and distribute, and auto-align layers.

features.name: Align Bottom Edges
features.summary: Lines up the selected layers by their bottom edges, or to the selection border with Align Layers To Selection.

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSBottoms (charID Algn). Also Move tool options bar buttons.

features.name: Align Horizontal Centers
features.summary: Lines up the selected layers by their horizontal centers, or to the selection border with Align Layers To Selection.

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSCentersH (charID Algn). Also Move tool options bar buttons.

features.name: Align Layers To Selection
features.summary: Aligns layer content to the edges or centers of the current selection border.

automation.notes: Needs a selection; uses the same align event and selectors.

features.name: Align Left Edges
features.summary: Lines up the selected layers by their left edges, or to the selection border with Align Layers To Selection.

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSLefts (charID Algn). Also Move tool options bar buttons.

features.name: Align Right Edges
features.summary: Lines up the selected layers by their right edges, or to the selection border with Align Layers To Selection.

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSRights (charID Algn). Also Move tool options bar buttons.

features.name: Align Top Edges
features.summary: Lines up the selected layers by their top edges, or to the selection border with Align Layers To Selection.

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSTops (charID Algn). Also Move tool options bar buttons.

features.name: Align Vertical Centers
features.summary: Lines up the selected layers by their vertical centers, or to the selection border with Align Layers To Selection.

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSCentersV (charID Algn). Also Move tool options bar buttons.

features.name: Auto-Align projection: Auto
features.summary: Picks Perspective or Cylindrical, whichever composes better.

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSContent and apply ('Aply') = projection charIDToTypeID('Auto') (Photomerge maps its Auto layout to it). Taken from Adobe's own stack scripts (StackSupport.jsx, Photomerge.jsx) as read from an unlicensed mirror; facts only.

features.name: Auto-Align projection: Collage
features.summary: Matches content without changing object shapes.

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSContent and apply ('Aply') = projection stringIDToTypeID("sceneCollage"). Taken from Adobe's own stack scripts (StackSupport.jsx, Photomerge.jsx) as read from an unlicensed mirror; facts only.

features.name: Auto-Align projection: Cylindrical
features.summary: Maps images onto an unfolded cylinder to reduce bow-tie distortion.

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSContent and apply ('Aply') = projection stringIDToTypeID("cylindrical"). Taken from Adobe's own stack scripts (StackSupport.jsx, Photomerge.jsx) as read from an unlicensed mirror; facts only.

features.name: Auto-Align: Geometric Distortion
features.summary: Compensates for barrel, pincushion or fisheye distortion while aligning.

automation.notes: Boolean key radialDistort on the align (using ADSContent) descriptor; Photomerge adds it when Geometric Distortion Correction is on. Taken from Adobe's own stack scripts as read from an unlicensed mirror; facts only.

features.name: Auto-Align Layers
features.summary: Aligns layers by matching overlapping content to a reference layer (a locked layer or one chosen automatically).

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSContent (ps14features); with no projection keys the dialog opens. Not for adjustment layers, vector layers or Smart Objects.

features.name: Auto-Align projection: Perspective
features.summary: Transforms other images to match a middle reference image.

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSContent and apply ('Aply') = projection charIDToTypeID('Prsp'). Taken from Adobe's own stack scripts (StackSupport.jsx, Photomerge.jsx) as read from an unlicensed mirror; facts only.

features.name: Auto-Align projection: Reposition
features.summary: Moves layers to match content without stretching or skewing.

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSContent and apply ('Aply') = projection stringIDToTypeID("translation") (Photomerge's Reposition radio button maps to translation); Moksa1123's recording of Auto-Align with Reposition also shows align with ADSContent and Aply. Taken from Adobe's own stack scripts (StackSupport.jsx, Photomerge.jsx) as read from an unlicensed mirror; facts only.

features.name: Auto-Align projection: Spherical
features.summary: Transforms images spherically for wide vertical and horizontal fields of view.

automation.notes: align with using = alignDistributeSelector ADSContent and apply ('Aply') = projection stringIDToTypeID("spherical"). Taken from Adobe's own stack scripts (StackSupport.jsx, Photomerge.jsx) as read from an unlicensed mirror; facts only.

features.name: Auto-Align: Vignette Removal
features.summary: Compensates for darkened image corners while aligning.

automation.notes: Boolean key vignette on the align (using ADSContent) descriptor; Photomerge adds it when Vignette Removal is on. Taken from Adobe's own stack scripts as read from an unlicensed mirror; facts only.

features.name: Auto-Blend Layers
features.summary: Adds layer masks to blend aligned layers into one seamless composite, for panoramas or focus stacks.

automation.notes: RGB or Grayscale only; not for Smart Objects, video layers, 3D layers or the background layer (help).

features.name: Auto-Blend method: Panorama
features.summary: Blends overlapping layers into a panorama.

automation.notes: Key not established.

features.name: Seamless Tones and Colors
features.summary: Adjusts color and tone while blending.

automation.notes: Key not established.

features.name: Auto-Blend method: Stack Images
features.summary: Keeps the best detail from each aligned layer, for extended depth of field.

automation.notes: Key not established.

features.name: Content-Aware Scale: Amount
features.summary: Sets the ratio of content-aware scaling to normal scaling.

automation.notes: Options bar setting of Content-Aware Scale; not established for scripting.

features.name: Content-Aware Scale: Protect (alpha channel)
features.summary: Chooses an alpha channel marking content to keep from distorting.

automation.notes: Options bar setting of Content-Aware Scale; not established for scripting.

features.name: Content-Aware Scale: Protect Skin Tones
features.summary: Tries to preserve areas containing skin tones.

automation.notes: Options bar setting of Content-Aware Scale; not established for scripting.

features.name: Content-Aware Scale: Reference point location and position
features.summary: Sets the fixed point for content-aware scaling, absolutely or relative to its current position.

automation.notes: Key freeTransformCenterState (enumerated, type quadCenterState) on the contentAware transform; the source shows QCSAverage (centre). Other reference-point values and the relative-positioning option are not shown in the source.

features.name: Content-Aware Scale: Scaling percentage (W, H)
features.summary: Sets the scale as width and height percentages, optionally linked.

automation.notes: transform on the target layer with width and height (percentUnit) and contentAware = true applies Content-Aware Scale without the options bar (Moksa1123 sweep). The linked-proportions toggle is only a UI convenience.

features.name: Content-Aware Scale
features.summary: Resizes an image or layer while preserving important content such as people and buildings and compressing less important areas.

automation.notes: Opening it interactively: Runs as select on menu item "contentAware" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). No published descriptor applies it numerically. Background layers need Select > All first.

features.name: Convert Warp Anchor Point (Unison / Independent handles)
features.summary: Switches whether an anchor point's Bezier handles move together or independently (Alt/Option-click toggles).

automation.notes: Interactive warp mode only.

features.name: Cylinder warp
features.summary: Warp preset that wraps a layer or text around a cylinder with curvature and perspective controls (since 23.4).

automation.notes: No published descriptor.

features.name: Distribute Bottom Edges
features.summary: Spaces three or more layers evenly by their bottom edges.

automation.notes: Distribute runs with the stringID distort (charID Dstr) and using = alignDistributeSelector ADSBottoms.

features.name: Distribute Horizontal Centers
features.summary: Spaces three or more layers evenly by their horizontal centers.

automation.notes: Distribute runs with the stringID distort (charID Dstr) and using = alignDistributeSelector ADSCentersH.

features.name: Distribute Left Edges
features.summary: Spaces three or more layers evenly by their left edges.

automation.notes: Distribute runs with the stringID distort (charID Dstr) and using = alignDistributeSelector ADSLefts.

features.name: Distribute Right Edges
features.summary: Spaces three or more layers evenly by their right edges.

automation.notes: Distribute runs with the stringID distort (charID Dstr) and using = alignDistributeSelector ADSRights.

features.name: Distribute Horizontally / Vertically (spacing)
features.summary: Makes the gaps between three or more layers equal (since 20.0).

automation.notes: distribute with null = target layers and using = alignDistributeSelector ADSDistH (Horizontally) or ADSDistV (Vertically) (Moksa1123 menu sweep, three layers, positions read back). Needs three or more layers.

features.name: Distribute Top Edges
features.summary: Spaces three or more layers evenly by their top edges.

automation.notes: Distribute runs with the stringID distort (charID Dstr) and using = alignDistributeSelector ADSTops.

features.name: Distribute Vertical Centers
features.summary: Spaces three or more layers evenly by their vertical centers.

automation.notes: Distribute runs with the stringID distort (charID Dstr) and using = alignDistributeSelector ADSCentersV.

features.name: Duplicate while transforming
features.summary: Holding Alt/Option when choosing a transform command transforms a copy.

automation.notes: Script equivalent: duplicate the layer, then transform the copy.

features.name: Free Transform
features.summary: Scales, rotates, skews, distorts and applies perspective in one operation using handles and modifier keys, or numeric fields in the options bar.

automation.notes: Numeric scale, rotate and move have DOM members; the transform event takes width/height percent, angle and offset in one step. Interactive bounding box: Runs as select on menu item "freeTransform" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). (charID FrTr; xtools Stdlib.freeTransform). Becomes Free Transform Path or Free Transform Points for paths. The background layer cannot be transformed.

features.name: Legacy Free Transform
features.summary: General preference that restores the pre-2019 scaling behaviour where Shift constrains proportions.

automation.notes: Not in the object model.

features.name: Maintain Aspect Ratio (link) in transforms
features.summary: Options bar link that decides whether dragging a corner scales proportionally; Shift toggles it (since 21.0).

automation.notes: Interactive option; numeric resize takes separate horizontal and vertical percentages.

features.name: Perspective Warp
features.summary: Corrects or changes perspective by drawing planes (quads) in Layout mode and moving their pins in Warp mode.

automation.notes: boogalooper runs perspectiveWarpTransform with DialogModes.NO, passing the quads and the warped positions. Requires the graphics processor (512 MB VRAM for 16- and 32-bit documents).

features.name: Automatic level/straighten
features.summary: Warp mode buttons that level near-horizontal lines, straighten near-vertical lines, or both.

automation.notes: Not established for scripting.

features.name: Perspective Warp Layout mode
features.summary: Mode for drawing and snapping quads along the planes of the image (L).

automation.notes: Interactive.

features.name: Perspective Warp Warp mode
features.summary: Mode for moving quad pins to change perspective (W); Shift-click keeps an edge straight.

automation.notes: Interactive.

features.name: Puppet Warp Density
features.summary: Sets mesh point spacing: Fewer Points, Normal or More Points.

automation.notes: Puppet Warp mesh option; how it is stored in the rigidTransform descriptor is not documented.

features.name: Puppet Warp Expansion
features.summary: Expands or contracts the outer edge of the mesh.

automation.notes: Puppet Warp mesh option; how it is stored in the rigidTransform descriptor is not documented.

features.name: Puppet Warp Mode (Rigid, Normal, Distort)
features.summary: Sets the elasticity of the mesh.

automation.notes: Puppet Warp mesh option; how it is stored in the rigidTransform descriptor is not documented.

features.name: Pins (add, delete, select, depth, rotate)
features.summary: Adds pins by clicking, deletes them with Delete or Alt/Option-click, selects all with Ctrl/Cmd+A, changes pin depth and rotates the mesh around a pin (Auto or fixed).

automation.notes: Interactive only.

features.name: Remove All Pins
features.summary: Clears every pin from the mesh.

automation.notes: Interactive only.

features.name: Show Mesh
features.summary: Shows or hides the mesh; H hides pins temporarily.

automation.notes: Display option.

features.name: Puppet Warp
features.summary: Distorts a layer or mask with a mesh and pins: some pins hold areas in place while dragged pins bend the rest.

automation.notes: Selecting the rigidTransform menu item opens the interactive mesh (ps14features). The committed result is recorded as a rigidTransform event with its descriptor (boogalooper event listener); the descriptor layout and replaying it are not documented. Works on Smart Objects as a smart filter. Interactive: Edit > Puppet Warp places and drags pins on a mesh. The committed rigidTransform event records pins and mesh, but the descriptor layout and replaying it are undocumented.

features.name: Reference point
features.summary: The fixed point transforms are made around, chosen with the reference point locator or by dragging; hidden until enabled in the options bar.

automation.notes: ArtLayer.resize(horizontal, vertical, anchor) takes an AnchorPosition.

features.name: Remove Warp Split
features.summary: Deletes the selected grid line, or both lines through a selected anchor point.

automation.notes: Interactive warp mode only.

features.name: Show Transform Controls
features.summary: Move tool option that shows transform handles on the selected layer.

automation.notes: Interactive tool option.

features.name: Split Warp Horizontally / Vertically / Crosswise
features.summary: Adds grid lines to the warp mesh for finer control (since 22.5); Ctrl/Cmd-click on the mesh splits at the pointer.

automation.notes: Only available inside interactive warp mode.

features.name: Again
features.summary: Repeats the last transformation.

automation.notes: transform with lastTransform true.

features.name: Commit or cancel a transformation
features.summary: Applies with Enter/Return, the Commit button or a double-click; Esc cancels.

automation.notes: Scripted transforms apply immediately. Each commit on pixels resamples the image, so combine steps before committing (help).

features.name: Distort
features.summary: Stretches freely by dragging corner handles.

automation.notes: Interactive mode: Runs as select on menu item "distort" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). (charID Dstr). Applying a skew/distort/perspective numerically has no DOM member and no published descriptor; the menu item only opens the handles. Interactive: Edit > Transform > Distort only opens corner handles to drag; the transform descriptor has no published key for moving individual corners. A four-corner result can be had with Perspective Warp and one quad (warp_perspective), which is a different command.

features.name: Flip Horizontal
features.summary: Mirrors the item across the vertical axis.

automation.notes: flip with axis horizontal. On a path, xtools Stdlib.flipPath uses transform with width -100%.

features.name: Flip Vertical
features.summary: Mirrors the item across the horizontal axis.

features.name: Transform masks, alpha channels and selection borders
features.summary: Transforms an unlinked layer or vector mask, an alpha channel, or (with Select > Transform Selection) a selection border.

automation.notes: Selection boundary members cover selection borders; masks and channels are transformed by targeting them first.

features.name: Transform Path / Transform Points
features.summary: The Transform menu becomes Transform Path for a whole path or shape, or Transform Points for selected segments.

automation.notes: transform with a Path ordinal target reference (xtools).

features.name: Perspective
features.summary: Applies one-point perspective by dragging corner handles.

automation.notes: Interactive mode: Runs as select on menu item "perspective" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). (charID Prsp). Applying a skew/distort/perspective numerically has no DOM member and no published descriptor; the menu item only opens the handles. Interactive: Edit > Transform > Perspective only opens handles to drag; no published descriptor applies it numerically. Perspective Warp with one quad (warp_perspective) reaches a similar result through a different command.

features.name: Rotate
features.summary: Turns around the reference point; Shift constrains to 15 degrees.

automation.notes: Interactive mode: Runs as select on menu item "rotateEventEnum" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). (charID Rtte).

features.name: Rotate 180°
features.summary: Turns the item half a turn.

automation.notes: rotateEventEnum with angle 180.

features.name: Rotate 90° Counter Clockwise
features.summary: Turns the item a quarter turn counterclockwise.

features.name: Rotate 90° Clockwise
features.summary: Turns the item a quarter turn clockwise.

features.name: Scale
features.summary: Enlarges or reduces around the reference point.

automation.notes: Interactive mode: Runs as select on menu item "scale" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). (charID Scl).

features.name: Skew
features.summary: Slants horizontally or vertically by dragging side handles.

automation.notes: Interactive mode: Runs as select on menu item "skew" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). (charID Skew). Applying a skew/distort/perspective numerically has no DOM member and no published descriptor; the menu item only opens the handles.

features.name: Transform video layers
features.summary: Applies Free Transform or Transform commands to a video layer, which Photoshop first converts to a Smart Object.

automation.notes: Conversion prompt appears if the video layer is not a Smart Object.

features.name: Warp
features.summary: Reshapes a layer, selection, shape or path with a mesh of control points or a preset warp style.

automation.notes: boogalooper copies a warp from one layer to another by reading it and running transform with a warp descriptor. Opening warp mode interactively: Runs as select on menu item "warp" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). The Switch Between Free Transform And Warp Modes button does the same from Free Transform.

features.name: Warp grid size
features.summary: Sets the warp mesh to Default (1x1), 3x3, 4x4, 5x5 or a custom number of columns and rows.

automation.notes: Not established for scripting.

features.name: Warp guide options
features.summary: Gear menu settings to show guides automatically, always or never, and to set guide color, opacity and density (default 2).

automation.notes: Display options.

features.name: Warp orientation and Bend, H, V values
features.summary: Changes the orientation of a preset warp and enters bend and distortion values numerically.

automation.notes: Part of the warp descriptor.

features.name: Warp style presets
features.summary: Options bar Warp menu with the preset styles (the Warp Text set: Arc, Arch, Bulge, Flag, Wave, Fish, Rise, Fisheye, Inflate, Squeeze, Twist and others), Custom and Cylinder.

automation.notes: The style is part of the warp descriptor passed to transform.

domains.name: Video and animation
domains.covers: The Timeline panel, video layers, frame animation and rendering video.

features.name: Select a frame
features.summary: Makes a frame current by clicking it or with the next, previous and first frame buttons.

automation.notes: animationFrameActivate with an animationFrameClass index reference; the Go To submenu items (animationGoToNextFrame and others) run as menu items.

features.name: Allow Frame Skipping
features.summary: Skips uncached frames during playback to keep real time.

automation.notes: Panel menu option; not established for scripting.

features.name: Save an animated GIF
features.summary: Exports a frame or timeline animation as an animated GIF through Save for Web (Legacy) or Save As GIF.

automation.notes: ExportOptionsSaveForWeb has no animation or looping member, so animated output by script is not established.

features.name: Animation Options (Layers panel)

features.name: Audio tracks and clips

features.name: New Blank Video Layer

features.name: Convert to Frame Animation

features.name: Convert to Video Timeline

features.name: Copy Frames

features.name: Copy Keyframes

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "timelineCopyKeyframes" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: Create Frame Animation

automation.notes: makeFrameAnimation with no descriptor (sakura-rtd FilesToAnimationGIF); listed in the Alchemist event list as Create Frame Animation. Unverified.

features.name: Create Video Timeline

features.name: Current-time indicator and Go To

features.name: Delete Animation

features.name: Delete Frame

features.name: Delete Frames

features.name: Delete Keyframes

features.name: Duplicate Frame

features.name: Enable Onion Skins

features.name: Export Timeline Comments

features.name: Extract Work Area

features.name: Set Favorite Clips / Show Favorite or All

features.name: Flatten Frames Into Clips / Layers

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "timelineFlattenFramesIntoLayers" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.summary: Creates a layer from each frame.

features.name: Frame animation
features.summary: An animation in which each frame records a configuration of layer visibility, position, opacity and style.

automation.notes: Frames are addressed as animationFrameClass references (ordinal target, last, or index) and the animation as animationClass; makeFrameAnimation starts one, animationFrameActivate selects a frame, and set changes frame or animation properties (sakura-rtd, boogalooper). features.name: Frame delay
features.summary: Sets how long each selected frame is shown, in seconds.

automation.notes: set on an animationFrameClass reference (target or a frame activated with animationFrameActivate) with to = animationFrameClass {animationFrameDelay: seconds as a double} (boogalooper set duration of last frame; sakura-rtd setFrameDelay; FaceTags in batchPlay). Unverified.

features.name: Frame disposal method

automation.notes: Context menu of a frame; not established for scripting.

features.name: Timeline (frames) Panel Options

features.name: Insert Blank Frame
features.summary: Inserts an empty frame at the current time in a blank video layer.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "insertBlankFrame" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: Interpret Footage
features.summary: Sets how a video layer's alpha channel (Ignore, Straight-Unmatted, Premultiplied-Matte with a matte color), frame rate and color profile are interpreted.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "interpretFootage" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). Opens a dialog. Dialog-only command: Layer > Video Layers > Interpret Footage (menu item "interpretFootage") opens the Interpret Footage dialog; no published event or descriptor sets alpha, frame rate or colour profile for a video layer.

features.name: Hold Interpolation
features.summary: Keeps the property unchanged until the next keyframe.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "timelineKeyframeInterpolationHold" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: Linear Interpolation
features.summary: Changes the property evenly between selected keyframes.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "timelineKeyframeInterpolationLinear" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: Keyframe animation of layer properties
features.summary: Animates Position, Opacity, Style, layer and vector mask position or enable, and global lighting by setting keyframes with the Time-Vary stopwatch.

automation.notes: Setting keyframes by script is not established in the sources.

features.name: Layer duration bar, in and out points
features.summary: Trims or moves when a layer appears by dragging the ends or body of its duration bar.

features.name: Lift Work Area
features.summary: Deletes the work-area section from selected layers, leaving a gap.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "timelineLiftWorkArea" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: Looping options

features.name: Make Frames from Clips

features.name: Make Frames From Layers

features.name: Match Layer Across Frames

features.name: Motion (Pan & Zoom, Rotate, Pan, Zoom)

features.name: Move Layer End Point to Current Time

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "timelineMoveLayerEndPoint" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: Move Layer In Point to Current Time
features.summary: Moves or hides frames of the selected layer relative to the current-time indicator.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "timelineMoveLayerInPoint" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: Duplicate selected frames (New Frame)
features.summary: Adds a frame by copying the selected frame.

automation.notes: duplicate with an animationFrameClass ordinal target reference.

features.name: Create New Layer for Each New Frame
features.summary: Adds a layer visible only in each new frame.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "animationNewLayerPerFrame" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: New Layers Visible in All Frames
features.summary: Controls whether new layers appear in every frame or only the active one.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "animationShowNewLayersInFrames" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: New Video Layer From File
features.summary: Adds a video file or image sequence as a new video layer.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "addVideoLayer" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). Opens the file dialog. Dialog-only command: Layer > Video Layers > New Video Layer From File (menu item "addVideoLayer") opens a file dialog; no published descriptor takes the file. Video Frames to Layers (import_video_frames) and New Blank Video Layer (add_video_layer) are scriptable.

features.name: Onion Skin Settings
features.summary: Sets frames before and after, frame spacing, maximum and minimum opacity and blend mode of onion skins.

features.name: Optimize Animation
features.summary: Reduces GIF size with Bounding Box cropping and Redundant Pixel Removal.

features.name: Paint and clone on video frames
features.summary: Paints, clones or heals on individual video frames (rotoscoping) without altering the source footage.

features.name: Play and preview animation

features.name: Reload Frame
features.summary: Reloads the current frame from the source footage.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "reloadFrame" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: Render Video: Render Options: Alpha Channel

features.name: Render Video: Photoshop Image Sequence: format, starting number, digits, size, frame rate
features.summary: Writes each frame as a numbered image file.

features.name: Render Video: Adobe Media Encoder: format, preset, size, frame rate, field order, aspect, color management
features.summary: Encodes a video file (for example H.264/MP4, QuickTime, DPX) with preset-driven settings.

features.name: Render Video: Name, folder and subfolder

automation.notes: Option of the Render Video dialog; descriptor keys not published.

features.name: Render Video: Range: All Frames, Start and End Frame, Work Area

automation.notes: Option of the Render Video dialog; descriptor keys not published.

features.name: Replace Footage
