domains.name: Automation
domains.covers: Actions, batch, droplets, scripts, variables and data sets, image processor, photomerge, merge to HDR, contact sheets and other File > Automate and Scripts items.

features.name: Action
features.summary: A recorded series of commands, stored in an action set, that can be played back on files.

automation.notes: Application.doAction(action, set) plays; Application.load(file) loads an .atn set.

features.name: Action Options
features.summary: Renames an action and changes its set, function key and color.

automation.notes: Not established.

features.name: Action set file (.atn)
features.summary: File that stores one or more action sets for transfer between computers.

features.name: Actions panel
features.summary: Panel for recording, playing, editing and organising actions and action sets.

automation.notes: Show or hide: Runs as select on menu item "toggleActionsPalette" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). (charID TglA).

features.name: Allow Tool Recording
features.summary: Lets painting and other tool strokes be recorded into actions.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "allowToolRecording" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: Apply Data Set
features.summary: Applies a data set's values to the document, overwriting it.

automation.notes: apply with a dataSetClass reference by name runs without the dialog (xtools).

features.name: Batch
features.summary: Plays an action on every file in a folder, from an import source, on open files or on files selected in Bridge.

automation.notes: Application.batch(inputFiles, action, set, BatchOptions). The action needs a Save As step when the destination is a folder. Reduce history states for speed (help). Also Tools > Photoshop > Batch in Bridge.

features.name: Batch: Compatibility (Windows, Mac OS, Unix)
features.summary: Keeps file names valid on the chosen platforms.

features.name: Batch: Destination (None, Save and Close, Folder)
features.summary: Leaves files open, saves over the originals, or saves to another folder.

features.name: Batch: Errors (Stop For Errors, Log Errors To File)
features.summary: Stops at each error or writes errors to a log file.

features.name: Batch: File Naming
features.summary: Builds output names from document name, serial number or letter, date and extension parts.

features.name: Batch: Include All Subfolders
features.summary: Also processes files in nested folders.

automation.notes: Include All Subfolders and Source are expressed by the inputFiles list passed to Application.batch.

features.name: Batch: Override Action "Open" Commands
features.summary: Processes the batch files instead of the file named in the action's Open step.

features.name: Batch: Override Action "Save As" Commands
features.summary: Saves to the batch destination instead of the location recorded in the action.

features.name: Batch: Source (Folder, Import, Opened Files, Bridge)
features.summary: Chooses which files the action runs on.

automation.notes: Include All Subfolders and Source are expressed by the inputFiles list passed to Application.batch.

features.name: Batch: Suppress File Open Options Dialogs
features.summary: Uses default or previous settings instead of showing open options (for example camera raw).

features.name: Batch: Suppress Color Profile Warnings
features.summary: Turns off color policy messages.

features.name: Button Mode
features.summary: Shows actions as colored buttons that play on click.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "buttonMode" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem).

features.name: Clear All Actions / Reset Actions
features.summary: Empties the panel, or restores the default set (replace or append).

automation.notes: xtools deletes every set one by one with delete; Reset Actions itself is not established.

features.name: Conditional Mode Change
features.summary: Converts a document to a target color mode only when its current mode is one of the chosen source modes; useful inside actions.

automation.notes: Keys sourceMode, destinationMode and merge; Adobe Image Processor calls it with DialogModes.NO. Document.changeMode is the unconditional DOM form.

features.name: Contact Sheet II
features.summary: Builds sheets of thumbnail images from a folder or open files, with layout and captions.

automation.notes: Event declared by Adobe's ContactSheetII.jsx with keys for source, sheet size, resolution, flatten, columns, rows, captions, font and spacing. Application.makeContactSheet with ContactSheetOptions exists in the object model but targets the older plug-in; unverified. Contact Sheet II (File > Automate > Contact Sheet II...) is Adobe's ContactSheetII.jsx. Its _main turns the dialog off only when app.playbackDisplayDialogs is DialogModes.ERROR (an action step with its dialog toggle off); a script call with DialogModes.NO is treated as the debugger case and opens the dialog, as does a call with no parameters. Application.makeContactSheet targets the pre-CS4 plug-in that no longer ships.

features.name: Contact Sheet II: Use Filename As Caption (font, size)
features.summary: Labels thumbnails with their file names.

automation.notes: Terminology key of the Contact Sheet II event. Matching ContactSheetOptions members: ContactSheetOptions.caption, ContactSheetOptions.font, ContactSheetOptions.fontSize (older plug-in API). Setting of Contact Sheet II (IndN, Font, FtSz keys), which opens its dialog when run from a script; see photoshop.automation.contact_sheet.

features.name: Contact Sheet II: Document (size, resolution, mode, flatten)
features.summary: Sets sheet width, height, units, resolution, color mode and whether layers are flattened.

automation.notes: Terminology key of the Contact Sheet II event. Matching ContactSheetOptions members: ContactSheetOptions.width, ContactSheetOptions.height, ContactSheetOptions.resolution, ContactSheetOptions.mode, ContactSheetOptions.flatten (older plug-in API). Setting of Contact Sheet II (Wdth, Hght, Unit, Rslt, RsUn, Md, FltT keys), which opens its dialog when run from a script; see photoshop.automation.contact_sheet.

features.name: Contact Sheet II: Source images (Use menu)
features.summary: Chooses a folder, open documents or Bridge selection.

automation.notes: Terminology key of the Contact Sheet II event. Setting of Contact Sheet II (InSr / InpD / InSd keys), which opens its dialog when run from a script; see photoshop.automation.contact_sheet.

features.name: Contact Sheet II: Thumbnails (place across/down first, columns, rows, spacing, Rotate For Best Fit)
features.summary: Sets thumbnail layout.

automation.notes: Terminology key of the Contact Sheet II event. Matching ContactSheetOptions members: ContactSheetOptions.acrossFirst, ContactSheetOptions.columnCount, ContactSheetOptions.rowCount, ContactSheetOptions.useAutoSpacing, ContactSheetOptions.horizontal, ContactSheetOptions.vertical, ContactSheetOptions.bestFit (older plug-in API). Setting of Contact Sheet II (RowO, Cols, Rows, UAS, HtSp, VtSp, Rtbf keys), which opens its dialog when run from a script; see photoshop.automation.contact_sheet.

features.name: Create Droplet
features.summary: Saves an action as a small application that processes files dropped on its icon.

automation.notes: Uses the same processing, saving and naming options as Batch.

features.name: Crop and Straighten Photos
features.summary: Automate command that crops and straightens the photos found in the active image.

automation.notes: Known from the Configurator command list and Alchemist; the help pages reviewed do not describe it. Runs without a dialog.

features.name: Data set text file
features.summary: CSV or tab-delimited file whose first line names the variables and each further line is one data set; true/false for visibility, file paths for pixels.

automation.notes: File layout description.

features.name: Data Sets
features.summary: Creates and edits named sets of variable values, with preview.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "editDataSets" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). Image > Variables > Data Sets... is dialog-only: the editDataSets menu item opens the dialog for creating, renaming and editing data sets one by one, and no published descriptor does that. Data sets can be imported, applied and exported with manage_data_sets (importDataSets, apply on dataSetClass).

features.name: Default and additional action sets
features.summary: Action sets shipped with Photoshop (for example Production and Text Effects) loaded from the bottom of the Actions panel menu.

automation.notes: Load the set, then play with Application.doAction.

features.name: Delete action, command or set
features.summary: Removes the selected action, command or set (Alt/Option-click skips confirmation).

automation.notes: delete with references to Actn and ASet by name, or Cmnd by index (xtools).

features.name: Delete All Empty Layers
features.summary: Removes layers with no content.

features.name: Droplet
features.summary: An executable that starts Photoshop and runs its action on dropped files or folders.

automation.notes: Created by Create Droplet; run by the operating system. Windows droplets moved to Mac must be dropped on the Photoshop icon once.

features.name: Duplicate action, command or set
features.summary: Copies an action, command or set.

automation.notes: Not established for scripting.

features.name: Edit, rearrange and overwrite action commands
features.summary: Double-clicks a command to re-record its values, drags commands to reorder them, or records additional commands.

automation.notes: Actions panel editing only.

features.name: Include or exclude commands
features.summary: Turns individual commands in an action on or off with their check marks.

automation.notes: Actions panel editing only.

features.name: Data Sets as Files
features.summary: Writes one PSD per selected data set using a base name and folder.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "exportDataSet" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). Opens the dialog.

features.name: JavaScript (ExtendScript) object model
features.summary: Photoshop's scripting object model of documents, layers, channels, paths and options, run from File > Scripts or other applications.

automation.notes: The model held here is Photoshop CC 2015.5 (types-for-adobe). Adobe now points new scripting to UXP.

features.name: Fit Image
features.summary: Resizes the image to fit within a width and height while keeping its proportions, optionally never enlarging.

automation.notes: Keys width, height, limit (Don't Enlarge). Document.resizeImage gives the same result in the DOM after computing the size.

features.name: Flatten All Layer Effects
features.summary: Merges every layer's effects into its pixels.

features.name: Flatten All Masks
features.summary: Applies every layer mask to its layer.

features.name: Generator Plugins
features.summary: Submenu of Generator plug-ins such as Image Assets (File > Generate before 25.11).

automation.notes: Moved under File > Automate in 25.11 (July 2024). Image Assets has its own record in import_export.

features.name: Image Processor
features.summary: Converts a folder or open files to JPEG, PSD and/or TIFF, with resizing, profile conversion, an optional action and copyright metadata, without needing an action.

automation.notes: Runs Adobe's installed script; executeAction on its event id (declared in the script header) or on "AdobeScriptAutomation Scripts" with javaScriptName "Image Processor...". Opens the script's dialog unless the script accepts a descriptor. Also Tools > Photoshop > Image Processor in Bridge. Works with PSD, JPEG and camera raw files. Image Processor (File > Scripts > Image Processor...) is dialog-only: Image Processor.jsx always builds and runs its dialog and reads no app.playbackParameters, so its event id cannot run it unattended. run_action_batch with an action covers the same conversions.

features.name: Image Processor: Copyright Info and Include ICC Profile
features.summary: Writes IPTC copyright text and embeds the color profile.

automation.notes: Image Processor dialog option; the script exposes no terminology keys.

features.name: Image Processor: Save as JPEG (Quality 0-12, Resize To Fit, Convert Profile to sRGB)
features.summary: Writes JPEGs into a JPEG subfolder.

automation.notes: Image Processor dialog option; the script exposes no terminology keys.

features.name: Image Processor: Open First Image To Apply Settings
features.summary: Applies settings chosen on the first image (for example camera raw) to all.

automation.notes: Image Processor dialog option; the script exposes no terminology keys.

features.name: Image Processor: Save as PSD (Maximize Compatibility, Resize To Fit)
features.summary: Writes PSDs into a PSD subfolder.

automation.notes: Image Processor dialog option; the script exposes no terminology keys.

features.name: Image Processor: Run Action
features.summary: Plays a chosen action from a loaded set on each image.

automation.notes: Image Processor dialog option; the script exposes no terminology keys.

features.name: Image Processor: Save and Load settings
features.summary: Stores or reloads the dialog settings in a file.

automation.notes: Image Processor dialog option; the script exposes no terminology keys.

features.name: Image Processor: Save as TIFF (LZW Compression, Resize To Fit)
features.summary: Writes TIFFs into a TIFF subfolder.

automation.notes: Image Processor dialog option; the script exposes no terminology keys.

features.name: Import Variable Data Sets
features.summary: Reads data sets from a comma- or tab-separated text file, optionally replacing existing sets, with an encoding choice.

automation.notes: Keys using (file), encoding, eraseAll, useFirstColumn (xtools).

features.name: Insert Conditional
features.summary: Adds a step that plays one action or another depending on a condition about the document or layer (If Current, Then Play Action, Else Play Action).

automation.notes: Actions panel editing only; referenced actions must be in the same set.

features.name: Insert Menu Item
features.summary: Adds a non-recordable menu command to an action.

automation.notes: Actions panel editing only.

features.name: Insert Path
features.summary: Records the selected path into an action so playback recreates it.

automation.notes: Actions panel editing only.

features.name: Insert Stop
features.summary: Adds a pause with a message, optionally with a Continue button, so a manual step can be done.

automation.notes: Actions panel editing only.

features.name: Lens Correction (Automate)
features.summary: Applies lens profile corrections to a batch of files.

automation.notes: Runs Adobe's installed script; executeAction on its event id (declared in the script header) or on "AdobeScriptAutomation Scripts" with javaScriptName "Lens Correction...". Opens the script's dialog unless the script accepts a descriptor.

features.name: Load Actions
features.summary: Adds a saved .atn action set to the panel.

automation.notes: Also by dragging the file into Photoshop.

features.name: Load Files into Stack
features.summary: Opens several files as layers of one document, optionally aligning them and making a Smart Object.

automation.notes: Runs Adobe's installed script; executeAction on its event id (declared in the script header) or on "AdobeScriptAutomation Scripts" with javaScriptName "Load Files into Stack...". Opens the script's dialog unless the script accepts a descriptor.

features.name: Load Multiple DICOM Files
features.summary: Opens a folder of DICOM frames as layers of one document.

automation.notes: Runs Adobe's installed script; executeAction on its event id (declared in the script header) or on "AdobeScriptAutomation Scripts" with javaScriptName "Load Multiple DICOM Files...". Opens the script's dialog unless the script accepts a descriptor. Load Multiple DICOM Files (File > Scripts > Load Multiple DICOM Files...) is dialog-only: Load DICOM.jsx always asks for the folder with a folder dialog (importDICOMFolder(getFolder())) and has no script entry point or playback parameters.

features.name: Merge to HDR Pro
features.summary: Combines differently exposed photos of a scene into one high dynamic range image, output as 32, 16 or 8 bits per channel.

automation.notes: Runs Adobe's installed script; executeAction on its event id (declared in the script header) or on "AdobeScriptAutomation Scripts" with javaScriptName "Merge to HDR Pro...". Opens the script's dialog unless the script accepts a descriptor. The merge dialog itself is interactive.

features.name: Modal controls (toggle dialog on/off)
features.summary: Makes an action pause at a dialog or modal tool so values can be changed during playback.

automation.notes: Set in the Actions panel. Scripts control dialogs with Application.displayDialogs.

features.name: New Action and recording
features.summary: Creates an action with a name, set, function key and button color, then records commands until Stop.

automation.notes: make on an action class (ps14features) creates it; recording itself is interactive. Alt/Option-click the New Action button starts recording without the dialog. Recording an action needs the user to perform the steps and press Stop in the Actions panel. The recorded make on the action class (Mk with Nw = Actn) is played with DialogModes.ALL to open the New Action dialog; nothing documents an unattended form that creates a named action without starting a recording, so no tool offers it. Actions can be loaded from .atn files instead (edit_actions load).

features.name: New Set
features.summary: Creates an action set to group actions.

features.name: Photomerge
features.summary: Stitches overlapping photos, tiled horizontally or vertically, into a panorama.

automation.notes: Event id declared by Adobe's Photomerge.jsx; with no descriptor the dialog opens. Application.makePhotomerge exists in the object model; unverified.

features.name: Photomerge: Blend Images Together
features.summary: Finds seams and blends exposure between images.

automation.notes: Photomerge dialog option; descriptor keys not published.

features.name: Photomerge: Content Aware Fill Transparent Areas
features.summary: Fills transparent edges of the panorama with similar nearby content.

automation.notes: Photomerge dialog option; descriptor keys not published.

features.name: Photomerge: Geometric Distortion Correction
features.summary: Compensates for barrel, pincushion or fisheye distortion.

automation.notes: Photomerge dialog option; descriptor keys not published.

features.name: Photomerge: Layout (Auto, Perspective, Cylindrical, Spherical, Collage, Reposition)
features.summary: Chooses how source images are projected and transformed.

automation.notes: Photomerge dialog option; descriptor keys not published.

features.name: Photomerge: Source Files (Files, Folders, Add Open Files)
features.summary: Chooses the images to merge.

automation.notes: Photomerge dialog option; descriptor keys not published.

features.name: Photomerge: Vignette Removal
features.summary: Removes darkened edges and compensates exposure.

automation.notes: Photomerge dialog option; descriptor keys not published.

features.name: Play action
features.summary: Runs an action, or a set's actions, on the active document.

automation.notes: Application.doAction(action, set); names are case-sensitive. Ctrl/Cmd-double-click plays an action; Ctrl/Cmd-click Play runs one command.

features.name: Playback Options
features.summary: Sets action playback to Accelerated, Step By Step, or Pause For a number of seconds.

automation.notes: xtools sets the application playbackOptions property (PbkO) with performance accelerated, stepByStep or pause and a pause value.

features.name: Record Again
features.summary: Replays an action pausing at each dialog or modal tool so new values can be recorded.

automation.notes: Interactive.

features.name: Save Actions
features.summary: Saves a set (or, since 25.7, selected actions) to an .atn file; Ctrl+Alt/Cmd+Option saves a text listing.

automation.notes: Not established for scripting.

features.name: Script Events Manager
features.summary: Runs a script or action automatically when a chosen Photoshop event occurs.

automation.notes: The dialog edits the same notifiers the DOM exposes: Notifiers.add(event, file, eventClass).

features.name: Script playback from actions
features.summary: Scripts recorded in actions receive their descriptor and dialog mode at playback.

features.name: Scripts menu and Browse
features.summary: Lists installed scripts and runs any other script file chosen with Browse.

automation.notes: Browse: Runs as select on menu item "browseScripts" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). Installed scripts run by name with AdobeScriptAutomation Scripts.

features.name: Start / Stop Recording
features.summary: Begins or ends recording commands into the selected action.

automation.notes: Recording is interactive; Esc also stops recording.

features.name: Statistics
features.summary: Loads files into a stack, aligns them optionally, converts to a Smart Object and applies a stack mode.

automation.notes: Runs Adobe's installed script; executeAction on its event id (declared in the script header) or on "AdobeScriptAutomation Scripts" with javaScriptName "Statistics...". Opens the script's dialog unless the script accepts a descriptor.

features.name: UXP scripting and plug-ins (batchPlay)
features.summary: Modern JavaScript API for scripts (.psjs) and plug-ins, with a DOM, batchPlay for Action Manager descriptors and executeAsModal.

automation.notes: UXP, not ExtendScript: the photoshop module exposes app (the DOM), core (executeAsModal and host queries), action (batchPlay, which plays Action Manager descriptors as JSON) and constants. Members are documented in Adobe's UXP reference with their minimum versions; they are not in the 2015.5 ExtendScript typings that dom_refs are checked against.

features.name: Pixel Replacement variable (Fit, Fill, As Is, Conform; alignment; clip)
features.summary: Replaces a layer's pixels with an image file, scaled and aligned in its bounding box.

automation.notes: Defined in the Variables dialog; no published descriptor.

features.name: Text Replacement variable
features.summary: Replaces the text of a type layer per data set.

automation.notes: Defined in the Variables dialog; no published descriptor.

features.name: Visibility variable
features.summary: Shows or hides a layer or group per data set.

automation.notes: Defined in the Variables dialog; no published descriptor.

features.name: Define Variables
features.summary: Marks layers as Visibility, Text Replacement or Pixel Replacement variables for data-driven graphics.

automation.notes: Runs as select on menu item "defineVariables" (reference menuItemClass/menuItemType; ps14features, xtools Stdlib.doMenuItem). Opens the dialog; the Background layer cannot hold variables. Image > Variables > Define... is dialog-only: the defineVariables menu item opens the Variables dialog, and no published descriptor defines a layer variable. Variables come in with a document or a data set file; manage_data_sets imports and applies data sets.

features.name: Web Photo Gallery
features.summary: Generated a web site of thumbnails and gallery pages from a set of images.

automation.notes: Optional legacy plug-in that the help says needs 32-bit Photoshop; Bridge took over web galleries. Application.makePhotoGallery and GalleryOptions remain in the object model; whether they work in current Photoshop is not established.

domains.name: Import and export
domains.covers: Open, Place, Save As and Export formats and their options: Export As, Quick Export, Save for Web, Generate Image Assets, layers to files and PDF presentation.

features.name: BMP: File format and bit depth
features.summary: Chooses Windows or OS/2 format and bits per pixel.

features.name: BMP: Compress (RLE) and Flip Row Order
features.summary: Advanced BMP options.

features.name: Export Color Lookup Tables
features.summary: Writes the look of a document's adjustment layers as 3DL, CUBE, CSP or ICC device link lookup tables, with description and copyright.

automation.notes: Runs Adobe's ExportColorLookupTables.jsx, whose javascriptresource header declares event id 9AA9D7D6-C209-494A-CC01-4E7D926DA642 under File > Export. The script always shows its dialog (a comment says it cannot run without UI) and reads its last settings from app.getCustomOptions under the same id, not from the event descriptor. Its file step plays the export event with using = class 'lut ' (keys fpth, dscr, Cpyr, gPts, wICC, w3DL, wCUB, wCSP, lcFE) on a rendered grid document. Needs a background layer plus adjustment layers.

features.name: Export with Content Credentials
features.summary: Attaches content credentials (provenance and edit history) to exported files.

automation.notes: Depends on Adobe cloud services; not established for scripting.

features.name: Customize Save Dialog File Formats
features.summary: Chooses which formats are listed in Save As and Save a Copy.

automation.notes: Recent addition (help page dated August 2026); not established for scripting.

features.name: DCS: composite (none, grayscale, color)
features.summary: Adds a 72-ppi grayscale or color composite for placement and proofing.

features.name: DCS 2.0: single or multiple files
features.summary: Writes channels as separate files or one file.

features.name: Enable Generator
features.summary: Plug-Ins preference that turns Generator, and the Generator Plugins menu, on or off.

automation.notes: Preferences > Plug-Ins; not in the object model. set with null = property pluginPicker of the application and to = a pluginPicker object with generatorEnabled true or false (Adobe's spaces-adapter generator.js setGeneratorStatus); get on the application's generatorStatus property reads the state. Unverified.

features.name: EPS: Encoding (ASCII, Binary, JPEG)
features.summary: Chooses how image data is delivered to PostScript devices.

features.name: EPS: Include Halftone Screen / Transfer Function
features.summary: Embeds print screen and transfer settings for commercial printing.

features.name: EPS: Image Interpolation
features.summary: Smooths the low-resolution preview when printed.

features.name: EPS: Preview (None, TIFF 1-bit/8-bit, Macintosh)
features.summary: Embeds a low-resolution preview for placing applications.

features.name: EPS: PostScript Color Management
features.summary: Converts data to the printer's color space.

features.name: EPS: Transparent Whites
features.summary: Makes white transparent in Bitmap-mode images.

features.name: EPS: Include Vector Data
features.summary: Keeps shapes and type as vectors for other applications.

features.name: Export As
features.summary: Exports the document, artboards, layers or groups to PNG, JPG, GIF (or SVG) with size, scale, canvas, metadata and color space settings.

automation.notes: Also from the Layers panel context menu. No object-model member or published descriptor runs the dialog's export; Quick Export events cover preset-driven export.

features.name: Export As: Canvas Size
features.summary: Centers the asset in fixed dimensions, clipping or padding with white, transparency or the last color.

automation.notes: Export As dialog option.

features.name: Export As: Color Space (Convert to sRGB, Embed Color Profile)
features.summary: Converts to sRGB and optionally embeds the profile.

automation.notes: Export As dialog option.

features.name: Export As: Format and format settings (PNG Transparency / Smaller File 8-bit, JPG Quality, GIF)
features.summary: Chooses the format; PNG gives 32-, 24- or 8-bit assets depending on the options.

automation.notes: Export As dialog option.

features.name: Export As: Image Size (Width, Height, Scale) and Resample
features.summary: Scales the asset with a chosen resampling method (Bilinear, Bicubic variants, Nearest Neighbor, Preserve Details).

automation.notes: Export As dialog option.

features.name: Export As: Metadata (None, Copyright and Contact Info)
features.summary: Embeds limited metadata; resolution is always included.

automation.notes: Export As dialog option.

features.name: Export As: Scale All (sizes and suffixes)
features.summary: Exports several relative sizes at once, each with a filename suffix such as @2x.

automation.notes: Export As dialog option.

features.name: Export Layers to Files
features.summary: Saves each layer (or each visible layer) as its own file with a name prefix, in a chosen format with its options and optional ICC profile.

automation.notes: Adobe script; event keys destination, fileNamePrefix, visibleOnly, icc, jpegQuality, psdMaxComp, tiffCompression, tiffJpegQuality, pdfEncoding, pdfJpegQuality, targaDepth, bmpDepth. Formats: BMP, JPEG, PDF, PSD, Targa, TIFF, PNG-8, PNG-24.

features.name: Export to Adobe cloud
features.summary: Saves exports to a cloud project from Export As.

automation.notes: Cloud service.

features.name: Extract Assets
features.summary: Extracted layers or groups as PNG, JPG, GIF or SVG assets at several resolutions (Photoshop CC 2015).

automation.notes: Documented for Photoshop CC 2015 and relying on Generator; whether it remains in current versions was not established.

features.name: File compression methods (RLE, LZW, JPEG, CCITT, ZIP)
features.summary: Lossless and lossy compression schemes used by the various formats.

automation.notes: Reference information; each format's options select the method.

features.name: AVIF
features.summary: Modern compressed image format listed for import and export.

automation.notes: Application.open reads it where Photoshop supports opening; saving to it has no options class or SaveDocumentType in the 2015.5 model.

features.name: BMP
features.summary: Windows bitmap format from 1-bit to 24-bit (and 32-bit), Windows or OS/2 type.

automation.notes: Saved with Document.saveAs and this format's options object; opened with Application.open.

features.name: Cineon
features.summary: 10-bit-per-channel Kodak format for film work; 16-bit RGB images can be saved to it.

automation.notes: Application.open reads it where Photoshop supports opening; saving to it has no options class or SaveDocumentType in the 2015.5 model.

features.name: Photoshop DCS 1.0
features.summary: EPS variant writing one file per CMYK channel plus an optional composite.

automation.notes: Saved with Document.saveAs and this format's options object; opened with Application.open.

features.name: Photoshop DCS 2.0
features.summary: EPS variant that keeps spot channels, as one or multiple files.

automation.notes: Saved with Document.saveAs and this format's options object; opened with Application.open.

features.name: DICOM

automation.notes: Application.open reads it where Photoshop supports opening; saving to it has no options class or SaveDocumentType in the 2015.5 model.

features.name: Digital Negative (DNG)
features.summary: Archival camera raw format, opened through Camera Raw.

automation.notes: Application.open reads it where Photoshop supports opening; saving to it has no options class or SaveDocumentType in the 2015.5 model.

features.name: Photoshop EPS
features.summary: PostScript format with vector and bitmap data for page layout; vectors rasterize on reopening.

automation.notes: Saved with Document.saveAs and this format's options object; opened with Application.open.

features.name: GIF (CompuServe GIF)
features.summary: Indexed-color format with LZW compression, transparency and animation.

automation.notes: Saved with Document.saveAs and this format's options object; opened with Application.open.

features.name: HEIF / HEIC
features.summary: Mobile photo format; needs HEIF and HEVC codecs on Windows, macOS 10.13 or later on Mac.

automation.notes: Application.open reads it where Photoshop supports opening; saving to it has no options class or SaveDocumentType in the 2015.5 model.

features.name: IFF
features.summary: General data format including Maya IFF.

automation.notes: Application.open reads it where Photoshop supports opening; saving to it has no options class or SaveDocumentType in the 2015.5 model.

features.name: JPEG
features.summary: Lossy 8-bit format for photographs; no transparency.

automation.notes: Saved with Document.saveAs and this format's options object; opened with Application.open.

features.name: JPEG XL (JXL)
features.summary: Format listed among those that store 32-bit images.

automation.notes: Application.open reads it where Photoshop supports opening; saving to it has no options class or SaveDocumentType in the 2015.5 model.

features.name: JPEG 2000
features.summary: Wavelet-compressed format supporting 16-bit images.

automation.notes: Application.open reads it where Photoshop supports opening; saving to it has no options class or SaveDocumentType in the 2015.5 model.

features.name: OpenEXR
features.summary: 32-bit-per-channel HDR format from visual effects work, with transparency.

automation.notes: Application.open reads it where Photoshop supports opening; saving to it has no options class or SaveDocumentType in the 2015.5 model.

features.name: PCX
features.summary: Legacy bitmap format listed among import and export formats.

automation.notes: Application.open reads it. SaveDocumentType lists it, but the 2015.5 model has no options class to save it with Document.saveAs.

features.name: Photoshop 2.0
features.summary: Legacy flattened format for very old software, macOS only.

automation.notes: Application.open reads it where Photoshop supports opening; saving to it has no options class or SaveDocumentType in the 2015.5 model.

features.name: Photoshop PDF
features.summary: PDF that can keep Photoshop editing data, with presets, PDF/X standards and security.

automation.notes: Saved with Document.saveAs and this format's options object; opened with Application.open.

features.name: Photoshop Raw
features.summary: Headerless byte stream of pixel data for transfer between applications; no layers.

automation.notes: Saved with Document.saveAs and this format's options object; opened with Application.open.

features.name: PICT File / PICT Resource

features.name: Pixar
features.summary: Format for high-end 3D rendering and animation systems, RGB or grayscale with one alpha channel.

automation.notes: Saved with Document.saveAs and this format's options object; opened with Application.open.

features.name: PNG
features.summary: Lossless format with transparency for RGB, indexed, grayscale and bitmap images.

features.name: Scitex CT
features.summary: Continuous-tone format for Scitex image processing systems.

automation.notes: Application.open reads it. SaveDocumentType lists it, but the 2015.5 model has no options class to save it with Document.saveAs.

features.name: Targa

features.name: TIFF

features.name: Image Assets (Generator)

features.name: Generator default settings layer

features.name: GIF: palette, colors, forced colors, dither, transparency, matte, interlace
features.summary: Controls the indexed-color conversion and GIF output options.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType snapNone); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('snapNone')) runs the same command.

features.name: Snap To Slices
features.summary: Sets whether snapping uses slices.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType snapToSlices); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('snapToSlices')) runs the same command.

features.name: Spring-loaded shortcuts
features.summary: Holding a tool's key switches to it temporarily and returns to the previous tool on release.

features.name: Stack floating panels
features.summary: Floating panels can be stacked so they move as one unit.

features.name: Status bar
features.summary: Bar at the bottom of each document window with magnification, the chosen status information and file details; clicking shows width, height, channels and resolution.

features.name: Status information
features.summary: Document Sizes, Document Profile, Document Dimensions, Measurement Scale, Scratch Sizes, Efficiency, Timing, Current Tool and 32-bit Exposure, shown in the status bar or Info panel.

features.name: Tool Presets
features.summary: Lists saved tool presets (a tool with its settings such as brush, opacity, flow and mode) for quick selection; the same presets appear in the options bar Tool Preset picker and can be saved to and loaded from files.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType toggleToolPresetsPalette); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('toggleToolPresetsPalette')) runs the same command. Application.saveToolBrushToFile, applyToolBrushFromFile and toolSupportsBrushes save and load the current tool's brush settings; choosing a tool preset is not covered by them.

features.name: Single or double column toolbar
features.summary: The double-arrow at the top of the toolbar switches between one and two columns.

automation.notes: Interactive only.

features.name: Tools panel
features.summary: The toolbar holding tools in groups; can be shown in one or two columns.

automation.notes: Script-Show_Tools in the same source records the show event with classPanel to display it. Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType TglT); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('TglT')) runs the same command.

features.name: Touch Bar support
features.summary: Context-sensitive Photoshop controls on the MacBook Pro Touch Bar.

features.name: Touch workspace
features.summary: Touch-friendly experience on supported Windows devices such as Surface Pro, with gestures and a customizable toolbar.

features.name: UI Scaling
features.summary: Scales parts of the interface; on recent Windows versions Photoshop follows the per-monitor OS scaling instead.
Shows the image at 100% (one image pixel per screen pixel).

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType ActP); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('ActP')) runs the same command.

features.summary: Shows the image at 200%.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType view200Percent); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('view200Percent')) runs the same command.

features.name: Snap window support (Windows)
features.summary: On Windows, the Photoshop window supports snap layouts from its maximise button or Win+Z.

automation.notes: Windows only; operating-system behaviour.

features.name: Essentials (Default)
features.summary: Switches to the default workspace.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType defaultWorkspace); app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('defaultWorkspace')) runs the same command.

features.name: Workspace switcher
features.summary: Menu in the application bar listing built-in and saved workspaces.

automation.notes: workspaceMenu is the Workspace Selection event in the Alchemist list; its descriptor keys are not documented. workspaceMenu is listed as an event but its descriptor is undocumented, and no cited source selects a named workspace. Only Window > Workspace > Essentials (defaultWorkspace) is reachable, through show_photoshop_panels.

features.name: Zoom Clicked Point to Center
features.summary: Centres the view on the clicked point when zooming.

features.name: Zoom In
features.summary: Increases magnification one preset step.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType ZmIn); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('ZmIn')) runs the same command.

features.name: Zoom Out
features.summary: Decreases magnification one preset step.

automation.notes: Recorded as the select event on a menu item (menuItemClass reference, menuItemType ZmOt); app.runMenuItem(charIDToTypeID('ZmOt')) runs the same command.

features.name: Zoom tool
features.summary: Magnifies or reduces the view; click to zoom in, Alt/Option-click to zoom out, or drag with Scrubby Zoom.

automation.notes: Selected by setting app.currentTool = 'zoomTool' (or the select event with a zoomTool class reference); using the tool on the canvas is interactive.

features.name: Zoom tool options
features.summary: Options bar settings: Zoom In and Zoom Out, Resize Windows To Fit, Zoom All Windows, Scrubby Zoom, 100% and Fit On Screen.

automation.notes: Tool options; interactive.

features.name: Zoom with Scroll Wheel
features.summary: Mouse wheel zooms instead of scrolling.

automation.notes: Set as an application preference: set with null = reference to property toolsPreferences of the application (ordinal targetEnum) and to = a toolsPreferences object holding only the key to change, the pattern Adobe's spaces-adapter uses for pluginPicker and unitsPrefs and JSUI uses for interfacePrefs. The key is zoomWithScrollWheel (boolean), named in the photoshop-types typings of toolsPreferences. Unverified.
